Title: Data Analyst Digital Health (m/w/d)
Description:
MEDIAN Deutschland ist Teil der MEDIAN Group, einem der führenden europäischen Anbieter auf dem Gebiet der medizinischen Rehabilitation und der psychischen Gesundheit. Mit mehr als 120 Einrichtungen in ganz Deutschland bietet MEDIAN ein dynamisches und innovatives Umfeld für Beschäftigte in den unterschiedlichsten Fach- und Servicebereichen mit vielfältigen Einstiegs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Als Spezialist für Rehabilitation und Teilhabe begleiten wir unsere Patientinnen und Patienten auf dem Weg zur Genesung und zurück in den Alltag – ganz nach unserem Leitsatz „Das Leben leben“.

Wir suchen Sie als Data Analyst (m/w/d) im Bereich digitale Gesundheit in Vollzeit !

Ihre Aufgabenschwerpunkte


Analyse der Nutzungs-, Interaktions- und Adhärenzdaten digitaler Nachsorge-Anwendungen entlang der gesamten Nutzungsreise (von der Registrierung bis zur Abrechnung)
Erschließung und Verknüpfung weiterer Datenquellen (z. B. Fragebogen-, Klinikbehandlungsdaten) über bestehende Systeme hinweg für vertiefende Analysen
Übersetzung von Anfragen aus Produkt- und Therapie-Team in fundierte analytische Fragestellungen und Kennzahlen, inklusive Anwendung statistischer Verfahren zur Inferenz und Prognose
Aufbau und Pflege eines KPI-Dashboards für Produktteam, Therapeut:innen-Team und Management
Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen gemeinsam mit den Teams zur Prozessoptimierung und besseren Unterstützung der Patient:innen
Identifikation von Daten- und Prozessproblemen, Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung verbesserter Datenstrukturen
Unterstützung beim monatlichen Reporting auf operativer und Management-Ebene


Ihr Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
Fundierte SQL-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit R
Erfahrung mit statistischer Inferenz und Forecasting-Verfahren, sowohl deskriptiv als auch erklärend und prognostisch
Erfahrung mit Dashboards und Datenvisualisierungen (z. B. Tableau, Power BI)
Fähigkeit, Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen strukturiert zu verknüpfen und in einen analysierbaren Zusammenhang zu setzen
Fähigkeit, fachliche Fragestellungen in analytische zu übersetzen, komplexe Daten zielführend zu interpretieren und verständlich an unterschiedliche Stakeholder (Produktteam, Therapeut:innen-Team, Management) zu kommunizieren
Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft, Daten- und Prozessprobleme proaktiv anzusprechen und Verbesserungsvorschläge einzubringen
Erfahrung im Bereich digitaler Gesundheitsanwendungen (Digital Health) oder im Umgang mit Nutzungs- bzw. Adhärenzdaten von Vorteil
Monatliche Reisebereitschaft von 2–4 Tagen innerhalb Deutschlands (meistens am Stück), Führerschein Klasse B
Deutschkenntnisse auf C2 Niveau, fließende Englischkenntnisse (C1)


Wir bieten Ihnen die Vorteile eines Marktführers


Sinnstiftende Aufgabe mit direktem Impact: Gestalten Sie die digitale Nachsorge aktiv mit - Ihre Analysen und Kennzahlen bilden die Entscheidungsgrundlage für Produkt und Therapie und tragen dazu bei, dass Patient:innen auch nach ihrem Klinikaufenthalt nachhaltig und patientenzentriert begleitet werden
Digitale Gesundheitsversorgung mitgestalten: Werden Sie Teil unserer digitalen Transformation und gestalten Sie mit Ihren Analysen die datenbasierte Weiterentwicklung innovativer digitaler Nachsorge-Angebote, die über 50.000 Patient:innen in ihrer nachhaltigen Genesung unterstützen
Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit: Übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle als Data Analyst und bauen Sie unsere Datenanalyse- und KPI-Infrastruktur eigenverantwortlich auf - an der Schnittstelle von Datenanalyse, Gesundheit, digitalem Produkt und Therapie
Flexibles Arbeiten: Profitieren Sie von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, regelmäßig mobil von zuhause oder unterwegs zu arbeiten - die entsprechende technische Ausstattung stellen wir Ihnen zur Verfügung
Interdisziplinäres Team mit Start-up-Charakter: Arbeiten Sie in einem dynamischen, diversen und interdiisziplinären Team und profitieren Sie von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, gegenseitigem Austausch und unserem festen wöchentlichen Teamtag
Zahlreiche Mitarbeitervorteile für bekannte Marken (Corporate Benefits)
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über die MEDIAN Akademie

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Your mission

We're a small data team with a big job: helping everyone at Cosuno make better decisions. Our data platform is stable and in good hands. What we need now is someone who takes our most important, open-ended business questions and answers them properly: in depth, with little guidance, and often before anyone thought to ask.

You'll work across product and commercial topics. How do general contractors and subcontractors actually use our platform? What makes some accounts grow into company-wide rollouts? Which levers move our funnel the most? You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and leadership, and we expect you to have opinions.

In Your First Few Months, You Might


Work out what drives account growth: which behaviours predict long-term retention and expansion, and how Sales and Customer Success can act on them.
Map how our customers really use the product: which workflows stick, where new features find their audience, and what healthy adoption looks like in an account's first months.
Pick a question nobody has asked yet, answer it, and change a product or go-to-market decision with the result.
Build the dbt models and Looker views your analyses need, so the next person can answer the question themselves.


How We Work


Questions Over Tickets: You don't wait for requests. You figure out what matters and go after it.
Depth Over Dashboards: One analysis that changes a decision beats ten reports nobody reads.
Pragmatic by Default: Simple processes, fast iterations, and the lightest method that gives a trustworthy answer.
Clarity Wins: A finding is only as good as how well others understand it and act on it.
AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools and expect everyone to use them fluently.


Your profile


5+ years in analytics at fast-growing startups or scaleups, ideally B2B SaaS, where your work shaped product or commercial decisions.
An exceptional ability to reason through ambiguous business problems: framing the right question, choosing a sound approach, and landing on a clear recommendation.
Hands-on experience in both product analytics (usage, adoption, engagement, experimentation) and commercial analytics (retention, expansion, funnel, pricing).
A track record of driving your own analytical agenda with minimal guidance.
Strong SQL and professional experience with dbt and a BI tool (a strong command of Looker is a big plus). You build the models and views you need instead of waiting for them.
Solid Python for analysis and scripting.
Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude Code, and a habit of using them in your daily work.
Excellent written and spoken English. You can explain a complex finding in one clear paragraph.


Bonus


Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms.
Experience in vertical SaaS, construction tech or procurement.
Experience with BigQuery.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: (Senior) Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
At International Campus, we're shaping the future of urban living. Across Germany, Austria, the Netherlands and the Czech Republic, our brands create inspiring homes for students and young professionals. As we continue to grow, data is becoming one of our most powerful assets. Join us and help transform insights into decisions that drive our business forward.




What You’ll do:

Transform data from occupancy, pricing, revenue and customer behavior into actionable business insights across four European markets.
Create intuitive dashboards and reports that empower teams to make smarter decisions every day.
Identify trends, opportunities and risks, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for senior leaders and the Executive Team, presenting insights with confidence and conviction.
Increase efficiency by automating recurring analyses and reporting processes using SQL and Python.
Take full ownership of your topics, from defining the business question to influencing strategic decisions




What You bring:

A strong quantitative educational background (e.g. Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or Engineering).
Strong hands-on skills in SQL, Python and Excel, with a passion for turning data into business value.
Experience working with BI and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
A confident and credible presence. You can challenge assumptions, defend your analyses and engage constructively with senior stakeholders, including C-level leaders.
A proactive, self-driven mindset. You take ownership, learn quickly, ask the right questions and don't wait for instructions.
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect data insights with commercial outcomes.
Professional fluency in English (C1) is essential, as English is the primary working language in this role, while German language skills are a strong asset and will help you build effective relationships across our organization
Experience in Real Estate, Hospitality, Serviced Living or another asset-heavy, consumer-facing industry would be a strong advantage.




What’s in it for You:

30 days of annual leave, plus additional paid leave on December 24 and December 31
Permanent employment contract, a wide range of employee perks and discounts and a competitive salary
Regular team events and workshops
Bring your own spirit to the company and be your authentic self
Work in a dynamic environment with extensive interaction and exchange with young people




What You should know about us

Our company culture is open, fair, and built on partnership. Despite our ambitious goals and high standards, enjoying our work and collaborating as a team always comes first.

As an employee, you are not only part of our culture, but you also actively help shape it. We believe that 200 minds are better than one, which is why we welcome and value every employee's feedback. This allows us to continuously reflect on and improve ourselves as an employer.

While we have outgrown our start-up roots, we have intentionally retained our entrepreneurial spirit. We are not a large corporation with rigid structures and lengthy decision-making processes. Instead, we offer an environment where ideas are heard, ownership is encouraged, and collaboration is key.

To get a better impression of International Campus and what we are passionate about, feel free to visit our LinkedIn and Instagram profiles.

Have we sparked your interest? Then apply now!

BE PART OF IC – We look forward to receiving your application!

Description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.




Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.




Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)




Are you curious about what makes games engaging? Do you enjoy understanding not just what players do, but why they do it, and turning that understanding into clear, actionable insights? We are looking for a Game Data Analyst to strengthen our product analytics capabilities. In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with solid technical foundations to support multiple game teams over time. This is an individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on data modeling, advanced analysis, and scalable analytical foundations.




Responsibilities

Partner with product and game teams to answer complex questions around player behavior, engagement, and progression
Perform advanced analyses using SQL to uncover patterns and drivers behind player actions
Design and analyze player segmentation and behavioral cohorts
Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests to measure feature performance, optimize player experiences, and guide data-informed decisions. Build and maintain reliable, analytics-ready data models (experience with dbt or similar tools)
Ensure data quality, clarity, and documentation of key datasets and metrics
Contribute to self-serve reporting and visualization
Partner with cross-functional teams to align priorities, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure analytics is central to shaping the player experience.
Collaborate with other analysts and data infrastructure team to improve analytical workflows and standards




Required Skills

3+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools
Experience working with complex datasets and analytical data models
Ability to translate data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical audiences
Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn new tools and approaches




Desirable Skills

Experience with Looker and dbt
Experience with Python or R for data analysis.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)
Background in games, free-to-play, or product analytics

Du unterstützt dabei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten umzusetzen. Unsere Analysen und Dashboards fließen direkt in das Reporting und die Entscheidungsgrundlagen unserer Kunden ein.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du hands-on an Analytics-Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Dashboards, der Analyse komplexer Daten sowie beim Aufbau von Datenstrukturen und -pipelines. Dabei begleitest du Projekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Deine Aufgaben


Du arbeitest an Analytics-Workstreams in Kundenprojekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Teilprojekte
Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst und betreibst du Datenpipelines zwischen Cloud-Quellen und Analytics- bzw. Dashboard-Tools und stellst deren Qualität, Automatisierung und Performance sicher (insbesondere über SQL)
Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards mit Fokus auf Usability und klare Entscheidungsunterstützung für das Management
Du analysierst komplexe und heterogene Datenstrukturen, bereitest Daten auf und führst verschiedene Datenquellen effizient zusammen
Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen und explorative Auswertungen durch und bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf
Du arbeitest eng im Projektteam und mit relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und treibst die Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen aktiv voran
Du unterstützt bei Architekturfragen, Priorisierungen und der Weiterentwicklung von Analytics-Lösungen
Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich und methodisch kontinuierlich weiter

Du hast erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) im Bereich Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Umfeld
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Python und bist in der Lage, komplexe Datenstrukturen eigenständig zu analysieren und aufzubereiten
Du hast erste Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenpipelines und/oder im Dashboarding gesammelt
Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit BI-Tools (z. B. AWS QuickSight, Grafana, Tableau, etc.) mit
Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert und hast Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen zu lösen
Du denkst dich schnell in neue Themen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter
Idealerweise hast du erste Berührungspunkte mit Prozessen in der Automobilindustrie oder im industriellen Umfeld
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst klar und trittst auch im Austausch mit Kunden sicher auf
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten

Bei DRIVE Consulting triffst du auf ein junges, wachsendes Team, dessen Herz für technische Beratungsprojekte in der Industrie schlägt – insbesondere im Automotive-Umfeld.

Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, schneller Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Offenheit, Vertrauen und Teamspirit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – in einem motivierten Team mit klarer Umsetzungsorientierung.

Individuelles Coaching und persönliches Buddy-Programm für deinen Einstieg und deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
Dienstwagen oder Jobrad bzw. Jobticket – flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen

Regelmäßige Teamevents zur Stärkung des Teamzusammenhalts
Monatliches Happy Friday Frühstück
100 € Spendenbudget zur freien Verfügung
Sabbatical-Optionen

Beschreibung

Du willst im Bereich Data Science & Analytics dort arbeiten, wo es wirklich zählt – an komplexen Industrieprojekten mit direktem Einfluss auf Entscheidungen auf Management-Ebene?

Bei DRIVE Consulting arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen führender Industrieunternehmen. Du unterstützt dabei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten umzusetzen. Unsere Analysen und Dashboards fließen direkt in das Reporting und die Entscheidungsgrundlagen unserer Kunden ein.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du hands-on an Analytics-Lösungen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Dashboards, der Analyse komplexer Daten sowie beim Aufbau von Datenstrukturen und -pipelines. Dabei begleitest du Projekte von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest an Analytics-Workstreams in Kundenprojekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Teilprojekte
  • Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst und betreibst du Datenpipelines zwischen Cloud-Quellen und Analytics- bzw. Dashboard-Tools und stellst deren Qualität, Automatisierung und Performance sicher (insbesondere über SQL)
  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards mit Fokus auf Usability und klare Entscheidungsunterstützung für das Management
  • Du analysierst komplexe und heterogene Datenstrukturen, bereitest Daten auf und führst verschiedene Datenquellen effizient zusammen
  • Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen und explorative Auswertungen durch und bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf
  • Du arbeitest eng im Projektteam und mit relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und treibst die Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen aktiv voran
  • Du unterstützt bei Architekturfragen, Priorisierungen und der Weiterentwicklung von Analytics-Lösungen
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich und methodisch kontinuierlich weiter

Dein Profil

  • Du hast erste Berufserfahrung (ca. 1–3 Jahre) im Bereich Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Umfeld
  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Python und bist in der Lage, komplexe Datenstrukturen eigenständig zu analysieren und aufzubereiten
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung im Aufbau von Datenpipelines und/oder im Dashboarding gesammelt
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit BI-Tools (z. B. AWS QuickSight, Grafana, Tableau, etc.) mit
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert und hast Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen zu lösen
  • Du denkst dich schnell in neue Themen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter
  • Idealerweise hast du erste Berührungspunkte mit Prozessen in der Automobilindustrie oder im industriellen Umfeld
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst klar und trittst auch im Austausch mit Kunden sicher auf
  • Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten

Unser Angebot an dich

Bei DRIVE Consulting triffst du auf ein junges, wachsendes Team, dessen Herz für technische Beratungsprojekte in der Industrie schlägt – insbesondere im Automotive-Umfeld.

Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, schneller Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter.

Offenheit, Vertrauen und Teamspirit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – in einem motivierten Team mit klarer Umsetzungsorientierung.

Außerdem Erwarten Dich

  • Individuelles Coaching und persönliches Buddy-Programm für deinen Einstieg und deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Dienstwagen oder Jobrad bzw. Jobticket – flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen
  • Täglicher Lunch-Zuschuss (6 €)
  • EGYM Wellpass für Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte über Corporate Benefits
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
  • Obst, Kaffee und Erfrischungsgetränke im Office
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents zur Stärkung des Teamzusammenhalts
  • Monatliches Happy Friday Frühstück
  • 100 € Spendenbudget zur freien Verfügung
  • Sabbatical-Optionen

Über uns

DRIVE Consulting GmbH ist eine Unternehmensberatung mit Hauptsitz in Aachen sowie Standorten in München, Berlin, Peking und Shanghai. Unser Herz schlägt für technische Beratungsprojekte mit Fokus auf die Automobil- und Industriebranche. Zu unseren Kunden zählen sowohl deutsche Premium OEMs als auch junge, aufstrebende Automobilhersteller sowie große und mittelständische Industrieunternehmen.

Unser Name steht für unseren klaren Fokus auf die Mobilitätsbranche und repräsentiert gleichzeitig unseren Spirit – denn wir sind ein Team, in dem jede*r Einzelne DRIVE hat.

Wir stehen unseren Kunden als Wegbereiter ins Unbekannte und als Katalysator für Innovationen zur Seite. Denn wir sind überzeugt, dass man nur mit dem Mut, neue Wege einzuschlagen, einzigartige Erfolgsgeschichten schreiben kann.

Wir schlagen Brücken zwischen kleinen Ideenschmieden und großen Konzernen sowie zwischen Management und Technologieexpert*innen.

Durch den engen und partnerschaftlichen Austausch mit unseren Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte und individuelle Lösungen. Ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist dabei unser einzigartiges Partnernetzwerk aus Industrie und Forschung. Dank unserer Nähe zu namhaften Universitäten wie der RWTH Aachen verbinden wir Wissenschaft und Praxis.

Begeisterung wird bei uns großgeschrieben und bestimmt unseren Arbeitsalltag – denn sie ist der beste Antrieb.

Wer uns fehlt, bist du!

Du konzipierst, implementierst und optimierst Tracking-Architekturen und setzt dabei Tools wie Google Tag Manager, GA4, Piwik PRO, BigQuery und Data Studio ein, um eine datenschutzkonforme, präzise und zukunftsfähige Datenerfassung sicherzustellen

Title: Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
A11 ist der ausführende Wachstumstreiber hinter Europas führenden Tech-Unicorns wie Trade Republic, Sennder und Kry. Wir sind ein SWAT-Team für Business Performance mit Expertise in Marketing, Sales, Data, Tech und People Ops. Mit mehr als 100 internationalen Expert:innen gehen wir komplexe Herausforderungen in Business und Technologie gezielt an. Ob Produkteinführungen in Rekordzeit oder die Transformation ganzer Geschäftsmodelle – wir liefern messbaren Impact.

Die Position

Bereit zum Aufbauen und Skalieren? Bei A11 glauben wir, dass Umsetzung wichtiger ist als Theorie. Wir suchen eine/n erfahrenen Data Analyst (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Analytics Teams bei A11.

Das Ziel unserer täglichen Arbeit ist es, aus Daten einen Mehrwert für unsere Partner und Kunden zu schaffen. Du unterstützt und berätst in dieser Rolle externe und interne Stakeholder in allen Themen rund um Data.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Data Engineering Team hilfst Du dabei, diese Möglichkeiten zu erschließen.

Sei Verantwortlich Für


Beratung unserer Kunden zu Dateninitiativen: von der Identifizierung strategisch relevanter Themen bis zur operativen Umsetzung, für ein datengestütztes Geschäftsverständnis
Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und Projektplänen aus Daten, überzeugend kommuniziert an (Senior) Stakeholder auf Kunden- und interner Seite
Koordination und fachliche Anleitung von Data Engineering & Science bei Data Warehousing-, ML- und KI-Projekten
Weiterentwicklung von konsistentem Tracking und Datenerfassung (client- und serverseitig) sowie einer einheitlichen, kundenspezifischen Dateninfrastruktur
Bereitstellung und Aktivierung von Daten für Unternehmensentscheidungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden


Dein Profil


Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics - idealerweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld, wobei ein Hintergrund in der Beratung oder in einer Agentur von Vorteil ist
Hohes Maß an emotionaler Intelligenz, um sinnvolle Beziehungen zu (leitenden) Interessengruppen aufzubauen und zu pflegen
Fundierte Erfahrung in mindestens einem speziellen Datenbereich (z.B. Marketing Analytics, Product Analytics, Data Governance, Customer Analytics)
Professioneller Umgang mit Tools zur Datenanalyse und -modellierung, inkl. SQL / dbt
Fachkenntnisse in mindestens einem Bereich von MDS: Datenerfassung (Google Tag Manager, Segment), Datenintegration (Fivetran, Airbyte), Datenbanken (Snowflake, BigQuery), Datenmodellierung (dbt, DataForm) & Aktivierung (Looker, Metabase, PowerBI, Census)
Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch ist ein Muss


Bitte beachte, dass wir Unterstützung im Berliner Büro suchen.

Warum Du Dich Für A11 Entscheiden Solltest


Gestalte die Zukunft der Innovation: Übernimm die Führung bei bahnbrechenden Projekten in einer Vielzahl von Unternehmen und Regionen. Du wirst einen echten Einfluss durch unseren strategischen und praxisorientierten Arbeitsstil haben.
Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team von Digital Natives zusammen: Erschließe neue Möglichkeiten zum Lernen, Mitgestalten und Aufblühen in einem dynamischen, multikulturellen Umfeld. Unser Team besteht aus über 25 Nationalitäten und bringt Erfahrung in einer Vielzahl von Unternehmen und Branchen mit.
Karriereentwicklung: Wir unterstützen dein Wachstum in jede Richtung—ob du deine Expertise vertiefen, eine Abteilung leiten oder neue Bereiche erkunden möchtest.
Nutze Veränderungen und neue Technologien: Wir probieren aktiv neue Tools und KI-Funktionen aus, um unsere Arbeitsabläufe und Prozesse zu optimieren, und geben dir kreative Freiheit sowie Autonomie, um deine Ziele zu erreichen.
Austausch und Entdecken: Von gemeinsamen Mahlzeiten mit dem Team über unterhaltsame Offsites bis hin zu regelmäßig stattfindenden Meetups—du wirst durch regelmäßige Events und dynamische Wissensaustauschmöglichkeiten nachhaltige Verbindungen aufbauen.


Wenn du motiviert bist, echten Einfluss zu erzielen und Resultate zu liefern, möchten wir dich kennenlernen!

Wir engagieren uns für Diversität und Inklusion

A11 bekennt sich zu Diversität und Chancengleichheit, dies gilt gleichermaßen für unsere Mitarbeitenden als auch Kandidat:Innen.

Wir schätzen die Menschen – mit all ihren vielfältigen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Unser vielfältiges Team hat unterschiedliche ethnische und kulturelle Hintergründe, geschlechtliche Identitäten, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienverhältnisse, religiöse und politische Zugehörigkeiten, sozioökonomische Status, Altersgruppen und Fähigkeiten.

Title: Senior Revenue Intelligence Analyst
Description:
The role and the team

As a Senior Revenue Intelligence Analyst (all genders) with a focus on Customer Excellence, you own end-to-end revenue analytics across Lucanet's customer journey, from acquisition to closing to retention. You build predictive models, KPI frameworks, and Board-ready dashboards, with special attention to post-sales metrics such as NRR, GRR, churn, and Professional Services utilization.

You report into the Revenue Architecture & Operations leadership team, work within Revenue Intelligence & Analysis, and partner closely with Customer Excellence, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and GTM Strategy. You connect insights across these functions so that leadership and the Board can make confident revenue decisions, and you work remotely from Germany. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.

What You'll Do


Own end-to-end revenue analytics from lead generation to retention and expansion across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Excellence.
Monitor and report on Customer Excellence KPIs including NRR, GRR, NPS, churn, utilization rate, and time-to-value.
Build predictive models for revenue forecasting, renewals, churn risk, and upsell potential.
Drive quarterly and annual revenue planning together with Finance and revenue leadership.
Build Board-ready and self-serve dashboards that give GTM teams direct access to performance insights.
Define KPI frameworks that connect leading and lagging indicators across the full revenue lifecycle.
Lead responses to Board and executive data requests and recommend actions on territories, quotas, and resources.



What You Bring

You have:


A track record of delivering cross-functional revenue analytics in RevOps, BI, or analytics roles that informed decisions across Marketing, Sales, and post-sales teams.
Experience building forecasting or predictive models covering the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to retention.
Advanced skills in SQL and Excel, plus Python or R, and dashboard development in Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
A solid understanding of revenue systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Customer Success platforms.
Strong communication skills: you present complex data as clear business narratives to executives and influence stakeholders across functions.
Fluent English, written and spoken.



It's a plus if you also have:


A post-sales background, for example in Professional Services, consulting, or Customer Success, including PS reporting or retention KPIs.
Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI for analysis and data visualization.



Perks at work


Flexible and hybrid working: our Lucaflex model lets you plan your working hours and location according to your needs and professional responsibilities.
Remote work from another country: work up to 90 days a year outside your home country, supported by our partner Workflex.
Professional development budget: get dedicated time, resources, and budget to build the skills for your career path.
Structured development process: quarterly catch-ups with your manager, built on clear expectations for impact, competence, and influence.
Paid volunteer days: take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Sales & RevOps)
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Analytics department's mission is to enable the organisation to take action based on data. We work on a variety of problems and datasets as members of cross-functional mission teams. We take ownership of the entire analytics funnel, from exploration through recommendations to impact measurement and take pride in the insights we generate.

In this analytics role, you will be a key partner to the RevOps and Sales organization, helping leaders and reps make sharper, faster decisions across the full revenue funnel. You will tackle complex and ambiguous questions, helping to quantify pipeline health, forecast performance, and build the business case for go-to-market initiatives. A major part of your role will be to guide the sales planning and execution cycle through rigorous analysis, from territory and quota design to performance tracking and the delivery of recommendations. You will play a crucial part in providing the insights needed to prioritize opportunities, evaluate rep and channel effectiveness, and create a more efficient, data-driven sales motion.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis to drive sales strategy, forecasting, and pipeline decisions.
In collaboration with sales leadership, identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks, and risks across the funnel.
Collaborate with Sales, RevOps, and Finance leads to develop a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end revenue cycle.
Design and implement data models, dashboards, and KPIs to guide territory planning, quota setting, and team performance.
Contribute to a learning and experimentation culture by promoting hypothesis-driven testing of sales plays, incentives, and processes.
Answer the big questions to push our understanding of what drives sales performance and customer conversion.
Contribute to the strategic thinking of the team by being a thought partner to Sales and Revenue leadership.


Your toolkit


5+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics, sales operations, or data science role.
Excellent stakeholder management & communication skills, including presenting to senior sales leadership.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python.
Strong experience with sales funnel, pipeline, and forecasting analysis, ideally in Salesforce.
Strong statistical background and proficiency with advanced methods (e.g. cohort analysis, forecasting models, causal inference, or quasi-experimentation).
Ability to understand rep and customer behavior and the meaning behind the numbers, translating them into actionable insights.
Practical, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on driving revenue and business impact.
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction in ambiguous situations and with highly engaged individuals.


Extras that give you an edge


Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and processing large-scale sales/event data.
Familiarity with sales forecasting models or compensation/incentive design is a plus.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, Jupyter Notebooks).
Experience with revenue attribution and financial modeling.
Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic).


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events

Title: Learning Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
About Us

We believe every child deserves the chance to reach their full potential — and that strong foundations in literacy and numeracy are where this begins.

EIDU partners with governments to strengthen public education systems at scale. Our technology-enabled platform integrates proven educational interventions and supports learners, teachers, education officers, and ministry staff within national systems.

Today, we work with 41 governments and will reach 1,000,000 active students across Kenya and Nigeria in 2026. We have doubled our learner numbers each year over the last five years and aim to reach tens of millions more. A randomized controlled trial found a 0.53 standard deviation improvement in learning outcomes — placing EIDU among the top 10% of education interventions in low- and middle-income countries.

We combine analytical rigor, entrepreneurial drive, and disciplined execution. As we scale, we are building an organization capable of turning strategy into measurable impact at national scale.

About The Role

We are looking for a Learning Data Analyst to form an integral part of the Impact team. You will own one question: What in our learner and teacher data is driving learning outcomes and where can we head next? You will use data to identify where the programme is working and where it isn't, and what that implies for the next change we should make.

We regularly test changes to our product and programme through experiments. You will help design these tests from the start, using your statistical knowledge to choose the right method and work out the population and sampling approach. When the results come in, you will analyse them and explain clearly what worked and what didn’t. Between experiments, you will explore our data to find patterns that point to what we should test next.

[Location: Kenya/Nigeria/Germany/India preferred, open to discuss]

What you will do:


Link what learners and teachers do in the app, how much they use it (dosage), how many are reached (coverage) and progression related to learning outcomes.
Diagnose where the programme is working and where it isn't, and translate findings into clear recommendations for the next product or programme change.
Plan, design and analyse experiments end-to-end: randomisation design, power calculations, and standard causal analyses of results.
Between experiments, run the discovery engine — funnel, cohort and fidelity analyses — to surface the next thing to test.
Partner with our Ops/BI Analyst on shared surfaces such as dashboards and routine reporting..
Work with the operations and learning teams to frame the right analytical questions, grounded in learning-science literacy.
Work directly with our tech stack: Redshift, Metabase, dbt


What you should bring:


Strong SQL and Python, with experience working directly against large, messy event-level datasets.
Practitioner-level statistics: comfortable with experimental design, power analysis, and standard causal inference methods.
A track record of turning ambiguous event data into clear, decision-useful analysis.
Enough learning-science literacy to ask the right questions of learner and teacher data — formal background or applied familiarity both welcome.
Comfort operating between rigorous experiment analysis and open-ended discovery work, and communicating both clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively in a multi-cultural environment and communicating technical information with non-technical audiences.


This probably isn't for you if


You want to build production ML models or data pipelines.
You want to own dashboards and regular reporting only.
You need clean, well-documented data before you can start.
You want a large analytics team around you.


What we offer:


Work on one of the biggest problems in the world: ensuring every child gets the education they deserve.
Being a part of an international and passionate team located in Kenya, Germany and Nigeria.
An open environment where feedback is welcomed, promoting mutual growth.
High degree of flexibility with regard to working hours and vacations.

Title: Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.

Title: Data Analyst (f/d/m)
Description:
Join us as femtasy's first internal Data Analyst (f/d/m). Sit with Marketing, Product, and Finance to turn messy questions into clear, actionable answers, working directly with our Head of Data.




This is femtasy

femtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 90% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.




Your mission and your impact:

Today, all data requests from Marketing (our principal stakeholder), Product, and Finance funnel through our Head of Data, who scopes every ask before an external agency executes it. That doesn't scale. You'll be the first internal hire to change that: sitting directly with stakeholders, turning vague requests into well-defined problems, and delivering a good-enough solution fast.




You'll report to the Head of Data and work alongside an Analytics Engineer who owns the heavier dbt/pipeline work.




Six months in, this is what your impact looks like: you run scoping conversations with Marketing especially, but also Product and Finance independently – no pre-framing needed from your Head of Data. You own the fact tables and models behind your recurring reporting. You've proactively fixed or flagged at least one foundational data issue – because you saw it, not because someone asked. Stakeholders treat you as a go-to resource, not a ticket-taker.




What you'll do

Own first-line scoping conversations with Marketing, Product, and Finance: ask the right clarifying questions, push back on vague or over-scoped requests, and land on a defined problem plus a good-enough solution.
Come up with your own solution after aligned with stakeholders, maximizing the impact and keeping the development time as short as possible.
Build and maintain the dashboards and reports (Tableau today, tool-agnostic long term) that Marketing, Product, and Finance can actually act on.
Build and manage data in dbt: create and maintain the fact tables and models that support your recurring reporting and analyses, with our Analytics Engineer supporting the underlying infrastructure.
Own the day-to-day reliability of what you build: catch issues, flag or fix them – so no one ever has to ask »which number is right«.
Question the status quo at the working level. If something's »always been done that way« and it's slowing a team down, we want you to say so and to work with your Head of Data on what's worth fixing.




What you bring

3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytics role: you can work independently on well-scoped problems and know when to ask for help on ambiguous ones.
Proven stakeholder-facing judgment. You've sat in front of a non-technical stakeholder with a vague ask, asked the right questions, and resisted both over-engineering the answer and under-scoping it.
You frame problems clearly, communicate directly, and challenge assumptions.
Solid SQL, dbt, and hands-on comfort with a BI tool: you build and maintain your models yourself, from raw data to fact table to dashboard. Our Analytics Engineer supports you on infrastructure, but day-to-day dbt work is yours to own.
Comfortable moving across domains. You won't own one fixed area – you will support Marketing and other stakeholders when needed.
Opinionated but coachable. You're willing to challenge »it's always been like that«, and open to direct feedback.
Fluent in English.

A strong plus, not a must

You've worked with Marketing before (at least one real marketing project)
You've experienced a startup environment
You already use AI tools in your day-to-day analysis




This role is hybrid, based in or around Berlin. We're in the office together every Tuesday and Wednesday, with flexibility on the remaining days.




This is NOT for you if…

You want every request fully pre-scoped before you touch it, rather than asking the clarifying questions yourself.
You'd rather just execute the ticket than sit with a stakeholder and challenge whether it's the right ask.
You reach for a dashboard or a data pull before you've actually understood the business problem behind it.
You're not comfortable owning your models end-to-end in dbt, from raw data to the fact table to the final report.
You see yourself as a data service desk instead of creating your own tickets after aligning with stakeholders.




What we offer

🌟 Impact & purpose. The chance to join a huge mission around female empowerment and gender equality.

🦸 Female-led and women-centric. A female-centric product, a female CEO & Founder, and over 90% of our whole team identifies as women+.

🤝 Inspiring, performance-oriented culture. A progressive team culture based on transparency, open feedback, ownership, and collaboration. Check out »radical candor« if you want to learn more about how we work.

🤖 AI-first by default. A company-paid AI subscription of your choice, and a team that automates everything worth automating so you can focus on the work that matters.

📈 Personal and professional growth. Team learning sessions, learning & development budgets, and internal trainings. Every team member, from junior to C-level, has access to personal 1:1 sessions with a professional business coach.

🔄 Healthy approach to taking a break. 26 holidays plus unlimited recharging time on top for when you really need it.

📍 Flexibility. Flexible working hours, hybrid setup with our Berlin office as home base.

🎉 (Really cool) events & benefits like an Urban Sports membership (or alternative offerings), snacks & lunches, mobility and retirement plans, and our famous femtasy parties and team events. We also cook and eat together twice a month and have a big office garden for the best BBQs in Berlin.

💪 Package. A compensation package that fairly mirrors what's expected from you and the impact you'll have on femtasy. Exact range shared in the first call.




femtasy offers equal opportunities for all and encourages applicants of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religious backgrounds, gender identities, and people with disabilities to apply.




Our Recruiting Process

Short application questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes)
30 min Get-to-know-each-other call with one of our recruiters
30 min with our Head of Data
1h 30 min working session with our Head of Data: a live scoping exercise, not a take-home test
45 min interview with one of your future stakeholders (Marketing, Product or Finance)
1h interview with our CEO
Final offer




We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible und usually respond within three days.

Title: Dunning & Collection Analyst (w/m/d)
Description:
Your responsibilities

As a Dunning & Collection Analyst, you are responsible for extracting, analyzing, and interpreting complex data from multiple sources to uncover patterns, trends, and insights that drive strategic improvements in our collection processes and recovery rates. You transform raw data into actionable intelligence that informs business decisions and process optimization.


You extract and compile data from various systems and databases to create comprehensive datasets for analysis, utilizing SQL queries and advanced Excel techniques to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
You perform in-depth statistical and exploratory analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and correlations in customer payment behavior, delinquency rates, collection effectiveness, and dunning performance across different customer segments.
You develop and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks that track key performance indicators (collection rates, days sales outstanding, recovery efficiency, dunning success rates) and provide visibility into performance drivers.
You conduct root cause analysis on collection challenges and payment failures, drilling down into data to understand why certain customer segments, payment methods, or dunning strategies underperform.
You segment customers and cohorts based on payment behavior, risk profiles, and response patterns to enable targeted collection strategies and personalized dunning approaches.
You propose data-driven solutions based on your findings—from process improvements and policy changes to tool enhancements—and provide quantified business cases to support implementation.
You collaborate with collection teams, finance, and IT to validate findings, ensure data quality, and drive implementation of recommended improvements, monitoring impact through post-implementation analysis.
You maintain comprehensive documentation of your methodologies, data sources, analysis logic, and assumptions to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across teams.


Your profile

You have completed a degree program in data science, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, business administration, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.


You possess expert-level SQL skills with the ability to write complex queries to extract, transform, and aggregate data from relational databases.
You are highly proficient in MS Excel, including advanced functions, pivot tables, data modeling, and the ability to handle and analyze large datasets efficiently.
You have hands-on experience with business intelligence tools or data visualization platforms (Power BI, Looker, BI Cubes or similar) to create compelling dashboards and reports.
You have practical experience analyzing financial data, specifically in areas such as accounts receivable, collection processes, payment behavior, or credit risk management.
You possess strong statistical thinking and are comfortable with descriptive and exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing, trend analysis, and correlation studies.
You have a sharp analytical mind with exceptional attention to detail, a natural curiosity to dig deeper into data, and the ability to challenge assumptions.
You excel at translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and compelling business narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.
You are results-oriented, proactive, self-directed, and take ownership of your analyses from conception through implementation and measurement.
You have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple analyses simultaneously, setting priorities effectively and delivering within deadlines.
You speak English fluently


If you don't check all the boxes above, don't worry—we're looking for the right mindset, analytical drive, and willingness to learn. Your passion for uncovering insights from data matters more than ticking every requirement.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Manager Data Analytics, Global Marketing (m/f/d)
Description:
Location: Berlin or Stäfa, Hybrid




We are looking for a Manager Data Analytics to establish and lead the day-to-day analytics capability within our Global Marketing organization. As the first dedicated data analytics expert in the team, you will have the opportunity to shape how we use data across brands, products, markets and consumer touchpoints.

This is an individual contributor analytics role that sits close to the business. You will work directly with marketing, product and portfolio stakeholders, helping them understand what the data means, what actions to take and how analytics can support better decisions for our brands and consumers. While embedded in Global Marketing, you will be connected to a broader community of analytics experts and work closely with our central Data & Data Science function.




Your Responsibilities




Partner with Global Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, KPIs and decision-ready insights
Deliver analyses across areas such as product usage, NPS and voice of the customer, campaign performance, digital behavior, funnel performance and customer feedback
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and self-service analytics solutions
Combine information from different data sources and transform complex datasets into clear business stories, implications and recommendations
Act as Global Marketing’s main interface to the central data and data science organization for advanced analytics and cross-functional projects
Support test-and-learn initiatives, A/B testing and experimental approaches
Manage recurring and ad hoc analytics requests while helping stakeholders prioritize the topics with the greatest business impact




What You Bring




A degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, marketing analytics or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or digital analytics
Strong experience working with large and complex datasets and translating them into actionable insights for business stakeholders
Hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL and Excel; knowledge of Python or R is an advantage
A good understanding of KPI frameworks, data visualization and applied business analytics
A self-starting, structured and independent working style, combined with strong stakeholder-management skills
Fluency in English; German is an advantage.




Why join us




This is a unique opportunity to become the analytics subject-matter expert embedded directly within Global Marketing.
You will have the freedom to build the analytics capability, establish effective ways of working and create your own path within an international marketing organization.




As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Title: Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization (m/f/x)
Description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization, to join our Data Science & Analytics team as a strategic partner and technical expert. In this role, you will steer our pricing strategy and commercial analytics function, translating complex data into actionable business insights that directly impact revenue and profitability.

You will work collaboratively on high-impact projects and partner with senior leadership to shape data-driven commercial decisions across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:


Take ownership of the pricing tool used by the commercial department
Develop and optimize end-to-end pricing strategies, including algorithm development, implementation, and continuous performance monitoring
Design and execute complex pricing experiments and A/B tests, analyzing results and providing strategic recommendations to leadership
Build and maintain sophisticated pricing models and algorithms using advanced analytical techniques
Generate commercial insights by conducting deep-dive analyses on pricing elasticity, customer behavior, market dynamics, and competitive positioning
Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Product, Operations, and Finance to identify opportunities and solve complex business challenges
Create and automate reporting frameworks and dashboards to enable self-service analytics across the organization
Establish best practices for pricing analytics, experimentation, and commercial decision-making
Stay current with industry trends in pricing optimization, e-commerce analytics, and circular economy business models


Requirements:


Approximately 3 to 5 years of experience in commercial analytics, pricing, or related analytical roles, preferably in e-commerce or marketplace environments
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python/Kotlin, as well as other programming language, are a plus
Experience designing and executing A/B tests and experiments with measurable business impact
Solid statistical knowledge
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable business recommendations
Effective stakeholder management skills and comfort presenting to senior leadership
Strategic mindset with strong business acumen and commercial awareness
Motivated and organized, thriving in dynamic environments


Preferred:


Experience with pricing algorithms, dynamic pricing, or revenue management systems
Knowledge of causal inference methods and advanced experimental design
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
Experience in sustainability-focused or circular economy businesses
Understanding of marketplace or two-sided platform dynamics


Location:


Berlin
Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 2 days a week)

Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.
Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.
Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.
Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin).
Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave.
Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!
Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.
Have fun at our legendary team and company events.
Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo.
Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.
Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine.
Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment.
At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.
