Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Fraud Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

We are Flink - your online supermarket revolutionising the way you do your grocery shopping. With a wide selection of over 2,400 high-quality products, we aim to deliver to your door in minutes. We put our customers first and ensure all products delivered are fresh and nutritious. Additionally, we can customise our national assortment to be able to offer you unique local products in every city. Our delivery hubs are located in densely populated inner-city locations and we strive to be sustainable by delivering on electric bikes and using packaging that can be recycled.

Founded by experienced e-commerce professionals and seasoned entrepreneurs with exceptional track records, backed by some of the most renowned Global investors, we are growing rapidly and have a great hunger to continuously challenge ourselves. We pride ourselves in being an inclusive and equal opportunities employer with a diverse and multicultural team.

If you want to be part of this exciting journey… read on!

In your role as Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d) you will be critical in the continued success of our marketplace partnerships. With our ambitious growth targets set for 2027, our marketplace partnerships play a crucial role, and understanding performance to better forecast success will be a key part of this role.

Job Description


Performance Analysis: Drive the analysis of performance across all marketplaces. This is more than just analyzing data! It’s deriving the business impact and driving initiatives that solve the problems.
Troubleshoot and Resolve: Act as the first line of defense for any operational issues that arise. You'll separate the real problems from the noise, solve problems or route them to the right people internally or with the partner, until they're solved.
Automate and Innovate: Leverage your skills to build, maintain, and improve scripts and tools that automate repetitive operational tasks, such as catalog updates and hub availability checks, reducing manual effort and eliminating errors.
Collaborate Across a Global Stage: Work hand-in-hand with internal teams (Commercial, Tech, and Operations) and external marketplace partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and execute strategic projects.
Experimentation: Run commercial experiments aimed at measurable growth across the marketplaces from setup through to the read-out. You'll help size the opportunity, track the test, and make an honest call on whether it worked.


Qualifications


A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
Clear experience in Data Analysis: You work day-to-day with SQL and have strong experience in turning data analysis into actionable insights, demonstrable through initiatives you have led.
Proficiency with BI Tooling: You have a solid experience with tools such as PowerBI/Looker (2+ years), comfortable with turning requests into insightful insights
Automation track record: You have not just played around with automating processes, but have clear examples of taking manual inefficiencies and building clean, working automation with your AI tool of choice.
Excellent Communication: Full professional fluency in English (both written and verbal) is required to collaborate effectively with our international team and partners.
Ownership & Responsibility: You have clear examples of owning initiatives from the ideation phase through to delivery with an understanding of the business impact.


Additional Information

For this role as Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d), the starting remuneration is as follows:

The base pay for this position is 45,000 - 50,000 EUR gross for full time (40 hours per week).

In Addition, FLINK Offers The Following Benefits


A €1000 annual L&D budget as well as individual coaching options to ensure you have plenty of opportunities to learn, grow and achieve your goals
26 days of vacation, +1 day every year up to a maximum of 30 days
A mobility budget of 35 EUR per month for Deutschland Ticket subsidy
A discount on your Urban Sports Club membership
Attractive company pension options
Unlimited access to an e-learning and development platform, Prosus Academy, including online German courses
Online discounts with Corporate Benefits and Future Bens
A cool discount off your personal Flink orders; be the first to test out new products!
A modern and dog-friendly office in the heart of Berlin - lots of delicious lunch spots available within short walking distance


It is our commitment that every applicant will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion.

Title: Spezialist:in Analytics und Prozessmanagement
Description:
Die Deutsche Bahn ist nicht nur einer der wichtigsten Mobilitätsdienstleister, sondern auch eines der größten Ingenieurbüros Deutschlands. Um neue Brücken, Tunnel, Bahnhöfe, Gleise und Signalanlagen zu realisieren und instand zu halten, arbeiten aktuell mehr als 10.000 Ingenieure bei uns – längst nicht genug. Als Ingenieur:in bei der Deutschen Bahn kannst du dabei etwas planen, managen oder überwachen, das bleibt: die Infrastruktur für kommende Generationen.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Spezialist:in Analytics und Prozessmanagement (w/m/d) für die DB InfraGO AG am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:


Die Analyse und Bewertung von Technologien und Prozessen der Leit- und Sicherungstechnik (LST) übernimmst du unter technischen, betrieblichen und wirtschaftlichen Gesichtspunkten
Standards und Prozesse für bereichsübergreifende Projekte und Programme zur Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Leit- und Sicherungstechnik entwickelst und implementierst du
Du steuerst eigenständig Teilprojekte und behältst dabei Abhängigkeiten, Zieltermine sowie die Umsetzung relevanter Maßnahmen im Blick
Kennzahlensysteme, Reports und Dashboards zur Steuerung von Wirtschaftlichkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Zielerreichung konzipierst, entwickelst und optimierst du kontinuierlich weiter
Mithilfe moderner Analysetools wertest du Daten aus, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen für Technologien und Prozesse ab
Die Abstimmung mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern koordinierst du und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung eines datengetriebenen Analytics Hubs für die LST-Plattform



Dein Profil:


Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Verkehrswesen, Bahningenieurswesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Datenanalyse, Prozessmanagement, Projektmanagement oder Business Analytics zeichnet dich aus
Du verfügst über Erfahrung in der Analyse und Aufbereitung komplexer Daten sowie im Umgang mit Reporting- und Visualisierungstools wie Power BI oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen
Analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für betriebliche, technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge gehören zu deinen Stärken
Die strukturierte Entwicklung von Kennzahlen, Dashboards und datenbasierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen liegt dir und macht dir Spaß
Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder für datengetriebene Lösungen zu gewinnen, runden dein Profil ab



Das ist uns wichtig:

Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Benefits:


Wir unterstützen dich bei der Suche nach Kitaplätzen oder Ferienbetreuung für deine Kinder. Außerdem kannst du Auszeiten für die Pflege von Angehörigen oder Sabbaticals nehmen. Je nach Job ist eine flexible Gestaltung von Arbeitszeit/-ort möglich.
Wir bieten dir 16 Freifahrten innerhalb Deutschlands pro Jahr und weitere Fahrvergünstigungen wie z.B. DB Job-Ticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg. Darüber hinaus gibt es günstige Mitnahmemöglichkeiten für Familie und Freunde.
Bei uns können alle DB Mitarbeitenden günstig shoppen. Jeden Monat findest du auf dem DB Reisemarkt neue Angebote, wie z.B. Mobilfunkverträge, Versicherungen, Vergünstigungen bei Hotelketten, Mode und Lifestyle.



Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Title: (Associate) Consultant Business Intelligence & Data Analytics (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir bei Capgemini Invent glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven den Wandel vorantreiben. Als innovative Transformationsberater vereinen wir unsere strategischen, kreativen und wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten und arbeiten eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um zukunftsweisende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Hilf uns dabei, den Wandel voranzutreiben, der auf die Herausforderungen unserer Kunden von heute und morgen zugeschnitten ist. Informiert und validiert durch Wissenschaft und Daten. Verstärkt durch Kreativität und Design. Und das alles auf der Grundlage von Technologien.

Deine Rolle

Als (Associate) Consultant (m/w/d) im Bereich Business Intelligence & Data Analytics meisterst du spannende Projekte, stellst dich anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen und gestaltest die Transformation von Organisationen und Geschäftsmodellen bis hin zum Leitbild datengetriebener Unternehmen.


Du berätst nationale und internationale Klient:innen branchenübergreifend in der Entwicklung von nachhaltigen und innovativen Lösungen für eine Transformation unserer Kunden zu einer datengetriebene Unternehmenssteuerung
Du identifizierst und priorisierst Analytics Use Cases, analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in technische Spezifikationen für maßgeschneiderte Reporting-Lösungen für Geschäftsprozessen und der Interaktion mit (End-)Kund*innen
Du konzipierst und entwickelst Dashboards und Reports für datengetriebene Entscheidungen und quantitative Insights – von der Datenaufbereitung bis zur Visualisierung und anschließender Industrialisierung des Produkts
Du arbeitest eng mit Strategie-, Daten- und Technologieexperten in interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen
Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unseres datenfokussierten Offerings mit und bringst deine Perspektive in Kundenprojekte ein


Dein Profil


Du bringst erste praktische (agile) Projekterfahrung im Requirements Engineering und der Umsetzung von datengetriebenen Lösungen, z.B. Reportings, Analytics-Produkten oder KPI-Analysen
Du hast erste fundamentale Erfahrung in der Beratungsbranche gesammelt oder vergleichbare Aufgaben in anderen Kontexten mit Kunden bereits übernommen
Du hast einen exzellenten Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor/Master) mit wirtschaftlichem oder technischem Hintergrund (z.B. Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder verwandte Studiengänge) und/oder hast ggf. bereits als Business Analyst Erfahrung gesammelt
Du besitzt erste Kenntnisse von ETL-Prozessen (z.B. mit SQL) sowie Erfahrung mit mindestens einem BI-Tool (z.B. Power BI, Tableau, Qlik)
Du hast Spaß an der Kombination von technologischem Verständnis, strategischer Analyse und Implementierung, hast Freude an Verantwortung und kritischem Hinterfragen und Lust, die Transformation unserer Kunden zu begleiten
Du bist kommunikationsstark und überzeugst durch deinen Teamgeist, hohe Zuverlässigkeit sowie ein hohes Engagement und selbstbewusstes Auftreten
Du besitzt exzellente Deutsch- (mindestens C1) und Englischkenntnisse und zeigst Flexibilität sowie Reisebereitschaft


Was du bei uns schätzen wirst


Werde Teil einer international führenden Unternehmensberatung, die durch innovative und wegweisende Projekte, globale Teams und digitales Know-How die Zukunft gestaltet
Bekomme klare Perspektiven für deine Karriere und Freiraum für Eigeninitiative
Erhalte individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Erlebe unser kontinuierliches Engagement für Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und Inklusion
Profitiere von unseren Benefits zur optimalen Work-Life-Balance mit attraktiven Angeboten rund um Gesundheit & Wellbeing, Zusatzpaketen rund um Mobilität sowie modernen Offices


Über Capgemini

Capgemini ist ein globaler Business- und Technologie-Transformationspartner für Organisationen. Das Unternehmen unterstützt diese bei ihrer dualen Transformation für eine stärker digitale und nachhaltige Welt – stets auf greifbare Fortschritte für die Gesellschaft bedacht. Capgemini ist eine verantwortungsbewusste, diverse Unternehmensgruppe mit einer über 55-jährigen Geschichte und 340.000 Mitarbeitenden in mehr als 50 Ländern. Kunden vertrauen auf Capgemini, um das Potenzial von Technologie für die ganze Breite ihrer Geschäftsanforderungen zu erschließen. Capgemini entwickelt mit seiner starken Strategie, Design- und Engineering-Expertise umfassende Services und End-to-End-Lösungen. Dabei nutzt das Unternehmen seine führende Kompetenz in den Bereichen KI, generative KI, Cloud und Daten sowie profunde Branchenexpertise und sein Partner-Ökosystem. Die Gruppe erzielte 2024 einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.

Wir freuen uns über deine vollstän­dige Be­wer­bung ausschließlich über unser Bewerbungsportal und unter Angabe deiner Ge­halts­vor­stel­lung, des frühest­mög­lichen Ein­tritts­zeit­punkts sowie deiner Standortpräferenz.

Die ausgeschriebene Vakanz ist ganzjährig zu besetzen.

Hier findest du weitere Informationen zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess.

Title: Consultant Data Analytics ERP Migrations (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Title: Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen
Description:
Über uns

Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Sie bietet Biotech-, Pharma- und Medizinprodukteunternehmen Lösungen für den Market Access, Preisbildung und Erstattung ihrer medizinischen Innovationen. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Ihre Aufgaben


Konzeption, Durchführung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Analysen auf Basis von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Kohortendefinition bis zur Ergebnisaufarbeitung
Interpretation und Einordnung der Analyseergebnisse zur Generierung belastbarer Real World Evidence sowie deren Übersetzung in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden
Strategische Beratung von Market-Access-, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen führender Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Fachliche Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung von Analysen in interdisziplinären Projekten sowie Anleitung weniger erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) sowie Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung der Befunde aus Abrechnungsdaten
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, für Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ-Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen, z. B. in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen


Ihre Qualifikation


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Versorgungsforschung, Public Health, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Epidemiologie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – im industriellen oder akademischen Umfeld

Title: eCommerce Growth Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an eCommerce Growth Analyst to join our eCommerce Solutions team to lead data analytics and real-time tracking, ensuring the quality and stability of our rapidly growing white-label solution.




What you will do:

Performance Optimisation & Analytics: lead site performance optimisation through advanced analytics tools and data-driven insights.
Monitoring & Growth Analysis: monitor key metrics such as traffic, user behaviour, and conversion rates to identify growth opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Analytics Tools & Tracking: leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and heatmaps to track, measure, and analyse website performance.
A/B Testing & CRO: implement A/B testing and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) strategies to improve user engagement and conversion performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: collaborate closely with marketing, UX, and development teams to enhance user experience and overall site effectiveness.
Tag Management & Data Accuracy: ensure accurate website tracking, including the setup and management of tags in Google Tag Manager for reliable data collection.




Workplace: Germany & Remote // Berlin & Hybrid

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.




Who you are:

Experience & Background: 4+ years of experience in growth, product optimisation, or similar roles within B2C e-commerce or consumer digital products.
Conversion Optimisation & Experimentation: strong hands-on experience improving website and app conversion funnels through experimentation, user behaviour analysis, and data-driven decision making.
Analytics & Tools: strong hands-on experience with tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, SQL, Grafana, Hotjar, and A/B testing platforms like AB Tasty, Maxymizer, or Optimizely.
Ownership & Problem Solving: strong ownership mindset with the ability to proactively investigate root causes and drive solutions when metrics or user behaviour change unexpectedly.
Customer & Product Mindset: customer-focused and curious about user behaviour, with the ability to identify friction points and opportunities to improve conversion and overall experience.
Analytical Thinking: ability to turn complex business problems into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable product improvements.
Collaboration & Ways of Working: comfortable working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, and commercial teams.
Communication Skills: clear communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability & Impact: thrives in fast-moving environments, adapts quickly to ambiguity, and is motivated by driving measurable business impact.




What you can expect:

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company




Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Benedetta, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Francesc Ferre.




For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
Description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Our Vision

To be the strategic engine room of Raisin’s People & Culture team—building the secure, data-driven, and innovative infrastructure that empowers our people and scales the organization.

Our Mission

We bridge the gap between people strategy and the technology that powers it. We ensure Raisin is future-ready, fair, and fully compliant by focusing on four core pillars:


People Systems: We manage and evolve our HRIS landscape so P&C can focus on people, not manual processes.
People Analytics: We leverage people analytics and AI automation to guide smarter business decisions, driving equity through modern Total Rewards frameworks.
People Governance: We act as P&C’s compliance anchor—taking ownership of audit requests, people policy and process transformation, and risk management (TPRM) to keep our infrastructure secure.


Your Responsibilities


We are looking for a People Analytics Manager to own the data, reporting, and insights of Raisin’s People function.
You will ensure smooth operations of our HR reporting systems and be the main point of contact for data-driven insights and analytics requests within our People tooling stack.
You will build and maintain Raisin’s People dashboards and reports to meet the business needs based on the requirements of the People business functions and in close alignment with the People Solutions leadership.
You will look after the data modeling, trend analysis, and predictive analytics related to our workforce.
You will support seamless integrations of People data pipelines in close alignment with People and Culture leadership and other stakeholders.
You will own the documentation of HR metrics, data definitions, and reporting structures across Raisin’s People applications.


Your Profile


You hold a university degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or bring equivalent experience with a strong analytical background.
You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in People Analytics, Business Intelligence, or data analysis.
You are able to translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable insights for business leaders.
You have strong People domain knowledge incl. People processes across the employee lifecycle.
You are highly responsible, trustworthy, and adept at handling sensitive and confidential data with the utmost discretion.
You have strong communication skills and you feel comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in English.
Experience with our tooling stack (especially with data visualization tools like Looker Studio and HRIS like Personio) is a plus.


Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:


Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.


Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Title: Data Engineer / ETL-Developer / Business Analyst m/w/d - remote - deutschlandweit
Description:
Über uns:


23DATA – ein cooles, dezentrales Team voller Datenversteher:innen und Zahlenzauberer! Bei uns trifft Remote-Arbeit auf echten Teamgeist, spannende BI-Projekte auf spaßige Social Weeks und knallharte Analysen auf jede Menge Humor. Regelmäßige Treffen in coolen Offices an wechselnden Orten in Deutschland sorgen dafür, dass wir uns nicht nur digital, sondern auch persönlich an einem Strang ziehen. Du möchtest als Data Engineer / ETL-Developer / Business Analyst bei uns einsteigen?


Deine Mission bei uns:

Zahlen, Daten, Fakten – du bringst Struktur in komplexe Projekte v.a. im Finanzdienstleistungssektor

Datenintegration & Aufbau starker ETL-Strecken (Deine Pipelines laufen wie geschmiert!)

Du arbeitest gerne mit modernen Data Engineering Technologien und hast Lust, Ab Initio und/oder Databricks zu deinem Steckenpferd zu machen

Erstellung von Dashboards und Reports (Langweilig war gestern – deine Visualisierungen haben Style!)

Du checkst die Anforderungen von Prozessen und übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen (wir machen Programmiersprachen zu deinen besten Freunden!)

Zusammenarbeit im Team an innovativen BI-Projekten

Datenanalyse & Modellierung (du erkennst Trends, bevor sie cool sind)

Du unterstützt unsere Seniors mit Kopf, Herz und Bock, Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen. Und wenn du willst, heben wir dich auch auf die Karriereleiter!




Voraussetzungen


Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau für Projektarbeit und Kommunikation zwingend erforderlich

Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau ebenfalls vorausgesetzt

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar (Master of Data Disaster Prevention)

Erste Erfahrung oder mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Data Engineering oder Data Analytics sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in Databricks und modernen Cloud-Datenplattformen

Für nahezu jedes Problem in deinem Leben kennst du das passende Tool

Scrum, Kanban und Wasserfall sind für dich keine fancy klingenden Reiseziele, sondern wunderbare Möglichkeiten, dein Leben (oder zumindest deine Arbeit) selbstständig zu strukturieren

Kommunikationsfreude, Humor und Teamspirit (mach dich gefasst, beim Lasertag fertig gemacht zu werden!)

Großes Plus: Bock auf Eigenverantwortung und Lust, um die Ecke zu denken! Keine Nuss ist dir zu hart. Und keine Sorge - du bist nie allein




Vorteile


30 Tage Urlaub

Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten (remote) innerhalb Deutschlands zur flexibleren Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags und Privatlebens sowie eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance

Zuschuss zum Mobilitätsticket im ÖPNV (Deutschlandticket)

Gesundheitsförderung durch Kooperation mit Fitness-Netzwerken (Wellpass)

Dienstrad Leasing Optionen

Regelmäßige Company Events (Social Weeks, Sommer- und Winterworkshops) für Treffen, Weiterentwicklung und Spaß innerhalb des 23DATA Teams

Ein umfassendes Onboarding Programm, welches Deinen Einstieg bei uns erleichtert, sowie ein Buddy, der Dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht

Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Wegen zu Leads und Partnern zur Unterstützung deiner Ideen

Regelmäßiges Feedback zur individuellen Entwicklung und Karriereplanung

Modernste Hardware und Diensthandy nach deinen Wünschen


Bereit, Datenheld:in bei 23DATA zu werden?




Recruiting Prozess





Unser Anspruch ist es, einen effizienten Recruitingprozess auf Augenhöhe zu gewährleisten, bei dem beiden Parteien die Eignung für die ausgeschriebene Vakanz beurteilen können. Der Prozess startet mit einem ersten telefonischen Kennenlernen von 30. Minuten. Sollten sich beide Parteien auf eine Fortführung einigen, folgt ein Fachinterview. Wenn alle Gespräche positiv verlaufen, rundet ein Gespräch mit einem Mitglied unseres Managementteams den Auswahlprozess ab.





Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?





Hast du Lust, eins der führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Datenanalyse, Datenintegration und datengetriebene Entscheidungen hautnah bei relevanten Projekten im deutschsprachigen Raum zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig deine Karriere weiter voranzutreiben? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
We're looking for


you as a Senior Analytics Engineer, to make an important contribution to climate neutrality together with us at thermondo. With your interest in renewable energies and your identification with our values, We do what we say, Better everyday, Stronger together, you will create real added value for us all.


As a certified professional with at least 5 years of experience in the field, you are passionate about transforming data into strategic insights and driving impactful business decisions. At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this


Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).


And recognise yourself here


Bringing at least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role within a tech company
Demonstrating advanced skills in Python, SQL, and data modeling.
Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.


What We Have To Offer


Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.
We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world will become for future generations
A corporate culture that brings people from all walks of life together - regardless of gender, origin, age, or background.
A modern office in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg with a roof terrace, where dogs are also welcome.
Work flexibly from the mobile office - up to 3 days a week.
Monthly company events such as Lunch & Learn and Drinks & Action.
Further your education! Regular opportunities for training and further education from our own Learning & Development team or external coaches.
A contribution to the company pension scheme.
Your well-being is important to us, which is why we invest in your physical and mental health and offer you 30 days of vacation, a permanent employment contract, and numerous other benefits via Corporate Benefits, as well as a discounted Urban Sports membership and access to nilo.health, a platform for mental health care.
Get around the city in a climate-friendly way with your JobRad.


About Us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. Today, our proprietary software enables 800 thermondinos to scale the heating transition in Germany. But we want more. We want to enable a fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer-facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management.

Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments.

Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate-neutral living.

Your application process


An initial interview with your Talent Acquisition Manager, Svetlana
If we are both on the positive side, you will talk with Dominique, our VP Commercial Product & Data
The next step is to meet with your to-be teammates
Finally, Become a thermondino!


Here we go

Is this exactly the challenge you are looking for? Then don't wait any longer and apply to us. We look forward to getting to know you!

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
As Marketing Analyst, you will own the full marketing intelligence cycle across all 14 of our markets, from reliable web tracking and clean data collection to decision-driven dashboards, incrementality measurement, and the steering logic our growth teams rely on. Based in Berlin, you will be the person who ensures marketing decisions are grounded in accurate data, and you will help answer where the next Euro of media spend should go to maximise revenue, margin, and efficiency. This is a role with genuine scope to build the marketing analytics function and grow into senior analytics leadership as PERGOLUX expands.

PERGOLUX designs and delivers premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees and roughly €200M in revenue, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, and our marketing team combines performance marketing with rigorous data work.

What You'll Do


Own marketing tracking quality and measurement reliability across all markets, setting up and auditing GTM, GA4, ad platform pixels, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, and event taxonomy for clean, GDPR-compliant data across Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliates, and CRM.
Design, build, and automate dashboards in tools such as Looker and AI-assisted reporting workflows that explain what is happening, why, and what action to take, and own the metric definitions that make them the single source of truth.
Design and run structured incrementality tests, including geo-lift tests, holdout tests, and pre/post analyses, to measure the true marginal impact of media spend, promotions, channels, and campaigns.
Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead and Head of Marketing to define budget allocation frameworks across Google, Meta, SEO, affiliates, and email, and translate data on traffic, cohorts, funnels, and creative performance into clear growth recommendations for country managers and leadership.
Set analytics standards, documentation, and best practices, support and improve our MCP and data connector ecosystem, and challenge misleading metrics so decisions rest on sound data.


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Web Analytics, or Growth Analytics, ideally within D2C e-commerce, with hands-on knowledge of GTM, GA4, e-commerce data layers, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs, and conversion APIs.
High proficiency in SQL and experience working with cloud data warehouses and multiple marketing, CRM, and e-commerce data sources.
Solid understanding of attribution, incrementality, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and payback.
A strong statistical mindset with practical experience designing A/B tests, geo-lift tests, holdout tests, or conversion lift studies, and the communication skills to turn analytical topics into clear guidance for marketing and leadership.
Bonus: experience with AI-assisted analytics, API connectors, automated reporting, or marketing data infrastructure.


What We Offer

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary


Company pension plan
Capped overtime, fully paid


🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work with an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27


One week per year of remote workation in the EU/UK


🌟 Benefits And Lifestyle


Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)
Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products
Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting
Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats


📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin (easily accessible by public transport)

How To Apply

Ready to build the analytics backbone of a growing premium e-commerce brand? Apply through our Career Page or reach out via LinkedIn. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

Deine Rolle

Möchtest du deine Leidenschaft für Datenvisualisierung in einem dynamischen Team einbringen und innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln? Wir suchen einen Senior Consultant (w/m/d) Decision Intelligence, der unser Team mit fachlicher Expertise und Engagement bereichert. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit sowie in Teilzeit zu besetzen.


Du leitest und realisierst End-to-End Data-&-Analytics-Projekte – von der Datenintegration bis zur Visualisierung und Entscheidungsunterstützung
Du entwickelst und optimierst moderne Analytics- und BI-Lösungen (z. B. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake) inkl. Datenaufbereitung (SQL, Python) und Visualisierung (Power BI, Tableau)

Title: Celonis Process Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Proxius. Ein dynamisches Start-up mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Process Intelligence! Unsere Mission: Komplexe Prozesse transparent machen, Potenziale aufdecken und mit Automatisierung und KI echte Verbesserungen schaffen.




Wir arbeiten vor allem mit großen Kunden aus der Telekommunikations- und Energiewirtschaft, deutschlandweit sowie international. Vielleicht kennt man uns außerhalb der Process-Mining-Bubble noch nicht, unsere Kunden aber ziemlich sicher. Proxius ist Celonis Platinum Partner und gehört damit zu den führenden spezialisierten Beratungen in diesem Bereich.




Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort Consultants (m/w/d) für Process Intelligence & Celonis, die Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns richtig durchzustarten.




Aufgaben




Bei uns bist du nicht einfach ein technischer Umsetzer. Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse wirklich funktionieren, wo Potenziale liegen und wie wir sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden heben können.




Dafür arbeitest du mit Daten, entwickelst Analysen und Lösungen und bringst Automatisierung und KI dort ins Spiel, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.




Process Intelligence & Consulting




Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an Celonis- und Process-Intelligence-Projekten von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung.
Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wirst mit wachsender Erfahrung zum Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Prozesse unserer Kunden und wirst zum Spezialisten für deine Themen und Branchen.




Data, Automation & AI




Du entwickelst Dashboards, Analysen, Automatisierungs-Flows und AI Solutions, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern tatsächlich etwas verändern.
Du entwickelst und optimierst Datenmodelle und Datenanbindungen (ETL) und sorgst dafür, dass aus Rohdaten nutzbares Prozesswissen wird.
Du beschäftigst dich mit der Frage, wie wir Prozesswissen mit Automatisierung und KI verbinden können und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungen.




Proxius weiterentwickeln




Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Standards und Produkte auf der Celonis-Plattform, die wir international einsetzen und vertreiben können.
Du bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir Projekte umsetzen, Lösungen entwickeln und als Unternehmen besser werden.




Profil




Wir suchen einen Charakter!

Natürlich brauchen wir für den Job bestimmte fachliche Skills. Mindestens genauso wichtig ist uns aber, wie du an Dinge herangehst.




Du willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert oder eben nicht. Du kannst dich in Daten und Prozesse verbeißen, verlierst dabei aber nicht aus den Augen, welches Problem wir eigentlich lösen wollen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast den Anspruch, Dinge wirklich gut zu machen.




Und: Du arbeitest gerne mit Kunden. Das bedeutet für uns nicht, jede Anforderung einfach umzusetzen. Wir suchen Menschen, die mitdenken, gute Fragen stellen und auch mal sagen: „Ich glaube, wir sollten das anders machen.“




Ein paar klassische Traits und Skills solltest du natürlich trotzdem mitbringen:




Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder BWL oder einen anderen Hintergrund, mit dem du uns überzeugst.
Du bringst Erfahrung mit SQL, BI, Datenbanken oder Datenmodellen mit und fühlst dich im Umgang mit Daten wohl.
Du hast mindestens erste Berufserfahrung im Data-, Process-, Automation- oder Consulting-Umfeld gesammelt.
Erfahrung mit Celonis ist natürlich ein großes Plus. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du Daten und Prozesse verstehst und Lust hast, dich tief in Process Intelligence einzuarbeiten.
Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und trittst gegenüber Kunden professionell, verbindlich und kommunikativ auf.
Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, bist gleichzeitig aber ein echter Teamplayer.
Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sind für unsere Kundenprojekte ein Muss.




Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Wenn du fachlich stark bist, schnell lernst und richtig Lust auf Process Intelligence hast, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.




Wir bieten




Ein richtig cooles und erfahrenes Team, in dem du viel lernen kannst und gleichzeitig Raum für deine eigenen Ideen bekommst.
Viel Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, Proxius aktiv mitzugestalten, statt nur Teil eines großen Beratungsapparats zu sein.
Projekte bei großen, bekannten Unternehmen mit komplexen Prozessen und echtem Impact.
Flexibilität, wie und wo du arbeitest: remote oder gemeinsam im Büro in München, Berlin oder Köln.
Eine transparente und faire Vergütung: Consultant 55–65k €
Und für uns eigentlich selbstverständlich und nicht zu erwähnen (tun wir aber trotzdem ;) ): neuestes IT-Equipment mit iPhone und leistungsfähigem Laptop, Wellpass / Sachbezug, Fortbildungen und richtig gute Team-Events.




Warum Proxius?




Weil wir klein genug sind, dass deine Ideen und deine Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied machen und gleichzeitig an Projekten arbeiten, die alles andere als klein sind.

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer und musst dich nicht durch fünf Hierarchieebenen kämpfen, bevor du Verantwortung übernehmen darfst. Wenn du etwas gut kannst, bekommst du den Raum dafür. Wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, helfen wir dir dabei, es zu lernen.

Und wenn du eine gute Idee hast, wollen wir sie hören.

Title: Analyst | Competition Practice | Berlin
Description:
Who We Are

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About The Role

We pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one.

You will become an integral part of Compass Lexecon’s German-speaking team, with the crucial role of helping clients understand how competition works in their industry. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence.

You will be working on both domestic and international assignments in collaboration with our colleagues across Europe. You will also have the opportunity to influence and contribute to the growth of our German, Austrian and Swiss businesses.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics. You will be based in Compass Lexecon’s Berlin office.

Applications for this position will close on 31st March 2027.

Key Responsibilities


Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry
Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach
Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata
Drafting reports summarising analysis
Participating in client meetings and conference calls


Skills/profile Sought


Master’s degree in economics, ideally with focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics
Fluency in English required
Fluency in German desirable
Highly analytical
Excellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-task
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients
Accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Stata and Excel skills desirable


Benefits Of Working At Compass Lexecon


Competitive salary and benefits
A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects
An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience
A blend of professional and academic environments
The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics
A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team
Opportunities for training such as secondments, office rotations, internal seminars, and conferences
The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute from day one


When Drafting Your Application

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

Title: People Controlling and Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
Description:
A BOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.

At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 50+ different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, a payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.

Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

About The Team

Do you want your work to create a real impact? Join our team and help take data-driven decision-making in workforce management to the next level. In this role, you will connect people data with financial metrics and transform them into valuable insights, forecasts, and recommendations for our stakeholders.

You will work closely with Finance, People function, and other business functions to support strategic decisions related to workforce planning and efficiency improvement. With your analytical mindset and drive for continuous improvement, you will actively contribute to the development and optimization of processes, tools, and strategies. You can expect a dynamic, fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership, where your ideas matter, and you can help shape change.

What your work will look like:


Own the analysis of personnel cost and FTE variances, identifying drivers, risks, and opportunities, and translating findings into clear recommendations for action.
Lead workforce planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling, translating operational developments into financial impacts and strategic recommendations.
Support monthly and annual closing activities within the People function, ensuring methodological consistency and audit readiness.
Develop and optimize dashboards, models, and KPI frameworks relating to headcount, personnel costs, hiring, and ad hoc analyses, while driving standardization and automation.
Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and implement enhancements that increase speed, accuracy, and efficiency across analytics and controlling workflows.
Collaborate closely with Payroll, Accounting, Controlling and Analytics teams to ensure high data quality, consistent KPIs, and reliable reporting.



What you need to be successful in this role:


3-5 years experience in Controlling, Analytics and People Analytics, particularly in forecasting, variance analysis, KPI development, and scenario modeling.
Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, prioritize effectively in alignment with stakeholders, and solve complex challenges through a data-driven and AI-enabled approach.
Strong expertise with analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, BI tools, or spreadsheet solutions), along with a passion for continuously improving processes, models, and analyses through automation, standardization, and AI.
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights, impactful visualizations, and actionable recommendations for a variety of stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, and Management.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a genuine interest in shaping and improving processes, tools, and strategies at a departmental level.
High level of initiative, ownership, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
Fluency in English is required; German language skills are a strong advantage.



Please note that we will not sponsor your visa or relocation, and you must have a valid work permit to be eligible for this position.

What's next?


Does it sound exciting? - Apply with your CV in English or German. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.
We will get back to you within 14 days of receiving your application.
The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 60min conversation with two stakeholders and an approx. 45min Team interview. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.



What We Offer

More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍

At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team.

We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career.

🏡 Flexibility that works

Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week.

🚲 Your commute, your choice

Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.

🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU

Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year.

📗 Keep raising the bar

Use an annual learning budget of €1,000 for courses, conferences, certifications and other development opportunities that help you grow and increase your impact.

🫴 Support when you need it

Access confidential counselling whenever you need support with personal or professional matters.

💰 Build your future

Look ahead with our company pension scheme and take care of your long-term financial wellbeing.

Benefits may vary by location and employment setup. Your recruiter will share the details relevant to your role.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

Title: Retail Media Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Retail Media Campaign Analyst, you form the analytical and operational backbone of our local Retail Media team in Germany. Working closely with our Retail Media Managers, you own the data-driven planning, tracking, optimization, and evaluation of advertising campaigns for FMCG brands, restaurant partners, and advertisers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, you translate complex performance datasets into actionable insights, maximize campaign revenue, and prove the ROI of our partners with hard facts. Through high-quality performance reporting, you proactively surface upselling opportunities and support the team with compelling insights for both internal reviews and external client meetings. To excel in this role, you bring deep ad-tech understanding, outstanding analytical skills, and a strong collaborative mindset.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager Retail Media

Key Responsibilities Of The Role


Analytical support, performance monitoring, and continuous data-led optimization of Retail Media and digital advertising campaigns to consistently hit client KPIs
Serving as the primary analytical partner for our Retail Media Managers regarding campaign performance, custom reporting requests, and ad-tech topics
Generating actionable insights from campaign performance and market data to drive long-term partner success
Systematically evaluating performance data to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities that support Commercial Managers in their business reviews
Building, automating, and maintaining performance dashboards, while preparing and occasionally co-delivering performance presentations for key accounts
Conducting closed-loop and attribution analyses
Collaborating closely with central Ad Operations, Data, and Product teams to continuously improve local campaign reporting standards and analytics infrastructure


What You Bring To The Team


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field
Proven expertise in campaign analytics, reporting, and optimization across Retail Media, Search (SEA), Display Advertising, or related digital channels
Deep understanding of ad serving, DSP, SSP, and analytics platforms, as well as Programmatic Advertising and data-driven advertising solutions
Strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience querying and visualizing complex datasets (e.g., using SQL, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
Excellent organizational skills to efficiently prioritize and manage requests across multiple stakeholders (Retail Media Managers) and active campaigns
Operational agility, quick comprehension, and adaptability within a fast-paced, high-growth business environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, commercial stories for internal teams and clients
Native/fluent German skills and professional fluency in English (written and spoken)


Our Offer

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! Here is what awaits you with us:

💰 A competitive compensation package that recognizes your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.

📝 A permanent employment contract with hybrid working options: three days a week in our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and two days working from home – entirely at your convenience.

🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club membership – for your work-life balance and a fresh mind in your day-to-day routine.

🍽️ Additional perks: a monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workplace.

🏠 Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.

🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our varied communities and ERGs (Employee Resource Groups).

😎 Shared experiences: after-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement initiatives, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Lieferando. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people’s stories, blogs, podcasts and more Lieferando and Just Eat Takeaway.com morsels.
