Title: Fraud Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Marketing Business Analyst (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Marketing Business Analyst in the Reactivation Analytics team, you will join the wider Global Marketing Analytics group. You will act as a strategic consultant, using data to understand customer behaviour, their journey and more importantly what motivates them to return. Your experience in CRM Analytics, combined with a knack for storytelling through data, will directly influence the ability to reduce churn impact and optimize our channels along with marketing spend.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What You’ll Do


Support the Global Reactivations Marketing function: understand key business questions, translate them into analytical tasks, and deliver insights that inform strategic decision-making
Build and evolve reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day decision-making and enhance global performance oversight
Measure, benchmark, and monitor Global Reactivation performance, identifying trends and opportunities to improve key customer and business KPIs
Improve analytical processes by advocating for scalable, automated, and standardized solutions
Utilise various databases and querying/programming languages to access, manipulate and present the data needed
You will not only take responsibility of own projects, but also be a team player to collaborate and share knowledge with other analysts


What You’ll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and enthusiasm for solving business problems with data
3+ years of experience in customer Engagement/ Retention metrics and how they contribute to overall business performance
A structured, results-oriented approach with the ability to break down broad questions into clear analytical steps of experience in Customer Analytics, Marketing Analytics, A/B testing or in a quantitative field—ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business
Experience in leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to increase personal and team productivity in day-to-day analytical work
Expertise in technical skills, including:
SQL and Spreadsheets (required), Tableau or a similar visualisation tool (e.g. Looker, PowerBI), Python (a plus)
Experience in testing (AB testing, campaign analytics, channel efficiency )
Experience in statistical modeling, regression, clustering, time series etc is good to have
Experience in performing analysis with large datasets and knowing what the common pitfalls are
Analytical and critical thinking combined with good presentation and communication skills
Strong problems solving skills and hands-on & can-do attitude
Ability to work independently


What We Offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing


You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.


Health & Wellbeing

Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Du hast deinen Masterabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bald) abgeschlossen.
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung z. B. durch Praktika, Uni-Projekte oder Selbststudium mit Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und -visualisierung und verfügst über solide Kenntnisse in Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps und idealerweise Python.
Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, Tools auszuprobieren und kreative Lösungen zu finden.
Du bringst Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echten Teamgeist mit.
Du beherrschst die Sprache Deutsch auf dem Level C2 und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.   Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Title: Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization (m/f/x)
Description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Analyst, Pricing & Revenue Optimization, to join our Data Science & Analytics team as a strategic partner and technical expert. In this role, you will steer our pricing strategy and commercial analytics function, translating complex data into actionable business insights that directly impact revenue and profitability.

You will work collaboratively on high-impact projects and partner with senior leadership to shape data-driven commercial decisions across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:


Take ownership of the pricing tool used by the commercial department
Develop and optimize end-to-end pricing strategies, including algorithm development, implementation, and continuous performance monitoring
Design and execute complex pricing experiments and A/B tests, analyzing results and providing strategic recommendations to leadership
Build and maintain sophisticated pricing models and algorithms using advanced analytical techniques
Generate commercial insights by conducting deep-dive analyses on pricing elasticity, customer behavior, market dynamics, and competitive positioning

Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Growth Analyst, User Acquisition
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business, from the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events and best-selling console games. We also own the world's largest streaming guide, giving us unique insights into audience behaviours and content tastes.

From a small startup, we've evolved into a team of more than 200 people, based in Berlin, around the world or working remotely. We've built a profitable business while continuing to grow.




Who we need

We are looking for a Senior Growth Analyst with at least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics. You will support growth across JustWatch TV and our streaming guide, with the main focus on JustWatch TV.

You will partner with our marketing, campaign, product and Business Intelligence teams to understand which acquisition activity brings valuable users, improve confidence in measurement and testing, and turn findings into budget and campaign decisions.




What you will be doing

Analyse user acquisition performance across channels, markets and audiences, and recommend where to scale, adjust or stop spending.
Develop our attribution approach and interpret MMP and ad platform reporting. Work with BI and technical teams to define conversion events, validate tracking and resolve data discrepancies. You will lead analytical requirements and validation; technical teams own implementation.
Analyse acquisition cohorts, activation, retention, subscription conversion and revenue alongside LTV, CAC, ROAS and payback periods. Make assumptions explicit and use findings to guide acquisition and bidding targets.
Design and evaluate A/B tests, holdouts and incrementality tests with the marketing team. Distinguish attributed conversions from incremental impact and turn findings into practical recommendations.
Build benchmarks, forecasts, dashboards and efficient reporting to guide planning, budgets and growth targets, working with BI to keep KPI definitions consistent and data reliable.
Support selected client campaign analyses and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, prioritising work that improves decisions and performance.




What we need from you




Essential experience

At least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics, ideally in an app, subscription or digital consumer business.
A strong understanding of mobile analytics, including attribution, conversion events, measurement limitations and discrepancies between data sources.
An understanding of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, TikTok and Google, their optimisation goals and performance metrics.
Experience analysing acquisition funnels, retention cohorts and unit economics to assess user value beyond installs or initial conversions.
Confident working with spreadsheets, BI tools and data from multiple sources.
The ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions constructively and prioritise independently.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Useful extras

Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, holdouts or incrementality tests.
SQL or Python.
Experience with CTV app measurement, ASO or CRM and lifecycle analytics.
German language skills.




What we offer you

An open-minded, international team that enjoys collaborating to reach shared goals.
Meaningful work, opportunities for personal growth and the chance to make a lasting impact.
A permission-less environment where you can take ownership and focus on delivering value without unnecessary complexity.
Trust in your expertise and judgement, with room to improve how we work and bring new ideas.
A collaborative and supportive environment that helps you achieve your personal and professional goals.
A flexible hybrid working environment, with no requirement to come to the office.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Title: Data Engineer / ETL-Developer / Business Analyst m/w/d - remote - deutschlandweit
Description:
Über uns:


23DATA – ein cooles, dezentrales Team voller Datenversteher:innen und Zahlenzauberer! Bei uns trifft Remote-Arbeit auf echten Teamgeist, spannende BI-Projekte auf spaßige Social Weeks und knallharte Analysen auf jede Menge Humor. Regelmäßige Treffen in coolen Offices an wechselnden Orten in Deutschland sorgen dafür, dass wir uns nicht nur digital, sondern auch persönlich an einem Strang ziehen. Du möchtest als Data Engineer / ETL-Developer / Business Analyst bei uns einsteigen?


Deine Mission bei uns:

Zahlen, Daten, Fakten – du bringst Struktur in komplexe Projekte v.a. im Finanzdienstleistungssektor

Datenintegration & Aufbau starker ETL-Strecken (Deine Pipelines laufen wie geschmiert!)

Du arbeitest gerne mit modernen Data Engineering Technologien und hast Lust, Ab Initio und/oder Databricks zu deinem Steckenpferd zu machen

Erstellung von Dashboards und Reports (Langweilig war gestern – deine Visualisierungen haben Style!)

Du checkst die Anforderungen von Prozessen und übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen (wir machen Programmiersprachen zu deinen besten Freunden!)

Zusammenarbeit im Team an innovativen BI-Projekten

Datenanalyse & Modellierung (du erkennst Trends, bevor sie cool sind)

Du unterstützt unsere Seniors mit Kopf, Herz und Bock, Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen. Und wenn du willst, heben wir dich auch auf die Karriereleiter!




Voraussetzungen


Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau für Projektarbeit und Kommunikation zwingend erforderlich

Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau ebenfalls vorausgesetzt

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar (Master of Data Disaster Prevention)

Erste Erfahrung oder mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Data Engineering oder Data Analytics sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in Databricks und modernen Cloud-Datenplattformen

Für nahezu jedes Problem in deinem Leben kennst du das passende Tool

Scrum, Kanban und Wasserfall sind für dich keine fancy klingenden Reiseziele, sondern wunderbare Möglichkeiten, dein Leben (oder zumindest deine Arbeit) selbstständig zu strukturieren

Kommunikationsfreude, Humor und Teamspirit (mach dich gefasst, beim Lasertag fertig gemacht zu werden!)

Großes Plus: Bock auf Eigenverantwortung und Lust, um die Ecke zu denken! Keine Nuss ist dir zu hart. Und keine Sorge - du bist nie allein




Vorteile


30 Tage Urlaub

Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten (remote) innerhalb Deutschlands zur flexibleren Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags und Privatlebens sowie eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance

Zuschuss zum Mobilitätsticket im ÖPNV (Deutschlandticket)

Gesundheitsförderung durch Kooperation mit Fitness-Netzwerken (Wellpass)

Dienstrad Leasing Optionen

Regelmäßige Company Events (Social Weeks, Sommer- und Winterworkshops) für Treffen, Weiterentwicklung und Spaß innerhalb des 23DATA Teams

Ein umfassendes Onboarding Programm, welches Deinen Einstieg bei uns erleichtert, sowie ein Buddy, der Dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht

Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Wegen zu Leads und Partnern zur Unterstützung deiner Ideen

Regelmäßiges Feedback zur individuellen Entwicklung und Karriereplanung

Modernste Hardware und Diensthandy nach deinen Wünschen


Bereit, Datenheld:in bei 23DATA zu werden?




Recruiting Prozess





Unser Anspruch ist es, einen effizienten Recruitingprozess auf Augenhöhe zu gewährleisten, bei dem beiden Parteien die Eignung für die ausgeschriebene Vakanz beurteilen können. Der Prozess startet mit einem ersten telefonischen Kennenlernen von 30. Minuten. Sollten sich beide Parteien auf eine Fortführung einigen, folgt ein Fachinterview. Wenn alle Gespräche positiv verlaufen, rundet ein Gespräch mit einem Mitglied unseres Managementteams den Auswahlprozess ab.





Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?





Hast du Lust, eins der führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Datenanalyse, Datenintegration und datengetriebene Entscheidungen hautnah bei relevanten Projekten im deutschsprachigen Raum zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig deine Karriere weiter voranzutreiben? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!





Ansprechpartner: Daniel Wajngarten - careers@23data.de




Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung ausschließlich über diese Plattform ein.
Bewerbungen, die per E-Mail eingehen, werden im Auswahlprozess NICHT berücksichtigt.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Title: Senior Consultant Decision Intelligence (w/m/d)
Description:
Wenn du dich für Capgemini entscheidest, wählst du ein Unternehmen, in dem du die Möglichkeit hast, deinen Karriereweg selbst zu gestalten. Du wirst von einem kollaborativen Netzwerk von Kolleg*innen auf der ganzen Welt unterstützt und inspiriert und kannst neu definieren, was möglich ist. Schließe dich uns an und unterstütze die führenden Organisationen der Welt, den Wert von Technologie zu erschließen und eine nachhaltigere, inklusivere Welt zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle

Möchtest du deine Leidenschaft für Datenvisualisierung in einem dynamischen Team einbringen und innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden entwickeln? Wir suchen einen Senior Consultant (w/m/d) Decision Intelligence, der unser Team mit fachlicher Expertise und Engagement bereichert. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in modernen Visualisierungstools und hast Freude daran, komplexe Daten in verständliche und aussagekräftige Visualisierungen zu überführen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit sowie in Teilzeit zu besetzen.


Du leitest und realisierst End-to-End Data-&-Analytics-Projekte – von der Datenintegration bis zur Visualisierung und Entscheidungsunterstützung
Du entwickelst und optimierst moderne Analytics- und BI-Lösungen (z. B. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake) inkl. Datenaufbereitung (SQL, Python) und Visualisierung (Power BI, Tableau)
Du konzipierst und implementierst Decision-Intelligence-Use-Cases zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen
Du integrierst, bereitest auf und sicherst die Qualität von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen unter Berücksichtigung von Governance-Anforderungen
Du evaluierst neue Technologien (z. B. Generative AI, Real-Time Analytics) und coachst Junior Consultants, während du hohe Qualitätsstandards sicherstellst


Dein Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium (z.B. Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in Data Analytics, BI oder Data Engineering
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI (oder vergleichbaren Tools) sowie Erfahrung mit SQL und Python
Erfahrung mit modernen Datenplattformen (z.B. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake) sowie fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung und Datenarchitekturen
Erfahrung in der Umsetzung komplexer Use Cases im Kundenumfeld sowie Interesse an Decision Intelligence, Advanced Analytics oder Generative AI
Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten, sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse entsprechend den Projektanforderungen und projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft


Was du bei uns schätzen wirst

Wir legen großen Wert auf die Vereinbarkeit von Arbeit und Privatleben. Deshalb hast du bei uns die Möglichkeit, hybrid aus dem Office, von zu Hause oder an anderen Capgemini Standorten in Deutschland zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig bietet Capgemini dir flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung: Unser Karrieremodell ermöglicht es dir, deine Karriere so zu lenken, wie es für dich am besten ist und unsere Leadership Programme unterstützen dich dabei. Mit zahlreichen Angeboten auf unserer Lernplattform hast du zudem jederzeit die Möglichkeit, deine Skills auszubauen oder dir neue anzueignen.

Unsere Communitys: Wir bieten dir aktive Mitarbeiternetzwerke, in denen du dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich mit Kolleg*innen aus aller Welt austauschen kannst. Zudem fördern unsere Communitys Vielfalt, Diversität und Inklusion am Arbeitsplatz.

Deine Benefits


Flexible Arbeitszeit- und Auszeitmodelle
Mobiles Arbeiten – auch hybrid von Zuhause aus
Jobfahrrad-Programm
Mobilitätsbudget
Vielfältiges Weiterbildungsangebot
Internationales Netzwerk
Kooperation mit dem pme Familienservice
Deferred Compensation – im Alter gut abgesichert
Verlängerte Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall
Gesundheitsangebote
Attraktiver Arbeitsplatz für Menschen mit Handicap
Kontakthalteprogramm fareWelcome!
Work-life-balance
Mitarbeiterrabatte
Team- und Sportevents

Title: Celonis Process Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
Description:
Wir sind Proxius. Ein dynamisches Start-up mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Process Intelligence! Unsere Mission: Komplexe Prozesse transparent machen, Potenziale aufdecken und mit Automatisierung und KI echte Verbesserungen schaffen.




Wir arbeiten vor allem mit großen Kunden aus der Telekommunikations- und Energiewirtschaft, deutschlandweit sowie international. Vielleicht kennt man uns außerhalb der Process-Mining-Bubble noch nicht, unsere Kunden aber ziemlich sicher. Proxius ist Celonis Platinum Partner und gehört damit zu den führenden spezialisierten Beratungen in diesem Bereich.




Für unser Team suchen wir ab sofort Consultants (m/w/d) für Process Intelligence & Celonis, die Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns richtig durchzustarten.




Aufgaben




Bei uns bist du nicht einfach ein technischer Umsetzer. Du willst verstehen, wie Prozesse wirklich funktionieren, wo Potenziale liegen und wie wir sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden heben können.




Dafür arbeitest du mit Daten, entwickelst Analysen und Lösungen und bringst Automatisierung und KI dort ins Spiel, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.




Process Intelligence & Consulting




Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden an Celonis- und Process-Intelligence-Projekten von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Lösung.
Du analysierst Prozesse und Daten, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und wirst mit wachsender Erfahrung zum Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden.
Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Prozesse unserer Kunden und wirst zum Spezialisten für deine Themen und Branchen.




Data, Automation & AI




Du entwickelst Dashboards, Analysen, Automatisierungs-Flows und AI Solutions, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern tatsächlich etwas verändern.
Du entwickelst und optimierst Datenmodelle und Datenanbindungen (ETL) und sorgst dafür, dass aus Rohdaten nutzbares Prozesswissen wird.
Du beschäftigst dich mit der Frage, wie wir Prozesswissen mit Automatisierung und KI verbinden können und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungen.




Proxius weiterentwickeln




Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Standards und Produkte auf der Celonis-Plattform, die wir international einsetzen und vertreiben können.
Du bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir Projekte umsetzen, Lösungen entwickeln und als Unternehmen besser werden.




Profil




Wir suchen einen Charakter!

Natürlich brauchen wir für den Job bestimmte fachliche Skills. Mindestens genauso wichtig ist uns aber, wie du an Dinge herangehst.




Du willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert oder eben nicht. Du kannst dich in Daten und Prozesse verbeißen, verlierst dabei aber nicht aus den Augen, welches Problem wir eigentlich lösen wollen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast den Anspruch, Dinge wirklich gut zu machen.




Und: Du arbeitest gerne mit Kunden. Das bedeutet für uns nicht, jede Anforderung einfach umzusetzen. Wir suchen Menschen, die mitdenken, gute Fragen stellen und auch mal sagen: „Ich glaube, wir sollten das anders machen.“




Ein paar klassische Traits und Skills solltest du natürlich trotzdem mitbringen:




Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder BWL oder einen anderen Hintergrund, mit dem du uns überzeugst.
Du bringst Erfahrung mit SQL, BI, Datenbanken oder Datenmodellen mit und fühlst dich im Umgang mit Daten wohl.
Du hast mindestens erste Berufserfahrung im Data-, Process-, Automation- oder Consulting-Umfeld gesammelt.
Erfahrung mit Celonis ist natürlich ein großes Plus. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du Daten und Prozesse verstehst und Lust hast, dich tief in Process Intelligence einzuarbeiten.
Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und trittst gegenüber Kunden professionell, verbindlich und kommunikativ auf.
Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, bist gleichzeitig aber ein echter Teamplayer.
Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sind für unsere Kundenprojekte ein Muss.




Du musst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Wenn du fachlich stark bist, schnell lernst und richtig Lust auf Process Intelligence hast, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.




Wir bieten




Ein richtig cooles und erfahrenes Team, in dem du viel lernen kannst und gleichzeitig Raum für deine eigenen Ideen bekommst.
Viel Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, Proxius aktiv mitzugestalten, statt nur Teil eines großen Beratungsapparats zu sein.
Projekte bei großen, bekannten Unternehmen mit komplexen Prozessen und echtem Impact.
Flexibilität, wie und wo du arbeitest: remote oder gemeinsam im Büro in München, Berlin oder Köln.
Eine transparente und faire Vergütung: Consultant 55–65k €
Und für uns eigentlich selbstverständlich und nicht zu erwähnen (tun wir aber trotzdem ;) ): neuestes IT-Equipment mit iPhone und leistungsfähigem Laptop, Wellpass / Sachbezug, Fortbildungen und richtig gute Team-Events.




Warum Proxius?




Weil wir klein genug sind, dass deine Ideen und deine Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied machen und gleichzeitig an Projekten arbeiten, die alles andere als klein sind.

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer und musst dich nicht durch fünf Hierarchieebenen kämpfen, bevor du Verantwortung übernehmen darfst. Wenn du etwas gut kannst, bekommst du den Raum dafür. Wenn du etwas noch nicht kannst, helfen wir dir dabei, es zu lernen.

Und wenn du eine gute Idee hast, wollen wir sie hören.

Title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
Description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren.

Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird.

Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich.

Das wirst du konkret tun:


Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung.
Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.
KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann.
Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen.
Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann.
Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen.


Dein Profil


Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt.
Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.
Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards.
Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen.
Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt.
Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum.
Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten.
Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Team.


Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. Zeig uns, wie du Daten genutzt hast, um dein Denken voranzubringen, und wo Experimente das beeinflusst haben, was du gebaut hast.

Was wir bieten


Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das mindestens zwei Bürotage mit Remote-Arbeit kombiniert.
Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir schaffen ein großartiges Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für die Gemeinschaft
Mitarbeit in einem fröhlichen und erfahrenen Team, das sich austauscht und voneinander lernt
Einblick in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der nebenan.de Stiftung
Verantwortung und große Möglichkeiten, dich aktiv einzubringen
Deine nebenan.de SpenditCard – pro Monat erhältst du ein zusätzliches Einkommen von 35 Euro, das du für Dinge deiner Wahl einsetzen kannst
30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr – außerdem bieten wir die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen sowie eines Sabbaticals


Über uns

nebenan.de ist Deutschlands größte Nachbarschaftsplattform. Das soziale Netzwerk wird von der Good Hood GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin betrieben. Über die kostenlose, lokale Plattform können sich Nachbar:innen unkompliziert helfen, zu Aktivitäten verabreden, Dinge teilen und verschenken. Als Sozialunternehmen ist es unser Ziel, Nachbar:innen wieder miteinander in Austausch zu bringen und so zu einer lebendigen, helfenden und sicheren Nachbarschaft beizutragen. nebenan.de steht nicht nur Privatpersonen offen, sondern auch lokalen Gewerben, gemeinnützigen Organisationen sowie Kommunen.

Vom demographischen Wandel über Einsamkeit bis hin zum nachhaltigen Umgang mit Ressourcen - wir wollen im Kleinen Antworten auf die großen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit finden. Hast du Lust, uns dabei zu unterstützen?

Dann schau dir jetzt unsere offenen Positionen an oder schick uns einfach eine Mail an jobs@nebenan.de um mehr zu erfahren. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Diversität ist Zusammenarbeit – bei nebenan.de freuen wir uns explizit über jede Diversitäts-Dimension, die unser Team bereichert. Wir leben Chancengleichheit und unterstützen sie.

  • Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben.   • Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.

Title: Marketing Analyst
Description:
As Marketing Analyst, you will own the full marketing intelligence cycle across all 14 of our markets, from reliable web tracking and clean data collection to decision-driven dashboards, incrementality measurement, and the steering logic our growth teams rely on. Based in Berlin, you will be the person who ensures marketing decisions are grounded in accurate data, and you will help answer where the next Euro of media spend should go to maximise revenue, margin, and efficiency. This is a role with genuine scope to build the marketing analytics function and grow into senior analytics leadership as PERGOLUX expands.

PERGOLUX designs and delivers premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees and roughly €200M in revenue, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, and our marketing team combines performance marketing with rigorous data work.

What You'll Do


Own marketing tracking quality and measurement reliability across all markets, setting up and auditing GTM, GA4, ad platform pixels, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, and event taxonomy for clean, GDPR-compliant data across Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliates, and CRM.
Design, build, and automate dashboards in tools such as Looker and AI-assisted reporting workflows that explain what is happening, why, and what action to take, and own the metric definitions that make them the single source of truth.
Design and run structured incrementality tests, including geo-lift tests, holdout tests, and pre/post analyses, to measure the true marginal impact of media spend, promotions, channels, and campaigns.
Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead and Head of Marketing to define budget allocation frameworks across Google, Meta, SEO, affiliates, and email, and translate data on traffic, cohorts, funnels, and creative performance into clear growth recommendations for country managers and leadership.
Set analytics standards, documentation, and best practices, support and improve our MCP and data connector ecosystem, and challenge misleading metrics so decisions rest on sound data.


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Web Analytics, or Growth Analytics, ideally within D2C e-commerce, with hands-on knowledge of GTM, GA4, e-commerce data layers, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs, and conversion APIs.
High proficiency in SQL and experience working with cloud data warehouses and multiple marketing, CRM, and e-commerce data sources.
Solid understanding of attribution, incrementality, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, CAC, ROAS, MER, contribution margin, and payback.
A strong statistical mindset with practical experience designing A/B tests, geo-lift tests, holdout tests, or conversion lift studies, and the communication skills to turn analytical topics into clear guidance for marketing and leadership.
Bonus: experience with AI-assisted analytics, API connectors, automated reporting, or marketing data infrastructure.


What We Offer

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary


Company pension plan
Capped overtime, fully paid


🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work with an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27


One week per year of remote workation in the EU/UK


🌟 Benefits And Lifestyle


Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)
Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products
Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting
Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats


📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin (easily accessible by public transport)

How To Apply

Ready to build the analytics backbone of a growing premium e-commerce brand? Apply through our Career Page or reach out via LinkedIn. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

Description:
New Permanent Opportunity for a Security Cleared Data Analyst

Must have active SC Clearance
Mid to Senior levels available
Up to £60k DoE plus package
Hybrid working – bases in Bristol, London, Manchester or Swansea




Who are we?

Our client is a leading technology consultancy delivering complex digital and data transformation programmes across the UK public sector.

Their teams work with clients to make better use of their data, delivering analytical solutions and insights that support better decision-making across a range of critical services.




What will the Data Analyst be doing?

You’ll be responsible for analysing data and turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights, working closely with clients and technical teams to solve challenging business problems.

The role will involve data analysis, statistical techniques, data visualisation and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




Key responsibilities include:

Analysing and interpreting complex datasets to identify trends, relationships and actionable insights
Applying statistical techniques including hypothesis testing, regression and clustering
Carrying out data mining, profiling and exploratory analysis across varied datasets
Cleaning, standardising and transforming data to improve its quality and usability
Performing data linkage and integrating information from multiple sources
Developing data models and selecting appropriate analytical approaches to answer business questions
Creating clear and effective data visualisations to communicate findings
Translating analytical results into meaningful recommendations for clients and stakeholders
Applying appropriate data governance, security and quality practices throughout analytical work
Working with clients to understand requirements and communicate complex findings to non-technical audiences




Key Skills and Requirements

Commercial experience working in a Data Analysis role
Strong analytical and statistical skills with experience interpreting complex datasets
Experience with statistical techniques such as regression, hypothesis testing and clustering
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python for data analysis would be advantageous
Experience with data cleansing, standardisation, profiling and validation
Understanding of data modelling, data integration and data linkage
Experience creating data visualisations and communicating insights effectively
Understanding of data governance, security and data quality principles
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly with non-technical audiences
Experience contributing to analytical approaches and supporting wider project delivery would be advantageous

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Ship the full stack of analytics: pipelines, dashboards, experiments and stakeholder narratives - using AI to move faster at every step.

Our mission to elevate later life care doesn’t resonate with you.
You prefer working in isolation rather than as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team.

You treat AI as a gimmick, haven’t built it into your workflow, or won’t keep learning as the tools move.
You prioritise perfect work over impact.
You're looking for a role where you can specialise in a specific area.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Supply
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable participant marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can independently drive strategic marketplace analytics and act as an end-to-end partner across product, operations, and leadership.

What you’ll bring to the role


Senior Analytics Expertise: Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency (e.g. pandas, experimentation analysis, automation), with a proven track record of architecting scalable reporting frameworks and data marts in modern BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Hex). Demonstrated capability to independently own ambiguous problems end-to-end — from complex raw data to executive-ready strategic insights.
Lifecycle Analytics: Experience analysing user acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, churn, and behavioural cohorts.
Experimentation & Statistics: Experience designing and analysing A/B or operational experiments, with solid grounding in statistical concepts and causal thinking.
Product Thinking: Ability to translate participant and marketplace challenges into measurable hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable recommendations.
Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to connect operational metrics to revenue, margin, and financial performance — understanding not just what is happening, but why it matters commercially.
Strategic Autonomy & Ownership: Exceptional ability to operate with high autonomy in a dynamic environment, independently setting priorities, challenging assumptions, framing complex problems, and driving strategic initiatives from initial hypothesis through execution.
Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of influencing senior leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Operations, Commercial, and Finance functions, telling compelling data-driven stories that shape strategy.
Marketplace Understanding: Strong grasp of B2B and two-sided marketplace metrics and economics.
Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready insights that shape strategy and execution.


What you'll be doing


Autonomously own analytics across the full participant lifecycle—from acquisition and onboarding through activation, engagement, quality, retention, and reactivation
Define and build strategic metrics, executive-facing dashboards, and robust experimentation frameworks that reveal participant behavior and optimize marketplace dynamics
Work closely with Product, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Executive Leadership to identify growth drivers, structure complex experiments, and translate intricate marketplace data into high-impact strategic decisions
Work hands-on across SQL, Python, experimentation, and senior stakeholder leadership to drive alignment around participant health, marketplace liquidity, unit economics, and long-term supply sustainability


Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

We’re part of Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands.

Founded in 2006, our teams in Guernsey, London, Malta, Germany, Portugal and Spain are constantly expanding and evolving.

We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Betway, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish, and your career can soar.

Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary.

Why we need you

We’re on a mission to create extraordinary experiences for our customers, and we believe that your unique skills, passion and superdrive will help us achieve our vision.

As a Data Analyst you’ll be using your skills to unlock the power of our data by finding innovative ways to analyse, organise, integrate, and visualise information. This will empower leaders across the business to make decisions quickly and confidently to stay ahead of the game.

What You’ll Be Doing

As part of your role, your responsibilities will include:


Answering business questions from stakeholders across a wide range of departments
Addressing analysis requests and providing actionable insights
Building reports/dashboards, models, and proof of concepts
Partnering with relevant teams to determine campaign effectiveness using performance data
Assisting the marketing team to determine ROI and monetary impact of acquisition efforts
Improving the flow of reporting/explanations and rationale; explaining performance to relevant stakeholders
Maintain knowledge, expertise, and best practises on a suite of data & BI technologies to promote appropriate adoption with the team
Stay up to date on the latest technologies and best practices


This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities. You may be required to complete other reasonable duties to achieve business objectives.

Essential Skills You’ll Bring To The Table

The necessary skills that we require for this role include:


Qualified to degree level in a numeric/data prominent discipline or similar
At least 5 years work experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or other data visualisation tools.
Demonstrable SQL skills to query complex data sets for the data analysis.

Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team




The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.




The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.




As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.




Responsibilities




Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.




Requirements




Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.




Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.




Work in a way that works for you




We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.




Working for you




We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:




Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities




About Us




A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office.

Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.
