Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Time Type:

Full time

Working Pattern:

Hybrid

Purpose of the Role

Reporting to the Data Analytics Manager, the Senior Data Analyst is a hands-on individual contributor who helps the team through its shift from platform delivery (post-EDP) toward value-added analytics and commercial insight. The role contributes to building lasting data partnerships with the underwriting, claims and exposure management teams, so that analytics is embedded in day-to-day decision-making rather than delivered as isolated reports.

The role holder will apply and role-model the technical standards the team works to peer review, version control, documentation, testing and release management -and will aid the Data Analytics Manager to raise the overall maturity of the function. They will contribute to the most complex analyses and help introduce new techniques, including the practical application of AI tools within the analytics workflow.

Duties And Accountabilities

Business partnering and value-added analytics


Act as the senior analytics business partner to one or more underwriting classes, proactively identifying where analytics can improve pricing, portfolio steering, renewal decisions and exposure management.
Translate open-ended commercial questions into well-scoped analyses and dashboard requirements.
Closely collaborate with the wider business to identify areas of automation and acceleration to improve operational efficiency.
Identify practical opportunities to enhance the analytics workflow with AI tooling -for example, using LLMs and agentic tools for data exploration, code generation, documentation, and surfacing insight to underwriters.
Support the Data Analytics Manager in shaping external data analytical propositions -from discovery and prototyping through to packaging and delivery.


Team maturity, standards and Power BI governance


Apply and help embed the team’s development lifecycle for BI and analytics assets, including naming conventions, documentation, peer review and sign-off before production release.
Follow and help maintain robust source-control practices for Power BI content – use of PBIP / TMDL format, Git-backed repositories, feature branches, pull requests and meaningful commit history.
Contribute to Power BI workspace governance: clear Dev / Test / Prod separation, deployment pipelines, dataset certification / endorsement, refresh monitoring and access management.
Coach analysts and BI developers on SQL, DAX, data modelling, visual design and engineering hygiene; take part in code / report reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Work closely with Data Engineering on changes to the semantic / curated layer and data marts, ensuring analytics and business needs are reflected in platform design.
Deliver complex analytics workstreams end-to-end – scoping, estimation, delivery, hand-over and post-implementation review.
Work within an Agile framework: break down requirements into epics and user stories, contribute to backlog prioritisation with the Data Analytics Manager, and provide realistic estimates.


Essential

Skills, Knowledge and Experience


Well developed and demonstrable experience in a data analytics or BI role, preferably in an insurance or finance environment.
Advanced SQL, including query optimisation and working with the Azure data stack (Data Factory, Synapse / Fabric, SQL-based semantic layers).
Advanced Power BI: data modelling (star schemas), advanced DAX, Power Query / M, performance tuning, RLS, and deployment via pipelines.
Understanding of Power BI engineering discipline: PBIP / TMDL source format, Git-based version control, pull-request review, structured release and rollback process; demonstrable experience of these practices in a team.
Proven ability to carry out peer review and QA of analytics work – spotting model errors, DAX issues, performance problems and UX weaknesses, and giving constructive feedback.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to underwriting and internal stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder engagement, with a track record of turning ambiguous business problems into delivered analytical outcomes.


Desirable


Well developed experience in a Lloyd’s syndicate, managing agent, London Market broker or specialty (re)insurer.
Python for data analysis (pandas / notebooks) and an appreciation of wider data science techniques, enough to collaborate credibly with Data Scientists and Actuarial.
Hands-on experience applying AI / LLM tooling to analytics work (e.g. Co-pilot for Power BI / Fabric, MCP-style integrations, agentic assistants, code-generation tools) with a pragmatic view on where they add value.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions, and data-quality tooling.


AEGIS Values

Fairness and respect

We make decisions considering the best interests of key stakeholders. We are direct and straightforward in our actions, working collaboratively to create a culture of fairness and respect.

Open and inclusive

We act with integrity, valuing diversity of thought and background. We take time to listen to the needs of our customers, stakeholders and colleagues working together to seek and share information.

Ambitious

We have a passion for success, aspiring to be recognised as best in class. We embrace new opportunities, encouraging innovation in pursuit of our goals.

Striving to be better

We strive to improve at all times, challenging complacency, being agile and adapting to change. We always seek to improve our customers’ experience with us.

Investing in people’s potential

We provide an environment where each employee can reach their personal potential. We encourage personal accountability for performance and individual ownership for growth and success.

AEGIS London is an equal opportunities employer and recognises the value of a diverse workforce in facilitating better decision making and business growth. We encourage a variety of differing views, perspectives and insights to create a collaborative working environment. Diversity and Inclusion are fundamental to our business and we encourage applications from all backgrounds recognising the diversity of society and our customers.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact


Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.
Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.
Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.
Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.
Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.
Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.
Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.


Your background


A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.
Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.
Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.
Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.


The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

Title: YouTube Data Analyst
Description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.




YouTube is one of our biggest growth engines, home to some of the most distinctive channels, including LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible. From working with the world’s biggest creators and A-list talent on hit formats like Snack Wars, to powerful storytelling through series such as Minutes With and Honesty Box, we’ve become one of the most exciting and influential players in the industry.




About the Role

Our YouTube team is growing, and we are on the proactive lookout for a Data Analyst in media industries. The Data Analyst produces insight that drives decisions across the YouTube team and informs the Originals commissioning pipeline.




What the opportunity looks like

Channel Performance - Analyse YouTube channel performance across watch time, CTR, audience retention, subscriber growth, CPMs, return viewers, and audience share to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Dashboard Management - Build, maintain, and optimise live reporting dashboards using Looker Studio and BigQuery, ensuring stakeholders have access to accurate, actionable performance data.
External Intelligence - Conduct competitive and market intelligence using tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, and platform analytics to benchmark performance and identify emerging category trends.
Format Growth and Analysis - Deliver audience, content format, and growth analysis to inform channel strategy, content investment decisions, and new channel or format opportunities.
Portfolio Growth Tracking - Monitor portfolio performance against targets, proactively flagging underperformance and providing data-driven recommendations to support business and commercial objectives.




Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.
Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.
Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
Proficiency in BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, and data visualisation best practices.
Familiarity with competitive intelligence and social analytics tools such as Tubular Labs, Social Blade, or similar platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.




At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.




LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Cambridge Aerospace is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support strategic decision-making through high-quality data analysis, forecasting and reporting. Working closely with the Director, Strategic Analytics & Intelligence, you will analyse commercial, market and operational data to provide clear insights that inform business strategy, investment priorities and growth opportunities.




This is a hands-on analytical role requiring strong technical capability, commercial awareness and the ability to turn complex datasets into meaningful recommendations. You will develop analytical models, dashboards and reporting tools, helping establish a robust, data-driven approach to strategic planning across the business.




Responsibilities

Analyse commercial, market and operational datasets to identify trends, opportunities and risks that inform strategic decisions
Develop market sizing models, including TAM, SAM and SOM, alongside defence spending forecasts and country attractiveness assessments
Build and maintain forecasting models, dashboards and reports covering growth pipelines, win rates, conversion performance and resource allocation
Support competitor analysis, portfolio performance assessments and strategic investment decisions through quantitative research
Develop clear data visualisations, executive reports and decision-support materials for senior stakeholders
Improve data quality, reporting processes and analytical frameworks, supporting the development of Cambridge Aerospace's strategic analytics capability




Requirements

Strong experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics or a comparable analytical role
Advanced skills in data analysis and modelling using Python, SQL, Excel or equivalent tools
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau or similar visualisation platforms
Strong statistical and quantitative skills, with experience in forecasting, trend analysis and interpreting complex datasets
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate data into practical commercial or strategic recommendations
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills and ability to work independently with senior stakeholders




Preferred Qualifications/Experience

Degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline
Experience in market intelligence, strategic analytics, commercial forecasting or business strategy
Exposure to defence, aerospace, technology or another data-intensive industry
Experience with market sizing, competitor benchmarking, pipeline analytics or investment modelling
Familiarity with data automation, data integration and building scalable reporting processes
Experience in fast-paced R&D or startup environments, with rapid prototype iteration times




What We Offer

Competitive compensation and stock options
Private medical and dental cover
Cycle to work scheme
Lunchtime catering on site




About Us

The mission of Cambridge Aerospace is to eliminate the risk of existential war in Europe. That risk comes from the air – low-cost drones and cruise missiles now manufactured in colossal volumes by our adversaries, ballistic missiles capable of ending the world as we know it, and a new generation of hypersonic weapons that evade every existing defence.




We're building low-cost interceptors that defeat these threats, and the surveillance systems to detect and target them – at a cost taxpayers can afford, at the pace the threat demands, and with sovereign supply chains that assure delivery.




We have immense backing from the world's best venture funds. We're one of the fastest-growing defence technology companies in history. And we're hiring the best talent to prosecute the mission.




If you are in the top 1%, willing to work harder than you ever have, build technology better than anyone else, and contribute to the defining challenge of our time, now is the time to join us.




Our Commitment to Inclusion

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As part of the Performance Management area, this role will lead complex data management, analysis, and reporting work for the department. The Senior Data Analyst will translate business questions into scalable data solutions, monitor business performance, and deliver actionable insights through analytics and visualizations tailored to a range of audiences, including senior leaders.

The role will work closely with business subject matter experts, Technology teams, and data owners, while operating with a high degree of independence. The successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of enterprise data and data infrastructure, connect information across systems and platforms, and help establish practical standards and reusable solutions that improve the team’s analytics capabilities.

What You Will Do


Independently lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements and data discovery through solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable insights, communicating key drivers, limitations, implications, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leaders
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data models, semantic models, data marts, reports, and Power BI dashboards tailored to varied audiences
Work across enterprise systems, tools, and platforms to source, connect, transform, reconcile, validate, and analyze complex data that may be inconsistent, incomplete, or poorly documented
Partner with business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineers, data scientists, and data owners to define requirements, resolve data issues, and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions
Strengthen data quality, governance, documentation, and single-source-of-truth practices, while identifying opportunities to automate recurring work and create reusable analytical assets
Provide technical guidance, peer review, and knowledge sharing, and help establish practical standards that improve the team’s analytics capabilities
Independently manage multiple priorities and stakeholder relationships, using sound judgment, business acumen, and appropriate escalation


What You Will Bring


Minimum of three years of relevant experience and a university or college degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling, semantic model design, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, performance optimization, security, deployment, and lifecycle management
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for data preparation, integration, reconciliation, validation, automation, analysis, and quality assurance
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex enterprise analytics, structure ambiguous problems, and manage multiple priorities with sound judgment
Experience working with large, messy datasets and modern data infrastructure, including warehouses or lakehouses, data marts, pipelines, APIs, cloud platforms, and system dependencies
Experience combining tools and platforms—such as Excel, Power BI, Databricks, SQL, Python or R, Azure services, and enterprise systems—to build reusable datasets and deliver end-to-end solutions
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with a commitment to data quality, governance, documentation, process improvement, and knowledge sharing
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Experience with Azure compute services, Azure Data Factory or similar orchestration tools, and relevant Microsoft certifications is an asset

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

What We're Proud Of


2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing
2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology
2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report)
2023 Fast Company Best Places for Innovators
2023 Gartner's Magic Quadrant
2023 Software Report's Top 100 Software Companies
2023 BuiltIn Best Places to Work

2022 PeerSpot Silver Peer Award in Software Composition Analysis
2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award
2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year
Company Wellness days - We shut down company operations during some days of the year (5 in total) to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy much-needed and deserved additional rest.
Paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO)

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Solides compétences en SQL et en manipulation de bases de données.

The Opportunity:

The Data Analyst 2 supports the development, maintenance, analysis, and monitoring of data and reporting solutions across the COR.IQ product portfolio. This role supports the Data Analyst 3 to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of operational and client reporting while also supporting investigations, analytics initiatives, onboarding activities, and reporting enhancements. The position develops expertise in product data, reporting systems, fraud analytics, and operational processes, while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the Data Analyst 3 in maintaining reporting and analytics operations.

Grade: 16

The Data Analyst 2 works closely with the Data Analyst 3, who provides operational guidance, mentorship, knowledge transfer, and day-to-day prioritization of reporting and analytics activities. The role serves as the primary backup to the Data Analyst 3 and is expected to progressively develop the skills and knowledge required to assume broader responsibilities over time.

This is a hybrid role with requirements to be on site 1 day a week, providing a balance between remote flexibility and in-person collaboration.

About The Role:


Support reporting production and reporting operations to ensure accurate and timely delivery of client and internal reporting.
Develop and maintain SQL/Qlik queries and data extracts for reporting extracts, other reporting scripts, analytics solutions, and reporting enhancements, with guidance on complex changes, to improve operational efficiency and product insights.
Investigate data quality issues and operational anomalies to support reliable product performance and customer outcomes.
Support onboarding, product operations, and client requests to ensure successful implementation and ongoing effectiveness of DSS products.
Develop subject matter expertise and operational readiness to provide backup coverage and succession support for the Data Analyst 3 role.


What You Need to Succeed:

Education:


Bachelor's degree in one of the following: Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics & Related discipline; Additional training in analytics, databases, business intelligence, Python, SQL, or reporting platforms (Qlik, Power BI) would be considered a strong asset.


Experience:


3-5 years in Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Intelligence, Reporting and Performance Analytics.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, MS Power BI, PostgreSQL, Qlik Sense, and Qlik NPrinting considered strong assets.
Strong problem-solving and investigation experience.


Skill Requirements


SQL and database-querying skills.
Experience with reporting and business intelligence platforms (Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of ETL and data-processing concepts.
Ability to understand and modify scripting and reporting logic.
Basic Python or similar programming language experience would be considered an asset.
Strong problem-solving and investigation skills.
Ability to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and root causes.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work with large data sets.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to prepare presentations, reports, and documentation.
Curiosity and willingness to learn.
Strong customer-service orientation.
Self-motivated and accountable.
Collaborative team player.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


What’s In It For You

At Symcor, we define our success by what we help others achieve. We were created to support our clients and, through our products, services, and solutions, protect and strengthen their brands. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.

Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.

Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.


Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).

Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.

Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.

Title: Senior Consultant - Data Analyst
Description:
À propos de Cognizant Consulting

Chez Cognizant Consulting, nous sommes bien plus qu’une équipe de service-conseil, nous formons une communauté mondiale de plus de 5 000 experts dévoués à accompagner nos clients dans la transformation de leur entreprise. Grâce à notre connaissance sectorielle et à notre expertise technologique, nous concevons des solutions d’affaires novatrices pour nos clients figurant au palmarès Fortune 500. Et maintenant, nous sommes à la recherche de notre prochain(e) collègue qui façonnera l’avenir des affaires. Et si c’était vous?

À propos du poste

En tant qu’Analyste de données vous aurez un impact en transformant des exigences d’affaires complexes en solutions de données claires et exploitables pour un client du secteur des services financiers, en analysant des données, en rédigeant des requêtes et en traduisant les besoins des parties prenantes en spécifications concrètes. Vous ferez partie intégrante de l’équipe de livraison en données et analytique et vous collaborerez avec des parties prenantes d’affaires, des ingénieurs de données et des équipes de livraison.

Ce que vous accomplirez


Analyser des ensembles de données complexes et rédiger des requêtes SQL performantes pour appuyer les besoins d’affaires et de production de rapports
Décomposer des exigences complexes en éléments plus petits et gérables et les traduire en spécifications claires
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes d’affaires et techniques afin de valider les hypothèses et de garantir l’exactitude des résultats
Documenter les besoins en données, la logique et les processus afin d’assurer la transparence et la continuité
Appuyer les équipes de livraison et d’ingénierie grâce à des analyses rigoureuses et à une résolution de problèmes fiable


Modalités de travail

Nous croyons que le travail hybride est l'avenir, et nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans la mesure du possible. Compte tenu des exigences opérationnelles de ce poste, il s'agit d'un poste hybride nécessitant 2 jours par semaine au bureau de Cognizant ou chez un client à Mississauga, Ontario. Quel que soit votre modalité de travail, nous sommes là pour favoriser un équilibre travail-vie personnelle grâce à nos programmes de mieux-être.

Les modalités de travail pour ce poste sont exactes à la date de publication. Elles peuvent changer en fonction du projet dans lequel vous êtes engagé, ainsi que des exigences de Cognizant et du client. Soyez assuré(e) que nous serons toujours clairs sur les attentes liées au poste.

Compétences requises


Solide maîtrise du langage SQL et des langages de requête
Excellente capacité de logique pour décomposer des exigences complexes en plusieurs éléments plus petits
Personne dévouée et travaillante


Compétences désirées


Expérience dans un langage de programmation tel que Python et Java
Connaissance de SPARK et des services REST
Expérience en risque de marché


Nous avons hâte de rencontrer des personnes qui partagent notre mission et qui souhaitent contribuer de différentes façons. N’hésitez pas à postuler, même si vous ne répondez qu’aux compétences requises. Vos expériences et vos compétences transférables comptent, montrez-nous comment vous pourriez être la personne qu’il nous faut pour ce poste.

Salaire et autres formes de rémunération

Nous évaluons régulièrement les données du marché afin d’offrir une rémunération globale concurrentielle à nos associés. Le salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre 87 000,00 $ et 102 000,00 $ par année. La position du candidat retenu au sein de cette fourchette dépend de la formation, de l’expérience de travail ou de gestion pertinente et d’autres qualifications liées à l’emploi et à l’entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible au programme de boni annuel discrétionnaire fondé sur le rendement de Cognizant, ainsi qu’à des avantages sociaux qui soutiennent votre bien-être physique, mental et financier.

About Cognizant Consulting

Cognizant Consulting is where curious minds come together to solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact. Blending industry insight, technology expertise, and the power of AI, we partner with leading organizations to transform the way they work, serve customers, and grow.

About The Role

As a Data Analyst, you will make an impact by turning complex business requirements into clear, actionable data solutions for a client in the financial services sector, analyzing data, writing queries, and translating stakeholder needs into concrete specifications. You will be a valued member of the data and analytics delivery team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and delivery teams, and clients.

In this role, you will


Analyze complex data sets and write high-performing SQL queries to support business and reporting needs
Decompose complex requirements into smaller, manageable pieces and translate them into clear specifications
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to validate assumptions and ensure accurate outputs
Document data needs, logic, and processes to ensure transparency and continuity
Support delivery and engineering teams through rigorous analysis and reliable problem-solving


Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mississauga, Ontario. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Must Have To Be Considered


Strong SQL and query language knowledge
Excellent logic to decompose complex requirements into multiple smaller pieces
Dedicated and hard-working


These will help you succeed


Experience in a programming language such as Python and Java
Knowledge of SPARK and REST services
Market risk experience


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

We regularly assess market data to ensure we offer a competitive compensation package for our associates. The base salary for this position ranges between $87,000.00 – 102,000.00 per year. Where the successful candidate may fall within the range depends on relevant education, work and/or management experience and other business-related and job-necessary qualifications. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual performance-based bonus, as well as benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing.

Description:

We are currently seeking a Data Analyst to join the Data Solutions team in the Wealth Technology group at CI Wealth. The Data Solutions team focuses on developing data-driven solutions, driving innovation, and uncovering key insights to support strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will play a key role in leveraging data to deliver solutions that enhance decision-making, streamline business processes, and support strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both data analysis and business processes.

Responsibilities

Post-secondary degree in a quantitative discipline.

Experience in the Financial Services Industry is an asset.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.


For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.

Title: Senior Data & BI Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Data and BI Analyst who will report to the team lead of the Data Quality to Insights team, and who’ll be tasked with turning complex Snowflake data assets into reliable reporting, AI tools, and actionable insights that directly drive top-line revenue growth.

About The Team

The Data Quality to Insights team owns the end-to-end data foundation on our Snowflake platform. We bridge the gap between raw data engineering and executive decision-making. Our primary responsibility is driving top-line growth by ensuring data reliability, catching revenue leakage, and building the analytics and AI tools that power operational strategy. If you enjoy taking complex, unstructured datasets and turning them into scalable data assets that directly influence business performance, this team is where that happens.

You’ll Have The Opportunity To


Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders (commercial team , product owners, projects owner , data architect,data engineer) to align the needs and coordinator the efforts.
Explore and build proof-of-concepts with advanced analytics approaches to uncover new levers for profitability and efficiency.
Validate and test data pipelines using SQL in Snowflake to ensure accuracy and trust in our reporting.
Participate actively in impactful projects as the trusted data/analytics subject matter expert
Cross-analyze multiple data sources to connect the dots and surface insights that drive smarter decisions from supply chain to marketing.
Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data that highlight business risks, leakage, or new growth opportunities.
Translate business requirements into reporting solutions and support the design of dashboards in Power BI.


YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING SKILLS AND QUALITIES:


Master's degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or related field.
Strong SQL skills with experience in modern data warehouse technologies (ideally Snowflake).
Analytical mindset and intellectual curiosity; you love digging into data and uncovering the story it tells.
Problem-solving drive ; comfortable tackling complex data puzzles and simplifying them into actionable insights.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI (or willingness to learn).
Strong communication skills; able to turn data into clear, concise, and impactful messages.


ACKNOWLEDGING THE POWER OF DIVERSITY

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead!

Let’s start with a strong foundation — You want it, we have it:


Annual bonus based on the company’s financial results
Generous paid time away
Pension plan
Collective saving opportunities
Industry leading healthcare fully paid by BRP


What About Some Feel Good Perks


Flexible work schedule
A summer schedule that varies by department and location
Holiday season shutdown
Educational resources
Discount on BRP products

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt and even in the air.
