Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Joining the Canadian Tire team in the FGL Sports division, you will be working as part of a team of data management analysts.

Your role as a Data Analyst will be to support the Data Architecture in the development of various query requirements across multiple enterprise database sources. You will design, implement and manage the structure of reporting systems. The Data Analyst will be responsible for data extraction initiatives from our various systems, validation with business departments for ad hoc analysis requests and project developments.

What You’ll Do


Support various business requests by being responsible for the optimization and creation of SQL queries.
Design, build, deliver and manage models and reports using Excel and Power BI.
Present data from multiple enterprise database sources.
Participate in the data architecture and data solution design of our various systems.
Collaborate with analysts in the development of connections and extractions with our various databases (Dynamics 365, Azure, I Hub ingestion).
Support data validations during the integration of systems under different platforms.
Analyze impacts in existing systems during change requests; Analyze and collaborate on structural specifications for new software and applications.
Develop an in-depth understanding of the various processes
Support process documentation and provide automation recommendations.
Participate in workshops to gather requirements and provide recommendations for reporting and BI solutions.
Convert processes into functional requirements clearly and understandable to developers and project teams.
Leverage knowledge of specific data products available as well as visualization capabilities to improve requirements and offer relevant suggestions to stakeholders.
Prioritize tasks with the team and ensure the availability of forward-looking roadmaps for features to be delivered on data products under the team's purview.
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence analysts and IT department in the realization of various requirements, as well as maintenance and evolution activities.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics)
3+ years of experience in data analytics and good understanding of data architecture.
Working knowledge of AI and data warehouse concepts and terminology;
Excellent Excel skills, especially with the use of advanced formulas and macros.
Strong knowledge of SQL, ETL, Power BI (report design & visualization) and Microsoft Azure.
Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (asset)
Experience in analysis, modeling, verification, and development of business and technical requirements methodologies.
Ability to establish, document and communicate data modeling standards, policies, guidelines, and governance structures. Ability to prioritize projects within timelines.
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to relate and describe situations with data; Ability to explain complex phenomena clearly and concisely to any type of hearing
Thorough person with a passion for quality and innovative technologies.
Excellent command of French and English, both oral and written


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: BI Analyst, Poker Data & Insights
Description:
BI Analyst, Poker Data & Insights

Location: Toronto, ON (onsite)

Salary: $60,000 - 80,000

Bonus: Maximum 50% per annum

Vacancies: 1 vacancy




Own the numbers behind the world's largest online poker site.




You will join a lean Business Intelligence team that reports directly to the Head of BI and works with senior leadership, marketing, CRM and finance every week. This is not a report-factory job. You will own the analysis behind decisions on growth, budgets and player experience, and you will see the impact within weeks.




We are looking for an experienced BI Analyst who is naturally curious, moves fast, and wants to know why a number moved, not just that it did. You won’t just build reports. You’ll own them, evolve them, and bring insights forward before anyone has to ask. If you spot something off in a dataset and can’t let it go until you understand it, we want to hear from you.




Duties and Responsibilities:

Monitoring and issue detection. Catch trends, anomalies and performance shifts before they become problems, and bring clear, actionable findings to stakeholders
Reporting and dashboards. Build and maintain Tableau dashboards and datasets that non-technical leaders understand instantly, including our weekly leadership growth and loss reporting
Player and business analysis. Analyze large, complex datasets to understand player behaviour, product performance and business trends, and connect each pattern to real business impact
Data design. Write and optimize SQL on our Snowflake data warehouse to meet changing stakeholder needs
KPI development. Lead and improve core metrics including LTV, churn, CAC and regional performance
Forecasting and budgeting. Track performance against forecasts, flag deviations, and support the monthly budgeting cycle with finance and country managers
Campaign and promotion ROI. Evaluate whether campaigns worked, and what we should do next
Executive communication. Turn complex findings into short summaries that drive decisions, not just inform them




Requirements - Soft Skills:

Fast learner who thrives under pressure. You pick things up quickly, adapt on the fly, and don't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed
Resourceful and self-directed. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it. You figure things out independently before escalating
Genuinely curious. You ask why, not just what. You dig into the data because you actually want to understand it
Strong ownership mentality. You treat your work like it's yours and don't wait to be told something needs fixing
Business and finance intuition. You understand what the numbers mean for the business, not just what they say on the surface
Clear, confident communicator. You can explain a complex finding to a non-technical executive in two sentences
Organized and detail-oriented. You QA your own work, catch your own errors, and don't ship something you're not confident in




Requirements - Technical Skills:

Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently
Experience with Tableau or other BI visualization tools (required)
Experience with Snowflake or equivalent cloud-based data warehouses (required)




Definitely Apply if You Have:

Experience in iGaming, fintech, or high-volume data environments (strong asset)
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment (asset)
Passion for poker, strategy games, or competitive gaming (asset)
Familiarity with KPI frameworks in a gaming or subscription or retention business
Experience supporting forecasting or budgeting cycles




Total Rewards:

Annual salary and level review
Up to 50% bonus per annum
Paid vacation and sick time off
Flexible and comprehensive benefits
Commute coverage
Birthday Gift
GGPoker Swag
Preferred Gym rate
Endless snacks and beverages

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Overview




We are seeking a hands-on and business-focused Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations.

The role will support Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management through performance reporting, data analysis, process automation, and actionable insights. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to monitor performance, investigate trends, and identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

This role is suited to an analyst who is comfortable working independently with data while continuing to develop their strategic and commercial analytics capability.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales & Lead Analytics – 20%

Monitor lead performance, contact rates, conversion, sales performance, and advisor productivity.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring performance reporting.
Analyze lead sources, customer segments, and sales funnel performance to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
Support sales optimization, lead allocation, capacity planning, and performance analysis.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to support Sales and Lead Management initiatives.




2. Care & Retention Analytics – 50%

Analyze post-sales customer and policyholder performance to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer experience.
Monitor and report on key Care & Support metrics, including retention, lapse, service levels, and customer engagement.
Conduct customer, cohort, and root-cause analysis to identify performance drivers.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.




3. Reporting, Automation & Data Quality – 20%

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual reporting and improve reporting efficiency through automation.
Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure reporting accuracy.
Maintain clear KPI definitions, reporting documentation, and analytical methodologies.




4. Business & Knowledge Support – 10%

Support ad-hoc analytical requests across Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management.
Document key business processes, analytical methodologies, and reporting frameworks.
Support knowledge-sharing and knowledge-transfer activities across teams.
Provide analytical support for new market initiatives as required.




Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, Sales Analytics, Customer Analytics, or another regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills




Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with automated reporting, data validation, and ETL processes.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing is desirable.
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and concepts is considered a nice-to-have.




Core Competencies

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Title: Data Analyst (Claims)
Description:
Luminary People Collective is a boutique recruitment and People advisory firm connecting great people with great opportunities. We partner with ambitious businesses to find exceptional talent, build strong teams, and create meaningful connections that last.




Luminary People Collective is partnering with Moe's Home Collection to find a detail-oriented, analytical and proactive Data Analyst (Claims) to join their growing team.




Moe's Home Collection is a family-run furniture and design company with a passion for creating thoughtfully designed pieces for the modern home. With an entrepreneurial mindset and a people-first approach, Moe's continues to evolve, challenge the status quo and find new ways to better serve its customers.







The Opportunity

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented and solutions-focused Data Analyst (Claims) to join the Moe's Home Collection team.




As Moe's first dedicated Data Analyst, this is an exciting opportunity to build structure, establish reporting processes and make a meaningful impact on how data is collected, analyzed and used across the business.

You will work with data from multiple sources, identify trends and recurring product issues, and translate your findings into practical recommendations that help the Quality team and broader business take action.




This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both the technical side of data and the opportunity to collaborate with different teams, solve problems and see the real-world impact of their work.







What You'll Be Responsible For

Claims Data Analysis & Insights

Consolidate claims, returns, damage and customer feedback data from multiple sources, including SAP, Resolutions Team logs, customer data and brand channels.
Clean, standardize and organize data to create a reliable and consistent dataset for analysis and reporting.
Categorize claims by product, SKU, vendor, defect type, sales channel and region to identify meaningful trends.
Analyze recurring defects, product issues and potential root causes across Moe's, Sundays and Hetta.
Identify patterns and emerging risks, providing clear insights into claim volumes, associated costs and affected products or vendors.
Present findings to the Quality team in a clear, actionable format that supports investigation and corrective action.
Use data to help measure the effectiveness of product quality improvements and identify opportunities to reduce future claims.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with the Resolutions Team and Customer Data teams to understand how claims information is collected, categorized and maintained.
Work closely with Quality Control to track product issues from identification through corrective action and measure whether improvements are delivering results.
Share relevant findings with Product Development, Sourcing and brand teams to support product decisions and vendor conversations.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure reporting reflects business needs and supports decision-making.
Build strong relationships with teams across North America and Asia, bringing a collaborative and solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.




Data Quality & Process Improvement

Map existing claims data sources and workflows, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement.
Develop a more structured and reliable approach to consolidating data across different systems and teams.
Recommend improvements to how claims information is captured, including standardized defect codes, required data fields and product or photo references.
Establish and maintain data quality standards to improve accuracy, consistency and reporting reliability.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve efficiency through automation and better data management practices.
Help build scalable processes that support future growth and evolving business needs.




Reporting, Dashboards & Documentation

Develop and maintain recurring claims reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
Create clear, accessible reporting that highlights key issues, trends and opportunities, including weekly claims summaries and monthly analysis by vendor, product and SKU.
Translate complex datasets into concise, meaningful insights that non-technical stakeholders can easily understand and act on.
Prepare ad hoc analysis and reporting to support leadership and cross-functional teams.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering data collection, cleaning, analysis and reporting.
Ensure reporting processes are well documented, repeatable and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Leverage AI tools, including Claude and ChatGPT, to support analysis, documentation, process improvement and productivity while maintaining appropriate data confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important function and build something meaningful from the ground up.

Within your first 12 months, success will look like:

Reliable claims visibility: The Quality team has access to consistent, trusted reporting that clearly identifies the most significant product claims and quality issues, eliminating the need for manual data gathering.
Consolidated data: All key claims data sources have been mapped, cleaned and brought together into a reliable dataset used across the business.
Actionable dashboards: Recurring Power BI dashboards and claims reports are established and actively used by Quality Control, Resolutions and brand teams.
Documented processes: Clear SOPs are in place for the end-to-end claims data process, ensuring consistency and continuity.
Measurable improvements: Insights from your analysis have helped drive corrective actions that result in measurable reductions in claims for targeted products, SKUs or vendors.
Strong partnerships: You have built credibility across departments and established yourself as a trusted resource for accurate data, meaningful insights and practical recommendations.

What You Bring
2 to 4 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst or similar analytical role, ideally within retail, e-commerce, furniture or consumer products.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH and data cleaning techniques.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI.
Experience extracting, consolidating and analyzing data from SAP or a comparable ERP system.
Strong understanding of data quality, data validation and working with information from multiple systems.
Ability to identify trends, investigate inconsistencies and translate data into clear business insights.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to non-technical audiences in a concise and engaging way.
Strong written communication skills, including experience documenting processes, procedures and SOPs.
Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, with an interest in using technology to improve efficiency and workflows.
Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A self-directed approach, with the confidence to take initiative, solve problems and build processes where they do not yet exist.




Nice to Have

Experience working with claims, returns, warranties, customer resolutions or product quality data.
Familiarity with quality control, product development, sourcing or vendor management.
Experience collaborating with teams across multiple time zones, particularly North America and Asia.
A degree in Business, Statistics, Data Analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in the furniture, fashion, retail or broader consumer goods industry.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys working with data and understands that great analysis is only valuable when it leads to meaningful action.




You bring a combination of analytical thinking and practical problem-solving. You are not someone who simply produces reports. You want to understand the business, uncover opportunities and contribute to better outcomes.




You are organized, resourceful and comfortable working independently. As the first dedicated analyst in this area, you are excited by the opportunity to build processes, introduce structure and take ownership of how things are done.




You also enjoy collaboration. You know how to work with different teams, communicate findings clearly and build relationships with stakeholders who may not share your technical background.

Above all, you are proactive, adaptable and motivated by the opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business.




Why Join Moe's Home Collection?

This is an opportunity to join a creative, entrepreneurial and people-first organization that values fresh ideas, collaboration and continuous improvement.




Make an impact: Step into a newly established role where you can shape reporting processes, build systems and directly influence product quality improvements.
Collaborative environment: Work alongside passionate and creative colleagues across multiple brands and departments.
Flexible work arrangements: Full-time hybrid/remote opportunity, with Vancouver, BC preferred.
Competitive compensation: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $70,000, plus bonus.
Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental and vision coverage, including enhanced mental health resources.
Time to recharge: Three weeks of vacation in your first year.
Professional development: Opportunities to learn, grow and expand your skills as the business evolves.
Product discounts: Generous discounts for employees, friends and family.
Workplace perks: A casual and open Vancouver office with views of downtown and the North Shore mountains, ergonomic sit-stand workstations, a stocked kitchen, free EV charging and an office gym.
Wellness benefits: Complimentary weekly spin classes at Ride Cycle Club in Vancouver and Toronto.

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $122,010.00/Yr. - CAD $165,070.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

  • Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
  • Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
  • Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
  • Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
  • Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
  • Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
  • Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
  • Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
  • Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.

About You

  • You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
  • You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
  • Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
  • You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
  • You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
  • You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
  • You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
  • You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
  • You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.

Title: Data Analyst

In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Department: Technology

Employment Type: Permanent

Location: Greater Montreal Metropolitan Area, Canada

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Description

Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la conception, de la création et de la maintenance de la couche analytique ainsi que des rapports destinés aux clients, reposant sur la plateforme Compliance Pro.

Au sein de l’équipe Reporting, ce rôle consiste à traduire des exigences complexes en matière de conformité et de sécurité en tableaux de bord robustes et en rapports tabulaires qui répondent aux besoins des utilisateurs finaux. Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la livraison de bout en bout : modélisation des données, création et mise à jour des tableaux de bord et des widgets, définition des meilleures représentations des données, ainsi que garantie de l’exactitude, de la performance et de la cohérence des rapports avec les données affichées dans CPro.

Ce rôle est fortement orienté client : une grande partie du travail consiste à créer et mettre à jour des rapports personnalisés pour des opérateurs spécifiques, à résoudre des problèmes en production et à s’assurer que les rapports critiques pour l’entreprise sont fiables et à jour.

Construire des solutions innovantes ; permettre des lieux de travail plus sûrs pour tous.

Nous allons créer un monde du travail plus sûr, en développant des logiciels pour soutenir un réseau mondial d'acheteurs, de fournisseurs et de partenaires responsables.

Aujourd'hui, chez Veriforce, nous soulageons plus de 50 000 organisations à travers le monde des contraintes de conformité, en les aidant à protéger leurs employés, leurs activités et la planète.

Nous veillons à ce que notre réseau de clients, de fournisseurs et de sous-traitants respecte les normes les plus importantes, qu'il s'agisse de santé, de sécurité, de développement durable ou de comportement éthique, en élaborant les meilleures solutions du marché.

La technologie que nous construisons aujourd'hui créera un avenir meilleur.

Anglais De Niveau Avancé

Cette exigence est requise puisque dans le cadre de cette fonction, vous aurez à intervenir auprès des clients, partenaires et/ou nos filiales internationaux sur une base récurrente tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Dans le présent document, le genre masculin est utilisé dans le seul but d'alléger le texte

Qu'est-ce Que Cela Signifie Au Jour Le Jour


Créer et améliorer des tableaux de bord et des rapports spécifiques aux clients
Assurer la mise en valeur des données (« data storytelling ») afin que celles-ci soient pertinentes et exploitables pour la prise de décision
Veiller à ce que les rapports Sisense reflètent fidèlement les données de l’application en production, tant en termes de valeurs que de mise en forme
Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents en production
Collaborer étroitement avec les Product Owners, les équipes QA, les parties prenantes internes et les équipes en contact avec les clients afin d’affiner les critères d’acceptation, clarifier la logique des données et valider les rapports nouveaux ou mis à jour
Mettre en place et maintenir des standards de reporting cohérents à travers l’environnement Sisense et les produits de reporting
Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie et de données pour identifier et modéliser de nouvelles sources de données lorsque nécessaire
Maintenir une documentation technique claire afin de faciliter la maintenance et l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs
Participer aux rituels agiles, utiliser Jira pour gérer les tâches et fournir des estimations, des mises à jour d’avancement et des livrables clairs pour le QAT


Ce Dont Vous Aurez Besoin Pour Réussir


Expérience pratique dans le développement de solutions analytiques avec Sisense (ou une plateforme BI similaire), incluant la création de tableaux de bord complexes et de rapports tabulaires avec filtres, widgets et champs personnalisés
Solides compétences en SQL et expérience en modélisation de données pour le reporting (jointures, agrégations, champs calculés, conversions de types de données, optimisation des performances)
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de rapports critiques en environnement de production, incluant :
L’analyse des écarts entre les systèmes sources et les données produites
La correction des problèmes de données et de mise en forme
La maintenance de rapports opérationnels à fort enjeu
Capacité à interpréter des spécifications métiers détaillées et à les traduire en solutions de reporting précises
Excellentes compétences en « data storytelling » et solide compréhension des bonnes pratiques en reporting
Expérience dans l’analyse et l’amélioration de rapports Sisense existants
À l’aise pour collaborer étroitement avec les Product Owners, le QAT et les équipes en contact avec les clients, notamment pour valider le comportement des tableaux de bord, des filtres et des résultats
Grande attention aux détails et souci de la qualité
Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec aptitude à identifier des enjeux à travers plusieurs couches de données


Ce Que Vous Obtiendrez En Retour

Nous voulons que vous puissiez donner le meilleur de vous-même. Nous mettons l'accent sur les moyens de soutenir notre équipe pour qu'elle donne le meilleur d'elle-même. Voici quelques-uns des avantages que nous offrons :

Title: Analyste senior des données de jeu / Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
La division ThunderFire de NetEase Games est un développeur et éditeur de jeux vidéo de premier plan qui s'engage à offrir des expériences de jeu d'exception à un public international. Réparties entre nos studios de Montréal et de Toronto, nos équipes collaborent sur des projets ambitieux et originaux, notamment des titres en cours de développement local, ainsi que des projets internationaux de NetEase tels que Blood Message et Ananta.

L'analyste senior des données de jeu jouera un rôle clé au sein de notre « Insights Center », une équipe pluridisciplinaire qui réunit sous un même toit la recherche sur les utilisateurs de jeux et l'analyse de données. La mission principale de l'Insights Center consiste à tester nos jeux, à recueillir des retours pertinents auprès des joueurs et à combiner les atouts complémentaires de la recherche sur les utilisateurs et de l'analyse de données afin de mettre en lumière les raisons sous-jacentes du comportement des joueurs. Ensemble, nous fournissons à nos équipes de développement et aux parties prenantes du studio des informations exploitables qui influencent la manière dont nos jeux sont conçus.

Le poste

En tant qu'analyste de données de jeu senior, vous transformerez les données des joueurs en récits clairs et convaincants qui guideront des décisions concrètes. Mais l'analyse de données au sein de notre studio va au-delà des rapports automatisés et des tableaux de bord : elle est au cœur d'une analyse exploratoire qui met au jour les facteurs comportementaux et motivationnels qui sous-tendent les actions des joueurs dans nos jeux. Votre travail s'inscrit aux côtés de la recherche utilisateur comme un outil complémentaire lors des tests de jeu et des études sur les joueurs, en apportant des réponses à des questions quantitatives tout en nous aidant à mettre au jour les schémas, les comportements et les attitudes qui définissent l'expérience des joueurs.

Ce poste s'adresse à une personne véritablement curieuse des données et des joueurs, qui raisonne en termes de récits et de perspicacité, et pas seulement de tableaux de bord et de chiffres. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les chercheurs en expérience utilisateur, les concepteurs de jeux, les producteurs et les ingénieurs afin de vous assurer que nous posons les bonnes questions et que nous utilisons les données appropriées pour y répondre.

Il est également important de comprendre comment notre équipe fonctionne au quotidien. Une grande partie de nos efforts est consacrée au développement d'outils internes — de plus en plus alimentés par l'IA — qui aident l'ensemble de l'Insights Center à travailler plus efficacement. Cela signifie que le travail direct sur les données des joueurs n'est pas une activité constante ; il dépend fortement de nos projets en cours, des calendriers de tests de jeu et des besoins du studio. Si la diversité vous passionne, si vous aimez autant créer des outils qu'analyser des données, et si vous souhaitez rester à la pointe des innovations apportées par l'IA dans le domaine de l'analyse, vous vous sentirez comme chez vous ici.

Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats basés à Montréal ou à Toronto. Cela dit, la priorité sera donnée aux candidats basés à Montréal, compte tenu de la concentration de notre équipe d'analyse dans cette ville et des exigences en matière de présence au bureau (actuellement 3 jours par semaine, sous réserve de modification).

Responsabilités


Analyser les données des joueurs afin d'identifier des tendances, des schémas et des enseignements qui éclairent les décisions de conception du jeu et soutiennent les initiatives de recherche sur les utilisateurs, en replaçant toujours vos conclusions dans le contexte plus large du comportement des joueurs.
Élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord et des visualisations qui communiquent les enseignements tirés des données de manière claire et convaincante, tant aux parties prenantes techniques que non techniques.
Posséder une connaissance pratique des pipelines de données et de la modélisation des données en amont, suffisante pour traduire les besoins analytiques en exigences techniques, signaler les problèmes de qualité des données et comprendre comment les décisions prises en amont dans le pipeline se répercutent sur la précision en aval – élément clé pour collaborer efficacement avec les ingénieurs en analyse et les ingénieurs de données.
Contribuer au développement et à la maintenance d'outils internes – de plus en plus basés sur l'IA – qui aident à la fois les chercheurs en expérience utilisateur et les analystes à suivre, visualiser et analyser plus efficacement les données issues des tests de jeu.
Collaborer avec les concepteurs de jeux, les développeurs et les chercheurs en expérience utilisateur pour identifier dès le départ les bonnes questions et les besoins en données, puis les accompagner tout au long du cycle de vie complet de l'analyse : vérifier que les données sont bien collectées, définir les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et les métriques, visualiser les résultats, et mettre en évidence les tendances, les réponses et les nouvelles questions méritant d'être explorées.
Surveiller les métriques et les KPI des jeux afin d'identifier les problèmes potentiels et les opportunités d'amélioration.
Expérimentez de manière proactive les outils et approches d'IA en matière d'analyse, en vous tenant informé des tendances émergentes et en partageant vos connaissances avec l'équipe.
Recherchez des opportunités d'exploiter les données, les outils et les bonnes pratiques afin d'améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité de la fonction d'analyse.
Tenez-vous informé des tendances du secteur et des bonnes pratiques en matière d'analyse des données de jeux vidéo.


Qualifications

Expérience


Licence ou master dans un domaine quantitatif tel que l'intelligence d'affaires, les mathématiques, les statistiques, l'informatique ou une discipline connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente).
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, de préférence dans le secteur du jeu vidéo.
Expérience avérée dans la transformation de données comportementales des joueurs en informations et recommandations claires et exploitables.
Expérience de la collaboration avec des partenaires interfonctionnels : concepteurs, développeurs, producteurs et, idéalement, chercheurs en expérience utilisateur.
Une expérience de travail au sein d'équipes internationales et avec des collègues et parties prenantes dont l'anglais n'est pas la langue maternelle est un atout.


Compétences techniques


Solides compétences en SQL et connaissance des outils d'analyse et de manipulation des données.
Expérience pratique de notre pile analytique principale ou d'outils équivalents : Sigma, dbt et Snowflake.
Expérience approfondie des outils de visualisation des données et de BI (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI ou similaires).
Une expérience en modélisation de données est un atout (modélisation dimensionnelle de Kimball, Data Vault, etc.).
Une expérience avec Python (ou R/équivalent) est un atout.
Connaissance – et, idéalement, expérience pratique – des applications d'IA/ML en analyse de données (LLM pour la génération d'informations, la modélisation prédictive, la détection d'anomalies, etc.).
Une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu vidéo et des cycles de production est un atout.


Atouts supplémentaires


Le bilinguisme français-anglais est un atout pour notre studio de Montréal.
Expérience de collaboration avec des chercheurs en expérience utilisateur (UX).
Expérience de travail avec des équipes de développement de jeux chinoises ou au sein d'un éditeur de jeux chinois.
Connaissance de l'analyse marketing, des données d'acquisition d'utilisateurs ou des canaux de retours de la communauté.


Pourquoi nous pourrions être la compagnie parfaite pour toi:

Nous offrons l'expérience unique de faire partie de la création d'une nouvelle équipe de jeu internationale en plein cœur de Montréal, qui bénéficie de la richesse de la diversité de ses membres et de l'échange culturel avec nos partenaires à Hangzhou.

Nous offrons également :


Couverture d'assurance et télémédecine dès le 1er jour;
Indemnité transports et repas;
Prime de référencement;
REER avec contribution de l'employeur.


Rejoins-nous pour travailler sur un projet ambitieux, dans une atmosphère unique de start-up et avec une équipe de développeurs de jeux passionnés et pleins d'énergie !

Senior Game Data Analyst

ThunderFire Division of NetEase Games is a leading game developer and publisher committed to delivering top-quality gaming experiences to a global audience. Operating across studios in Montreal and Toronto, our teams collaborate on ambitious, original IPs - including titles in active development locally, as well as global NetEase projects such as Blood Message and Ananta.

The Senior Game Data Analyst will be a key contributor within our Insights Center - a multidisciplinary team that brings together Games User Research and Data Analytics under one roof. The Insights Center's core mission is to test our games, gather meaningful feedback from players, and combine the complementary strengths of user research and data analytics to surface the underlying why behind player behaviour. Together, we deliver actionable insights to our game teams and studio stakeholders that shape how our games are built.

The Role

As a Senior Game Data Analyst, you will turn player data into clear, compelling stories that drive real decisions. But analytics in our studio goes beyond automated reporting and dashboarding - it's central to exploratory analysis that uncovers the behavioral and motivational drivers behind what players do in our games. Your work sits alongside user research as a complementary tool in playtests and player studies, answering quantitative questions while helping us uncover the patterns, behaviours, and attitudes that define the player experience.

This is a role for someone genuinely curious about data and about players - someone who thinks in terms of narrative and insight, not just dashboards and numbers. You will partner closely with user researchers, game designers, producers, and engineers to ensure we're asking the right questions and using the right data to answer them.

It's also important to understand how our team works day to day. Much of our effort goes into building internal tooling - increasingly powered by AI - that helps the broader Insights Center work more effectively. This means that working directly with player data is not a constant; it is highly dependent on our current projects, playtest schedules, and studio needs. If you're excited by variety, by building tools as much as analyzing data, and by staying at the cutting edge of how AI is reshaping analytics, you'll feel at home here.

This role is open to candidates based in either Montreal or Toronto. That said, priority will be given to Montreal-based candidates, given the concentration of our analytics team there and expectations of in-office days (current rate at 3 days per week, subject to change).

What You'll Do


Analyze player data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform game design decisions and support user research initiatives - always framing your findings as part of the broader story of player behaviour.
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate data insights clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
Working knowledge of data pipelines and upstream data modeling, sufficient to translate analytical needs into technical requirements, flag data quality issues, and understand how upstream pipeline decisions ripple into downstream accuracy - key to partnering effectively with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of internal tooling - increasingly AI-powered - that helps both user researchers and analysts track, visualize, and analyze data from playtests more efficiently.
Partner with game designers, developers, and user researchers to identify the right questions and data needs from the start - then see them through the full analytics lifecycle: confirming whether the data is tracked, defining KPIs and metrics, visualizing the results, and surfacing trends, answers, and new questions worth exploring.
Monitor game metrics and KPIs to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.
Proactively experiment with AI tools and approaches in analytics, staying current on emerging trends and sharing what you learn with the team.
Look for opportunities to leverage data, tooling, and best practices to raise the quality and efficiency of the analytics function.
Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices in game data analytics.


What You Bring

Experience


Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Business Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in the video game industry.
Demonstrated experience translating player behavioural data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners - designers, developers, producers, and ideally user researchers.
Experience working with international teams and with colleagues and stakeholders for whom English is not a first language is an asset.


Technical Skills


Strong SQL skills and knowledge of data analysis and manipulation tools.
Hands-on experience with our core analytics stack or equivalent tools: Sigma, dbt, and Snowflake.
Extensive experience with data visualization and BI tools (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar).
Experience with data modelling is an asset (Kimball dimensional modelling, data vault, etc.).
Experience with Python (or R/equivalent) is an asset.
Awareness of - and ideally hands-on experience with - AI/ML applications in analytics (LLMs for insight generation, predictive modelling, anomaly detection, etc.).
Good knowledge of the video game industry and production cycles is an asset.


Nice to Have


Bilingual in French and English, an asset for our Montreal studio environment.
Background working alongside UX researchers.
Experience working with Chinese game development teams or in a Chinese game publisher context.
Familiarity with marketing analytics, user acquisition data, or community feedback channels.


Why could we be the perfect place for you:

We offer the unique experience of being part of the foundation of a new international game team right in the heart of Montreal, which benefits from the rich diversity of its members and the cultural exchange with our partners in Hangzhou.

We also offer:


Insurance coverage and telemedicine from day one,
Transportation and meal allowance,
Referral bonus,
RRSP with employer contribution.


Join us to work on an ambitious project, in a unique 'Start-Up Atmosphere' and with a team of passionate and energetic game developers!

Justification des exigences linguistiques

NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste.

Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux.

Language Requirement Justification

NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position.

However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.
