  • Recherchez des opportunités d'exploiter les données, les outils et les bonnes pratiques afin d'améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité de la fonction d'analyse.
  • Tenez-vous informé des tendances du secteur et des bonnes pratiques en matière d'analyse des données de jeux vidéo.

Qualifications

Expérience

  • Licence ou master dans un domaine quantitatif tel que l'intelligence d'affaires, les mathématiques, les statistiques, l'informatique ou une discipline connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente).
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, de préférence dans le secteur du jeu vidéo.
  • Expérience avérée dans la transformation de données comportementales des joueurs en informations et recommandations claires et exploitables.
  • Expérience de la collaboration avec des partenaires interfonctionnels : concepteurs, développeurs, producteurs et, idéalement, chercheurs en expérience utilisateur.
  • Une expérience de travail au sein d'équipes internationales et avec des collègues et parties prenantes dont l'anglais n'est pas la langue maternelle est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Solides compétences en SQL et connaissance des outils d'analyse et de manipulation des données.
  • Expérience pratique de notre pile analytique principale ou d'outils équivalents : Sigma, dbt et Snowflake.
  • Expérience approfondie des outils de visualisation des données et de BI (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI ou similaires).
  • Une expérience en modélisation de données est un atout (modélisation dimensionnelle de Kimball, Data Vault, etc.).
  • Une expérience avec Python (ou R/équivalent) est un atout.
  • Connaissance – et, idéalement, expérience pratique – des applications d'IA/ML en analyse de données (LLM pour la génération d'informations, la modélisation prédictive, la détection d'anomalies, etc.).
  • Une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu vidéo et des cycles de production est un atout.

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Le bilinguisme français-anglais est un atout pour notre studio de Montréal.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des chercheurs en expérience utilisateur (UX).
  • Expérience de travail avec des équipes de développement de jeux chinoises ou au sein d'un éditeur de jeux chinois.
  • Connaissance de l'analyse marketing, des données d'acquisition d'utilisateurs ou des canaux de retours de la communauté.

Pourquoi nous pourrions être la compagnie parfaite pour toi:

Nous offrons l'expérience unique de faire partie de la création d'une nouvelle équipe de jeu internationale en plein cœur de Montréal, qui bénéficie de la richesse de la diversité de ses membres et de l'échange culturel avec nos partenaires à Hangzhou.

Nous offrons également :

  • Couverture d'assurance et télémédecine dès le 1er jour;
  • Indemnité transports et repas;
  • Prime de référencement;
  • REER avec contribution de l'employeur.

Rejoins-nous pour travailler sur un projet ambitieux, dans une atmosphère unique de start-up et avec une équipe de développeurs de jeux passionnés et pleins d'énergie !

Senior Game Data Analyst

ThunderFire Division of NetEase Games is a leading game developer and publisher committed to delivering top-quality gaming experiences to a global audience. Operating across studios in Montreal and Toronto, our teams collaborate on ambitious, original IPs - including titles in active development locally, as well as global NetEase projects such as Blood Message and Ananta.

The Senior Game Data Analyst will be a key contributor within our Insights Center - a multidisciplinary team that brings together Games User Research and Data Analytics under one roof. The Insights Center's core mission is to test our games, gather meaningful feedback from players, and combine the complementary strengths of user research and data analytics to surface the underlying why behind player behaviour. Together, we deliver actionable insights to our game teams and studio stakeholders that shape how our games are built.

The Role

As a Senior Game Data Analyst, you will turn player data into clear, compelling stories that drive real decisions. But analytics in our studio goes beyond automated reporting and dashboarding - it's central to exploratory analysis that uncovers the behavioral and motivational drivers behind what players do in our games. Your work sits alongside user research as a complementary tool in playtests and player studies, answering quantitative questions while helping us uncover the patterns, behaviours, and attitudes that define the player experience.

This is a role for someone genuinely curious about data and about players - someone who thinks in terms of narrative and insight, not just dashboards and numbers. You will partner closely with user researchers, game designers, producers, and engineers to ensure we're asking the right questions and using the right data to answer them.

It's also important to understand how our team works day to day. Much of our effort goes into building internal tooling - increasingly powered by AI - that helps the broader Insights Center work more effectively. This means that working directly with player data is not a constant; it is highly dependent on our current projects, playtest schedules, and studio needs. If you're excited by variety, by building tools as much as analyzing data, and by staying at the cutting edge of how AI is reshaping analytics, you'll feel at home here.

This role is open to candidates based in either Montreal or Toronto. That said, priority will be given to Montreal-based candidates, given the concentration of our analytics team there and expectations of in-office days (current rate at 3 days per week, subject to change).

What You'll Do

  • Analyze player data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform game design decisions and support user research initiatives - always framing your findings as part of the broader story of player behaviour.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that communicate data insights clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines and upstream data modeling, sufficient to translate analytical needs into technical requirements, flag data quality issues, and understand how upstream pipeline decisions ripple into downstream accuracy - key to partnering effectively with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of internal tooling - increasingly AI-powered - that helps both user researchers and analysts track, visualize, and analyze data from playtests more efficiently.
  • Partner with game designers, developers, and user researchers to identify the right questions and data needs from the start - then see them through the full analytics lifecycle: confirming whether the data is tracked, defining KPIs and metrics, visualizing the results, and surfacing trends, answers, and new questions worth exploring.
  • Monitor game metrics and KPIs to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Proactively experiment with AI tools and approaches in analytics, staying current on emerging trends and sharing what you learn with the team.
  • Look for opportunities to leverage data, tooling, and best practices to raise the quality and efficiency of the analytics function.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices in game data analytics.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Business Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in the video game industry.
  • Demonstrated experience translating player behavioural data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners - designers, developers, producers, and ideally user researchers.
  • Experience working with international teams and with colleagues and stakeholders for whom English is not a first language is an asset.

Technical Skills

  • Strong SQL skills and knowledge of data analysis and manipulation tools.
  • Hands-on experience with our core analytics stack or equivalent tools: Sigma, dbt, and Snowflake.
  • Extensive experience with data visualization and BI tools (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar).
  • Experience with data modelling is an asset (Kimball dimensional modelling, data vault, etc.).
  • Experience with Python (or R/equivalent) is an asset.
  • Awareness of - and ideally hands-on experience with - AI/ML applications in analytics (LLMs for insight generation, predictive modelling, anomaly detection, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of the video game industry and production cycles is an asset.

Nice to Have

  • Bilingual in French and English, an asset for our Montreal studio environment.
  • Background working alongside UX researchers.
  • Experience working with Chinese game development teams or in a Chinese game publisher context.
  • Familiarity with marketing analytics, user acquisition data, or community feedback channels.

Why could we be the perfect place for you:

We offer the unique experience of being part of the foundation of a new international game team right in the heart of Montreal, which benefits from the rich diversity of its members and the cultural exchange with our partners in Hangzhou.

We also offer:

  • Insurance coverage and telemedicine from day one,
  • Transportation and meal allowance,
  • Referral bonus,
  • RRSP with employer contribution.

Join us to work on an ambitious project, in a unique 'Start-Up Atmosphere' and with a team of passionate and energetic game developers!

Title: Senior Data Analyst

A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.


For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.


A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***


At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!


🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Joining the Canadian Tire team in the FGL Sports division, you will be working as part of a team of data management analysts.

Your role as a Data Analyst will be to support the Data Architecture in the development of various query requirements across multiple enterprise database sources. You will design, implement and manage the structure of reporting systems. The Data Analyst will be responsible for data extraction initiatives from our various systems, validation with business departments for ad hoc analysis requests and project developments.

What You’ll Do


Support various business requests by being responsible for the optimization and creation of SQL queries.
Design, build, deliver and manage models and reports using Excel and Power BI.
Present data from multiple enterprise database sources.
Participate in the data architecture and data solution design of our various systems.
Collaborate with analysts in the development of connections and extractions with our various databases (Dynamics 365, Azure, I Hub ingestion).
Support data validations during the integration of systems under different platforms.
Analyze impacts in existing systems during change requests; Analyze and collaborate on structural specifications for new software and applications.
Develop an in-depth understanding of the various processes
Support process documentation and provide automation recommendations.
Participate in workshops to gather requirements and provide recommendations for reporting and BI solutions.
Convert processes into functional requirements clearly and understandable to developers and project teams.
Leverage knowledge of specific data products available as well as visualization capabilities to improve requirements and offer relevant suggestions to stakeholders.
Prioritize tasks with the team and ensure the availability of forward-looking roadmaps for features to be delivered on data products under the team's purview.
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence analysts and IT department in the realization of various requirements, as well as maintenance and evolution activities.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics)
3+ years of experience in data analytics and good understanding of data architecture.
Working knowledge of AI and data warehouse concepts and terminology;
Excellent Excel skills, especially with the use of advanced formulas and macros.
Strong knowledge of SQL, ETL, Power BI (report design & visualization) and Microsoft Azure.
Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (asset)
Experience in analysis, modeling, verification, and development of business and technical requirements methodologies.
Ability to establish, document and communicate data modeling standards, policies, guidelines, and governance structures. Ability to prioritize projects within timelines.
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to relate and describe situations with data; Ability to explain complex phenomena clearly and concisely to any type of hearing
Thorough person with a passion for quality and innovative technologies.
Excellent command of French and English, both oral and written


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Ethics and Compliance
Description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:


Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program



What are your contributions to the team?


Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).
Integrate and analyze data across multiple Ethics & Compliance datasets, creating a unified view to support decision-making and oversight.
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify anomalies, patterns, and potential indicators of misconduct or non-compliance.
Design and optimize data pipelines, data models, and automation processes to improve scalability, timeliness, and reliability of compliance data.
Partner with cross-functional teams (including Legal, HR, Audit, Risk, IT) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.
Enable data-driven investigations by extracting, analyzing, and interpreting relevant data.
Lead the evolution of analytics for our Ethics and Compliance organization, including the development of predictive analytics and forward-looking risk indicators.
Support the Strategy & Governance analyst to translate complex data into clear, business-friendly insights for leadership and stakeholders.



How to thrive in this role?


You have a Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.
You have 5–8+ years of experience in data analytics.
You have advanced technical skills in:
SQL and data querying
Data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
You have familiarity with Databricks and programming languages such as Python or R; this would be considered an asset.
You have experience working with multiple, complex datasets and integrating them into cohesive reporting solutions.
You have an analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and hidden risks.
You demonstrate a high level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
You are curious and adaptable, with an interest in advancing into predictive and advanced analytics.
You have the ability to build dashboards and tell a compelling data story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience working within an Ethics & Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Legal environment, as well as familiarity with compliance-related frameworks and data (e.g., hotline reports, investigations, risk management, policy adherence); this would be considered an asset.



Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst, YEG2
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications

Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you

Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la conception, de la création et de la maintenance de la couche analytique ainsi que des rapports destinés aux clients, reposant sur la plateforme Compliance Pro.

Le Data Analyst sera responsable de la livraison de bout en bout : modélisation des données, création et mise à jour des tableaux de bord et des widgets, définition des meilleures représentations des données, ainsi que garantie de l’exactitude, de la performance et de la cohérence des rapports avec les données affichées dans CPro.

Ce rôle est fortement orienté client : une grande partie du travail consiste à créer et mettre à jour des rapports personnalisés pour des opérateurs spécifiques, à résoudre des problèmes en production et à s’assurer que les rapports critiques pour l’entreprise sont fiables et à jour.

Grande attention aux détails et souci de la qualité
Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec aptitude à identifier des enjeux à travers plusieurs couches de données

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)

Collect, structure, and analyze data from multiple sources (ERP systems, operations, quality, etc.).

Title: Analyst, Platform & Enablement
Description:
Role Summary

Job Description Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.

This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.

This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.

Position Details

About The Role


Build and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions.
Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics.
Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes.
Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format.
Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers.
Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines.
Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders.
Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives.
Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively.


About You


You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context.
Data and coding fluency — you are a self-starter comfortable using SQL, Python, and generative AI tools to access data and deliver analysis independently.
You have hands-on experience with Databricks (SQL,Python, PySpark, Delta Lake) and can write, review, and troubleshoot complex analytical queries and data pipelines.
You have hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking ecosystems such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or similar tools, including familiarity with events, sessions, users, UTM parameters, attribution, funnels, and conversion measurement.
You have experience with BI and reporting platforms — particularly Power BI.
You have experience with data validation and reconciliation — comparing data across source systems, identifying discrepancies, and documenting business rules that govern metric calculations.
You are comfortable performing root cause analysis — diagnosing why a metric moved, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches — scoping the data needed, defining assumptions, and delivering concise answers under time pressure.
You have experience working in agile environments — managing your own backlog across 2-week sprints, balancing recurring reporting with project work, and communicating progress and blockers proactively.


Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

Support for Community Involvement

Title: Data Analyst (Claims)
Description:
Luminary People Collective is a boutique recruitment and People advisory firm connecting great people with great opportunities. We partner with ambitious businesses to find exceptional talent, build strong teams, and create meaningful connections that last.




Luminary People Collective is partnering with Moe's Home Collection to find a detail-oriented, analytical and proactive Data Analyst (Claims) to join their growing team.




Moe's Home Collection is a family-run furniture and design company with a passion for creating thoughtfully designed pieces for the modern home. With an entrepreneurial mindset and a people-first approach, Moe's continues to evolve, challenge the status quo and find new ways to better serve its customers.







The Opportunity

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented and solutions-focused Data Analyst (Claims) to join the Moe's Home Collection team.




As Moe's first dedicated Data Analyst, this is an exciting opportunity to build structure, establish reporting processes and make a meaningful impact on how data is collected, analyzed and used across the business.

You will work with data from multiple sources, identify trends and recurring product issues, and translate your findings into practical recommendations that help the Quality team and broader business take action.




This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both the technical side of data and the opportunity to collaborate with different teams, solve problems and see the real-world impact of their work.







What You'll Be Responsible For

Claims Data Analysis & Insights

Consolidate claims, returns, damage and customer feedback data from multiple sources, including SAP, Resolutions Team logs, customer data and brand channels.
Clean, standardize and organize data to create a reliable and consistent dataset for analysis and reporting.
Categorize claims by product, SKU, vendor, defect type, sales channel and region to identify meaningful trends.
Analyze recurring defects, product issues and potential root causes across Moe's, Sundays and Hetta.
Identify patterns and emerging risks, providing clear insights into claim volumes, associated costs and affected products or vendors.
Present findings to the Quality team in a clear, actionable format that supports investigation and corrective action.
Use data to help measure the effectiveness of product quality improvements and identify opportunities to reduce future claims.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with the Resolutions Team and Customer Data teams to understand how claims information is collected, categorized and maintained.
Work closely with Quality Control to track product issues from identification through corrective action and measure whether improvements are delivering results.
Share relevant findings with Product Development, Sourcing and brand teams to support product decisions and vendor conversations.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure reporting reflects business needs and supports decision-making.
Build strong relationships with teams across North America and Asia, bringing a collaborative and solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.




Data Quality & Process Improvement

Map existing claims data sources and workflows, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement.
Develop a more structured and reliable approach to consolidating data across different systems and teams.
Recommend improvements to how claims information is captured, including standardized defect codes, required data fields and product or photo references.
Establish and maintain data quality standards to improve accuracy, consistency and reporting reliability.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve efficiency through automation and better data management practices.
Help build scalable processes that support future growth and evolving business needs.




Reporting, Dashboards & Documentation

Develop and maintain recurring claims reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
Create clear, accessible reporting that highlights key issues, trends and opportunities, including weekly claims summaries and monthly analysis by vendor, product and SKU.
Translate complex datasets into concise, meaningful insights that non-technical stakeholders can easily understand and act on.
Prepare ad hoc analysis and reporting to support leadership and cross-functional teams.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering data collection, cleaning, analysis and reporting.
Ensure reporting processes are well documented, repeatable and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Leverage AI tools, including Claude and ChatGPT, to support analysis, documentation, process improvement and productivity while maintaining appropriate data confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important function and build something meaningful from the ground up.

Within your first 12 months, success will look like:

Reliable claims visibility: The Quality team has access to consistent, trusted reporting that clearly identifies the most significant product claims and quality issues, eliminating the need for manual data gathering.
Consolidated data: All key claims data sources have been mapped, cleaned and brought together into a reliable dataset used across the business.
Actionable dashboards: Recurring Power BI dashboards and claims reports are established and actively used by Quality Control, Resolutions and brand teams.
Documented processes: Clear SOPs are in place for the end-to-end claims data process, ensuring consistency and continuity.
Measurable improvements: Insights from your analysis have helped drive corrective actions that result in measurable reductions in claims for targeted products, SKUs or vendors.
Strong partnerships: You have built credibility across departments and established yourself as a trusted resource for accurate data, meaningful insights and practical recommendations.

What You Bring
2 to 4 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst or similar analytical role, ideally within retail, e-commerce, furniture or consumer products.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH and data cleaning techniques.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI.
Experience extracting, consolidating and analyzing data from SAP or a comparable ERP system.
Strong understanding of data quality, data validation and working with information from multiple systems.
Ability to identify trends, investigate inconsistencies and translate data into clear business insights.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to non-technical audiences in a concise and engaging way.
Strong written communication skills, including experience documenting processes, procedures and SOPs.
Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, with an interest in using technology to improve efficiency and workflows.
Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A self-directed approach, with the confidence to take initiative, solve problems and build processes where they do not yet exist.




Nice to Have

Experience working with claims, returns, warranties, customer resolutions or product quality data.
Familiarity with quality control, product development, sourcing or vendor management.
Experience collaborating with teams across multiple time zones, particularly North America and Asia.
A degree in Business, Statistics, Data Analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in the furniture, fashion, retail or broader consumer goods industry.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys working with data and understands that great analysis is only valuable when it leads to meaningful action.




You bring a combination of analytical thinking and practical problem-solving. You are not someone who simply produces reports. You want to understand the business, uncover opportunities and contribute to better outcomes.




You are organized, resourceful and comfortable working independently. As the first dedicated analyst in this area, you are excited by the opportunity to build processes, introduce structure and take ownership of how things are done.




You also enjoy collaboration. You know how to work with different teams, communicate findings clearly and build relationships with stakeholders who may not share your technical background.

Above all, you are proactive, adaptable and motivated by the opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business.




Why Join Moe's Home Collection?

This is an opportunity to join a creative, entrepreneurial and people-first organization that values fresh ideas, collaboration and continuous improvement.




Make an impact: Step into a newly established role where you can shape reporting processes, build systems and directly influence product quality improvements.
Collaborative environment: Work alongside passionate and creative colleagues across multiple brands and departments.
Flexible work arrangements: Full-time hybrid/remote opportunity, with Vancouver, BC preferred.
Competitive compensation: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $70,000, plus bonus.
Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental and vision coverage, including enhanced mental health resources.
Time to recharge: Three weeks of vacation in your first year.
Professional development: Opportunities to learn, grow and expand your skills as the business evolves.
Product discounts: Generous discounts for employees, friends and family.
Workplace perks: A casual and open Vancouver office with views of downtown and the North Shore mountains, ergonomic sit-stand workstations, a stocked kitchen, free EV charging and an office gym.
Wellness benefits: Complimentary weekly spin classes at Ride Cycle Club in Vancouver and Toronto.

Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with various business units (Operations & Transportation, Finance, Supply Chain, ROP, REX, Centralized Routing) to understand their business needs and develop tailored automation or reporting solutions. Present automated data insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Serve as a liaison between technical teams (data ingestion, engineering) and business stakeholders to align automation efforts with priorities


Project Management


Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects focused on
data automation, insight generation, and continuous improvement. Track project milestones and ensure timely delivery of automation initiatives
Other projects or duties as assigned

Willingness to understand business operations and identify automation opportunities
Experience of scripting languages (like Python, R, SQL) and data process workflow automation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to explore alternative solutions that support data automation and process optimization insight delivery
Collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
This position must pass a post-offer background check

Master’s degree preferred

Title: Sr Analyst Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As part of the Performance Management area, this role will lead complex data management, analysis, and reporting work for the department. The Senior Data Analyst will translate business questions into scalable data solutions, monitor business performance, and deliver actionable insights through analytics and visualizations tailored to a range of audiences, including senior leaders.

The role will work closely with business subject matter experts, Technology teams, and data owners, while operating with a high degree of independence. The successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of enterprise data and data infrastructure, connect information across systems and platforms, and help establish practical standards and reusable solutions that improve the team’s analytics capabilities.

What You Will Do


Independently lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements and data discovery through solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable insights, communicating key drivers, limitations, implications, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leaders
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data models, semantic models, data marts, reports, and Power BI dashboards tailored to varied audiences
Work across enterprise systems, tools, and platforms to source, connect, transform, reconcile, validate, and analyze complex data that may be inconsistent, incomplete, or poorly documented
Partner with business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineers, data scientists, and data owners to define requirements, resolve data issues, and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions
Strengthen data quality, governance, documentation, and single-source-of-truth practices, while identifying opportunities to automate recurring work and create reusable analytical assets
Provide technical guidance, peer review, and knowledge sharing, and help establish practical standards that improve the team’s analytics capabilities
Independently manage multiple priorities and stakeholder relationships, using sound judgment, business acumen, and appropriate escalation


What You Will Bring


Minimum of three years of relevant experience and a university or college degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling, semantic model design, DAX, Power Query, dashboard development, performance optimization, security, deployment, and lifecycle management
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for data preparation, integration, reconciliation, validation, automation, analysis, and quality assurance
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex enterprise analytics, structure ambiguous problems, and manage multiple priorities with sound judgment
Experience working with large, messy datasets and modern data infrastructure, including warehouses or lakehouses, data marts, pipelines, APIs, cloud platforms, and system dependencies
Experience combining tools and platforms—such as Excel, Power BI, Databricks, SQL, Python or R, Azure services, and enterprise systems—to build reusable datasets and deliver end-to-end solutions
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with a commitment to data quality, governance, documentation, process improvement, and knowledge sharing
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Experience with Azure compute services, Azure Data Factory or similar orchestration tools, and relevant Microsoft certifications is an asset


The base salary for this position is between $80,400 - $130,400 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Are you someone who always strives to do the right thing, who steps up for themselves and others, and who delivers with impact? Then we want to hear from you!

Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.
