Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our analytics team and help deliver data-driven insights across product performance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, and business reporting.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, build and maintain reports and dashboards, analyze business trends, and provide leadership teams with accurate, actionable insights. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Location: You will be based in our Etobicoke office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Analytics – Product & Operations.

Posting Type: Replacement.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $71,000 - $100,000.

Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Your Moneris Career - What You'll Do


Build, maintain, and enhance recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical outputs used by business and leadership teams.
Analyze trends across product performance, customer onboarding, operational service levels, revenue, customer experience, sales channels, and business process efficiency.
Extract, validate, and analyze data from multiple systems using SQL, Excel, BI tools, and other analytics platforms.
Translate business questions into clear analysis, insights, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support recurring reporting cycles, leadership updates, performance reviews, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate and improve reporting processes.
Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.


Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role.
Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.


Your Moneris Career - What You Get

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.


Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).
Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.
Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.
Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.

An exciting opportunity exists to join as a Senior Data Analyst in the Wireless Service & Equipment Finance team. This position will be responsible for creating and maintaining Tableau dashboard that including dashboard design, creation, master data file building, data mining and measuring service & equipment revenue /usage KPIs and be able to be as story teller. Candidates will work very closely with various teams to provide value-added analysis on Wireless Revenue.

The Sr. Data Analyst will be based in Toronto and will provide expert data management to Wireless Service & Equipment Finance.

What You'll Do


Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.
Develop and maintain master datasets and reporting data layers using Databricks, SQL and Python, including data extraction, transformation, integration and validation from multiple data sources.
Build and automate weekly and monthly financial scorecards, dashboards and management reports, providing clear insights into performance trends and key business drivers.
Analyze large and complex datasets across multiple source systems to evaluate wireless subscriber, revenue, equipment, usage and other financial/business KPIs.
Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable data models, queries, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Write and optimize SQL queries and Databricks workflows to extract, join, cleanse, transform and aggregate large datasets for financial reporting and business analysis.
Use Python and SQL to automate recurring data preparation, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Develop visually effective dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify trends and investigate key drivers.
Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation between source systems, master datasets, financial results and reporting outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Investigate data discrepancies, data quality issues and potential data corruption; identify root causes and work with appropriate teams to implement solutions.
Support Financial Analysis, Pricing, Commercial Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams by providing reliable datasets, analytical insights and ad-hoc reporting.
Process and analyze data to support business cases, forecasting, performance measurement and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Define data requirements and business rules and ensure data extracts and reporting outputs are complete, accurate and fit for purpose.
Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with Data, Technology and IT teams to identify appropriate source systems, databases and tables and understand upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Present analytical findings to Finance and business stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business stories, key insights and actionable recommendations.


What You'll Bring


3+ years’ experience in data analytics/Business Intelligence, ideally within telecommunications.
Advanced Databricks and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
Strong Python and/or PySpark programming and data manipulation experience.
Advanced Tableau dashboard development; Power BI experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, transformation, quality, architecture, and data management.
Experience building master datasets, reusable reporting sources, and automated/scalable reporting solutions.
Strong Excel skills, including large datasets and financial analysis.
Experience with statistical, trend, variance, testing, and performance analysis.
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Insights-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and customer-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Senior Consultant - Data Analyst
Description:
À propos de Cognizant Consulting

Chez Cognizant Consulting, nous sommes bien plus qu’une équipe de service-conseil, nous formons une communauté mondiale de plus de 5 000 experts dévoués à accompagner nos clients dans la transformation de leur entreprise. Grâce à notre connaissance sectorielle et à notre expertise technologique, nous concevons des solutions d’affaires novatrices pour nos clients figurant au palmarès Fortune 500. Et maintenant, nous sommes à la recherche de notre prochain(e) collègue qui façonnera l’avenir des affaires. Et si c’était vous?

À propos du poste

En tant qu’Analyste de données vous aurez un impact en transformant des exigences d’affaires complexes en solutions de données claires et exploitables pour un client du secteur des services financiers, en analysant des données, en rédigeant des requêtes et en traduisant les besoins des parties prenantes en spécifications concrètes. Vous ferez partie intégrante de l’équipe de livraison en données et analytique et vous collaborerez avec des parties prenantes d’affaires, des ingénieurs de données et des équipes de livraison.

Ce que vous accomplirez


Analyser des ensembles de données complexes et rédiger des requêtes SQL performantes pour appuyer les besoins d’affaires et de production de rapports
Décomposer des exigences complexes en éléments plus petits et gérables et les traduire en spécifications claires
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes d’affaires et techniques afin de valider les hypothèses et de garantir l’exactitude des résultats
Documenter les besoins en données, la logique et les processus afin d’assurer la transparence et la continuité
Appuyer les équipes de livraison et d’ingénierie grâce à des analyses rigoureuses et à une résolution de problèmes fiable


Modalités de travail

Nous croyons que le travail hybride est l'avenir, et nous nous efforçons d'offrir de la flexibilité dans la mesure du possible. Compte tenu des exigences opérationnelles de ce poste, il s'agit d'un poste hybride nécessitant 2 jours par semaine au bureau de Cognizant ou chez un client à Mississauga, Ontario. Quel que soit votre modalité de travail, nous sommes là pour favoriser un équilibre travail-vie personnelle grâce à nos programmes de mieux-être.

Les modalités de travail pour ce poste sont exactes à la date de publication. Elles peuvent changer en fonction du projet dans lequel vous êtes engagé, ainsi que des exigences de Cognizant et du client. Soyez assuré(e) que nous serons toujours clairs sur les attentes liées au poste.

Compétences requises


Solide maîtrise du langage SQL et des langages de requête
Excellente capacité de logique pour décomposer des exigences complexes en plusieurs éléments plus petits
Personne dévouée et travaillante


Compétences désirées


Expérience dans un langage de programmation tel que Python et Java
Connaissance de SPARK et des services REST
Expérience en risque de marché


Nous avons hâte de rencontrer des personnes qui partagent notre mission et qui souhaitent contribuer de différentes façons. N’hésitez pas à postuler, même si vous ne répondez qu’aux compétences requises. Vos expériences et vos compétences transférables comptent, montrez-nous comment vous pourriez être la personne qu’il nous faut pour ce poste.

Salaire et autres formes de rémunération

Nous évaluons régulièrement les données du marché afin d’offrir une rémunération globale concurrentielle à nos associés. Le salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre 87 000,00 $ et 102 000,00 $ par année. La position du candidat retenu au sein de cette fourchette dépend de la formation, de l’expérience de travail ou de gestion pertinente et d’autres qualifications liées à l’emploi et à l’entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible au programme de boni annuel discrétionnaire fondé sur le rendement de Cognizant, ainsi qu’à des avantages sociaux qui soutiennent votre bien-être physique, mental et financier.

About Cognizant Consulting

Cognizant Consulting is where curious minds come together to solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact. Blending industry insight, technology expertise, and the power of AI, we partner with leading organizations to transform the way they work, serve customers, and grow.

About The Role

As a Data Analyst, you will make an impact by turning complex business requirements into clear, actionable data solutions for a client in the financial services sector, analyzing data, writing queries, and translating stakeholder needs into concrete specifications. You will be a valued member of the data and analytics delivery team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and delivery teams, and clients.

In this role, you will


Analyze complex data sets and write high-performing SQL queries to support business and reporting needs
Decompose complex requirements into smaller, manageable pieces and translate them into clear specifications
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to validate assumptions and ensure accurate outputs
Document data needs, logic, and processes to ensure transparency and continuity
Support delivery and engineering teams through rigorous analysis and reliable problem-solving


Work model

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mississauga, Ontario. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Must Have To Be Considered


Strong SQL and query language knowledge
Excellent logic to decompose complex requirements into multiple smaller pieces
Dedicated and hard-working


These will help you succeed


Experience in a programming language such as Python and Java
Knowledge of SPARK and REST services
Market risk experience


We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Salary And Other Compensation

We regularly assess market data to ensure we offer a competitive compensation package for our associates. The base salary for this position ranges between $87,000.00 – 102,000.00 per year. Where the successful candidate may fall within the range depends on relevant education, work and/or management experience and other business-related and job-necessary qualifications. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual performance-based bonus, as well as benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
About Hirevantis LLC

Hirevantis LLC is a leading IT staffing, technology consulting, and talent solutions provider. We bridge the gap between exceptional professional talent and top-tier cross-functional teams throughout North America. As we expand our presence across Canada, we are seeking a results-driven Business Data Analyst to turn data into actionable intelligence and drive commercial success for our enterprise business clients.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst with 3 years of professional experience who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and technical data analytics. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to collect, clean, and model complex datasets, building interactive tracking tools and dashboards that directly guide business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Synthesis & Visualization: Collect, structure, and clean raw operational data from multiple disparate production systems to create reliable truth metrics.
Dashboard & Report Engineering: Design, build, and optimize interactive business dashboards and automated reports using Tableau or Power BI.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison between technical teams and business units to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable corporate strategies.
Statistical Performance Analysis: Perform continuous trend evaluation, key performance indicator (KPI) monitoring, and data mining to identify operational bottlenecks and growth avenues.
Database Management: Write and refine advanced SQL queries, handling database scripts, triggers, and basic data governance metrics to ensure validation accuracy.
End-User Training: Train internal teams and client partners on navigating newly deployed dashboard tools to drive data culture autonomy.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, Data Management, or a related quantitative field.
Experience: Exactly 3+ years of direct experience working as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst.
Technical Mastery:
Exceptional proficiency in SQL for relational database querying.
Proven expertise with BI reporting software (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker).
Practical coding familiarity with scripting languages like Python or R for data wrangling.
Advanced command of MS Excel (including Power Query, pivot tables, and macro-modeling).
Core Competencies: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking capabilities with an unwavering attention to detail.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with a proven ability to present data-driven narratives to senior management.

Preferred Attributes

Prior experience working within an Agile / Scrum framework.
Familiarity with Canadian market metrics or working within distributed North American consulting networks.
Certifications such as the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP).

What We Offer

Competitive Canadian market salary commensurate with mid-level technical expertise.
Flexible work schedules (remote/hybrid flexibility matching local provincial standard time zones).
Extended health, dental, and professional development support pipelines.

BI Analyst, Poker Data & Insights

Location: Toronto, ON (onsite)

Salary: $60,000 - 80,000

Bonus: Maximum 50% per annum

Vacancies: 1 vacancy




Own the numbers behind the world's largest online poker site.




You will join a lean Business Intelligence team that reports directly to the Head of BI and works with senior leadership, marketing, CRM and finance every week. This is not a report-factory job. You will own the analysis behind decisions on growth, budgets and player experience, and you will see the impact within weeks.




We are looking for an experienced BI Analyst who is naturally curious, moves fast, and wants to know why a number moved, not just that it did. You won’t just build reports. You’ll own them, evolve them, and bring insights forward before anyone has to ask. If you spot something off in a dataset and can’t let it go until you understand it, we want to hear from you.




Duties and Responsibilities:

Monitoring and issue detection. Catch trends, anomalies and performance shifts before they become problems, and bring clear, actionable findings to stakeholders
Reporting and dashboards. Build and maintain Tableau dashboards and datasets that non-technical leaders understand instantly, including our weekly leadership growth and loss reporting
Player and business analysis. Analyze large, complex datasets to understand player behaviour, product performance and business trends, and connect each pattern to real business impact
Data design. Write and optimize SQL on our Snowflake data warehouse to meet changing stakeholder needs
KPI development. Lead and improve core metrics including LTV, churn, CAC and regional performance
Forecasting and budgeting. Track performance against forecasts, flag deviations, and support the monthly budgeting cycle with finance and country managers
Campaign and promotion ROI. Evaluate whether campaigns worked, and what we should do next
Executive communication. Turn complex findings into short summaries that drive decisions, not just inform them




Requirements - Soft Skills:

Fast learner who thrives under pressure. You pick things up quickly, adapt on the fly, and don't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed
Resourceful and self-directed. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it. You figure things out independently before escalating
Genuinely curious. You ask why, not just what. You dig into the data because you actually want to understand it
Strong ownership mentality. You treat your work like it's yours and don't wait to be told something needs fixing
Business and finance intuition. You understand what the numbers mean for the business, not just what they say on the surface
Clear, confident communicator. You can explain a complex finding to a non-technical executive in two sentences
Organized and detail-oriented. You QA your own work, catch your own errors, and don't ship something you're not confident in




Requirements - Technical Skills:

Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently
Experience with Tableau or other BI visualization tools (required)
Experience with Snowflake or equivalent cloud-based data warehouses (required)




Definitely Apply if You Have:

Experience in iGaming, fintech, or high-volume data environments (strong asset)
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment (asset)
Passion for poker, strategy games, or competitive gaming (asset)
Familiarity with KPI frameworks in a gaming or subscription or retention business
Experience supporting forecasting or budgeting cycles




Total Rewards:

Annual salary and level review
Up to 50% bonus per annum
Paid vacation and sick time off
Flexible and comprehensive benefits
Commute coverage

GGPoker Swag
Preferred Gym rate
Endless snacks and beverages

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Overview




We are seeking a hands-on and business-focused Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations.

The role will support Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management through performance reporting, data analysis, process automation, and actionable insights. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to monitor performance, investigate trends, and identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

This role is suited to an analyst who is comfortable working independently with data while continuing to develop their strategic and commercial analytics capability.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales & Lead Analytics – 20%

Monitor lead performance, contact rates, conversion, sales performance, and advisor productivity.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring performance reporting.
Analyze lead sources, customer segments, and sales funnel performance to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
Support sales optimization, lead allocation, capacity planning, and performance analysis.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to support Sales and Lead Management initiatives.




2. Care & Retention Analytics – 50%

Analyze post-sales customer and policyholder performance to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer experience.
Monitor and report on key Care & Support metrics, including retention, lapse, service levels, and customer engagement.
Conduct customer, cohort, and root-cause analysis to identify performance drivers.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.




3. Reporting, Automation & Data Quality – 20%

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual reporting and improve reporting efficiency through automation.
Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure reporting accuracy.
Maintain clear KPI definitions, reporting documentation, and analytical methodologies.




4. Business & Knowledge Support – 10%

Support ad-hoc analytical requests across Sales, Care & Support, and Lead Management.
Document key business processes, analytical methodologies, and reporting frameworks.
Support knowledge-sharing and knowledge-transfer activities across teams.
Provide analytical support for new market initiatives as required.




Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, Sales Analytics, Customer Analytics, or another regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills




Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience with automated reporting, data validation, and ETL processes.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing is desirable.
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and concepts is considered a nice-to-have.




Core Competencies




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into clear and actionable business insights.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Curious, commercially aware, and comfortable investigating business performance.
Customer-focused mindset with an interest in developing deeper business and strategic analytics capability.




Why Join Us




Work directly on analytics supporting sales growth and customer retention.
Gain exposure to multiple areas of the Life Insurance customer lifecycle.
Develop technical, commercial, and strategic analytics capability.
Work closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams.
Opportunity to contribute to automation, process improvement, and future market initiatives.




Benefits




That's why you can expect to be rewarded for the hard work you put in through job satisfaction, career development and the fantastic range of benefits we offer:




What's in it for you?




4 weeks vacation per year
10 paid sick days per year
Hybrid role – 3 days in office and 2 days work-from-home
100% employer paid health benefits from day 1 including $500 Healthcare Spending Account
Parental leave top-up
5% RRSP matching after 3 months of service
Learning and growth opportunities
Free weekly lunches, epic social events, and more!




If this role interests you, we would love to hear from you!

Provide education and subject matter expertise to the leadership teams and clinicians on data interpretation, and effective use of decision support tools, and analytic applications.
Manage and ensure the accurate and timely submission of external data, reports and required deliverables in accordance with established deadlines and reporting requirements.
Stay informed of emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in healthcare, business intelligence, data analytics and information management.




Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, and contribute effectively within multidisciplinary teams, supported by strong interpersonal skills and sound analytical and statistical capabilities.
Related undergraduate degree or diploma; Master’s degree considered an asset (MBA/Health Information Management/Computer Science).
Minimum 3 years experience in a decision support setting (hospital/health care environment) or relevant field.
At least 2 years previous experience in SQL Data Query Language is required.
Knowledge of statistical tools, such as R, Python, SAS etc.
Knowledge of databases and report writing tools/ business intelligence solutions like Tableau, PowerBI and Crystal Reports.
Strong computer knowledge and skills with proficiency in decision support tools and applications, databases, designing and generating reports and knowledge of business intelligence tools.
Essential experience with ATC/WTIS, CIHI acute and post-acute databases (DAD, NACRS, OMHRS, NRS, CCRS), MIS/OHRS, Meditech, EPIC, Integrated Decision Support (IDS) BI, Intellihealth Ontario is essential.
EPIC Cogito certification is an asset.
Experience with funding models (HBAM/GEM, QBPs, PCOP) is an asset.
Proficiency in data analysis, interpretation and presentation using MS Office tools is essential;
Project management abilities including excellent organization and time management skills to manage a demanding workload effectively in an environment of many conflicting and competing deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to establish and maintain strategic relationships and collaborative partnerships with diverse healthcare providers and stakeholders.




Please Note: Assignment subject to change based on the needs of the department.

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits


Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. WHO WE ARE




GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential. Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All. At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.




THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL




The Business Intelligence Analyst enables data‑driven decision‑making by delivering high‑quality, actionable insights aligned to organizational priorities. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, the role ensures analytics solutions are scalable, accurate, and governed by enterprise data standards. Through proactive performance monitoring and analysis, the Analyst supports strategic and operational improvement across the organization.

Responsibilities include:

Design, develop, and maintain business intelligence reports, dashboards, and metrics aligned with strategic and operational goals.
Translate business requirements into technical specifications and partner with data and analytics teams to deliver effective BI solutions.
Ensure data integrity, governance, and consistency by adhering to enterprise data standards and architecture.
Monitor key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Conduct ad‑hoc and deep‑dive analyses to support leadership decision‑making and business initiatives.
Present insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Support and enable business users through guidance on BI tools, data interpretation, and best practices.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Post‑secondary degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field.
3+ years of hands‑on experience designing and delivering BI reports, dashboards, and scorecards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong technical proficiency in data querying, transformation, and modeling using SQL and related languages (e.g., DAX, Power Query, M).
Experience developing end‑to‑end BI solutions, including ETL processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure Synapse, Snowflake, BigQuery).
Proven ability to work with large, complex datasets and translate business requirements into scalable, actionable insights while ensuring data quality and governance.
Strong communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills, with experience engaging both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.




NICE TO HAVE

Knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, R) for advanced analytics or automation.
Exposure to machine learning or predictive analytics concepts and their integration into BI workflows.
Background in training or mentoring business users on BI tools and data literacy.
Bilingual in French and English.




WHAT WE OFFER

Base Salary: CAD $59,688.00 - 91,109.00

Offer positioning: Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.

(if eligible - add this) Additional compensation: Eligible for a discretionary target bonus.

Total rewards: Health and dental coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and well-being support (up to $10,000 per year for mental health).

Posting disclosures: This is for a new vacancy.

Work model: Hybrid

Offer positioning: Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.




THE CULTURE

We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.




Where your growth means our growth.

Where your voice is heard and valued.

Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.




We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.




Here’s to Better Health for All!

Proficiency in English is required for this position. As part of this role, you will be required to communicate with colleagues or customers who use English as their primary language. By requiring English proficiency for this position, we aim to ensure that our employees can excel in their roles, collaborate, and communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of our organization.

GS supports diversity, equity and inclusion in our teams and communities, and we value the unique contributions made by all. Posting Status: Open

Location: (On-site) 26 Prince Andrew Place, North York, ON, M3C 2H4

Salary Band: $75,185 - $105,116 per year

Hours of Work: 36.25 per week

Posting Date: October 13, 2026

Closing Date: October 27, 2026




Who we are

The Office of the Chief Electoral Officer (Elections Ontario) is an independent, non-partisan office of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario, responsible for administering provincial elections, by-elections, and referenda.




At the heart of our work is a commitment to democracy – making voting easy and accessible for all electors, while maintaining the integrity, security, and transparency of the electoral process.




Join our team

The Elector Data & Analytics Division is seeking a skilled and curious Business Intelligence Analyst to help assess the accuracy and the quality of Ontario's Register of Electors and related geographic products and services.




In this role, you will apply data management, spatial analysis, research, and information modelling techniques to support the Permanent Register of Electors of Ontario. You will work with large and complex datasets, including elector, address, property, and geographic information, to deliver insights that support decision making.




What you can expect in this role

Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence, you will:

Support the development and delivery of advanced analytics and research pertaining to the quality of information in the Permanent Register of Electors of Ontario.
Identify, integrate, and maintain information and models for assessing the provincial register of electors’ data. This involves integrating datasets of addresses, properties, and a repository of geographical and administrative spatial assets.
Define, implement, and track key quality metrics and performance indicators for evaluating the quality of information maintained in the provincial register and disseminated as list and geographical products and services to provincial and municipal stakeholders.
Provide education and guidance to team members and external stakeholders on understanding business intelligence research initiatives.
Consult and collaborate with staff from other functions to create actionable recommendations. Advise the Manager on the implications of business proposals, projects, and decisions affecting register information.




What you need to qualify

Required skills and experience:

Demonstrated knowledge of information modelling, data analysis, data processing methodologies, and research methods.
Experience writing SQL queries, procedures, and data processing workflows, preferably using Microsoft SQL Server/T-SQL.
Experience using version control systems, preferably Git, with a preference working with Azure DevOps.
Demonstrated experience in analyzing tabular and spatial data using GIS software, tools, and datasets.
Experience with business intelligence applications and development tools such as Microsoft Power BI, to design appropriate Business Intelligence applications, measures, and tests to evaluate data.

Assets:

Experience in a legislative, regulatory, public sector, or broader public service environment, particularly where data management and measurement frameworks support statutory obligations.
Experience conducting quantitative research and applying statistical methodologies to support decision making.
Experience working with Statistics Canada population and demographic datasets.
Experience working with Ontario-based datasets such as those from Land Information Ontario (LIO) and TERANET.
Experience with statistical tools or programming languages such as R, SAS, Python or similar analytical platforms.
Experience in automating processes such as the generation of quantitative reports would be an asset.
Education: A degree in one of the following disciplines: Mathematics, Statistics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Political Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be legally entitled to work in Canada.




This role requires in-office presence five (5) days per week. There is no hybrid option.




The successful candidate will be required to complete criminal background and social media checks as part of the hiring process.




How to apply

Our recruitment process reflects our mission to uphold the integrity and accessibility of the electoral process and to manage elections in an efficient, fair, and impartial manner. We offer career growth opportunities and a competitive rewards program.




Please submit your cover letter and resume as one PDF attachment, using format: EO-2026-116, First Name Last Name in the subject line, to jobs@elections.on.ca, no later than 4:00 PM on October 27, 2026.




Please note: Applications without a cover letter will not be accepted.




We thank all applicants for their submission, but only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.




How to request an accommodation

Elections Ontario is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment, where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.




Under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Ontario Human Rights Code, we provide accommodation for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. If you require a disability-related accommodation to participate, please call 1-888-668-8683, send a fax to 1-866-714-2809, TTY at 1-888-292-2312 or email hr@elections.on.ca.




At Elections Ontario, all resumes are screened by the Talent Acquisition team and Hiring Managers, without the use of AI. Criminal record checks also do not use AI. However, AI technology is used when conducting social media checks.




Elections Ontario posts salaries in accordance with ESA pay/transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary range are determined through various factors, including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge and applicable skill sets.

Title: Data Analyst, Reporting
Description:
The Data Analyst, Reporting is responsible for delivering accurate financial and business reporting and providing insights that support the needs of clients and internal stakeholders. This role translates stakeholder needs into clear reports, dashboards and recurring deliverables.


Develop and maintain complex financial and non-financial reports and dashboards for client, management and business needs.
Support improvements to the firm’s reporting capability by assessing and applying appropriate tools and approaches.
Prepare data from various sources for reporting and analysis in Excel, Power BI and other business intelligence tools.
Interpret financial and business information to identify trends, risks and relevant insights for stakeholders.
Translate stakeholder objectives, measures and requirements into clear and accurate reporting deliverables.
Validate and reconcile reports, dashboards and underlying data, resolving discrepancies before distribution.
Prepare client reporting packages, including quarterly and annual presentations, financial templates and ad hoc information.
Develop matter management reports for clients and internal stakeholders.
Advise lawyers and Business Services professionals on reporting requirements, deliverables and interpretation.
Provide reporting and analytical coverage during absences, peak periods and changing business needs.
Maintain documentation for data sources, reporting requirements, calculations and processes.
Review reports, dashboards and supporting analysis prepared by other Analysts for accuracy, completeness and appropriate interpretation.
Provide financial data, reporting and analytical support for projects and firm initiatives.



Qualifications


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Finance or Accounting, or equivalent experience, is essential.
3 to 5 years of related experience, preferably within a professional services firm.
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, with expert knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, is required.
Working knowledge of SQL and Power Query in Excel is required. Experience with Power BI Desktop, MDX, and/or DAX would be an asset.
Experience in extracting data from a complex accounting system is required. Experience with 3E would be an asset.



Core Competencies


Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly grasp complex assignments; the aptitude to analyze a variety of considerations, determine what’s important, and assess possible courses of action.
Ability to plan, organize, schedule, and deliver within tight deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
Strong client service orientation combined with the ability to manage multiple client needs at the same time.
Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the organization with tact and diplomacy.
Ability to build strong working relationships with key stakeholders of the firm.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work well both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong aptitude for utilizing technology and continuous process improvement.
Sound judgment including the ability to deal with confidential information with utmost discretion.
Exceptional attention to detail.



Hybrid

This position is part of our hybrid work model with 3 days in the office per week. As part of our onboarding, new hires are required to be in the office more often for the first few months of employment to ensure they receive the requisite cross training.

Toronto

Job Title

Sr. Analyst, Loyalty Analytics

Canada Goose isn't like anything else. We've built something great, something special - an iconic lifestyle brand with an inspirational and authentic story. At the heart of it is our promise to inspire and enable all people to thrive in the world outside. To Live in the Open. At Canada Goose, you're part of a movement that belongs to something bigger. Here, opportunities are everywhere - to try something new, to learn, to do meaningful and impactful work, and they're yours for the taking.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Loyalty Analytics Analyst to lead data-driven insights for our CRM & loyalty program. You will own the analytics function for loyalty, turning complex customer, transaction, and engagement data into strategic recommendations that boost retention, increase lifetime value, and maximize program ROI. This is a high-impact senior role where your expertise will directly shape loyalty strategy.

What You'll Do

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Metergy Solutions Inc. (“Metergy”)
Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Our Mission
Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with passion, thrives on positivity, and delivers with precision. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

Metergy office location is in Markham but will be moving to North York toward the end of 2026!
Position Summary
The Business Intelligence analyst is accountable for the management, development and execution of the Business Intelligence (BI) & Revenue Assurance Program, Annual Rate Increases, operations dashboards, and reporting, and overall Gross Margin (GM) Integrity.

Key Responsibilities:


Extract, clean, and analyze large volumes of data to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Conduct deep dive business intelligence analysis into operational areas within Operations to provide analysis and insight on the interplay between the various key performance indicators (e.g., workforce performance & management, Revenue Assurance, productivity, cost and quality drivers).
Effectively collaborate with stakeholders to develop insights and recommendations to enable strategic discussions among leadership.
Provided monthly management insight for performance opportunities, financial Rate and Volume variance analysis to help identify resource allocation opportunities
Accountable for understanding regulation changes and launching organizational projects to implement changes in all impacted areas in submetering (includes non-responsible departments)
Plans, develops and approves all operational policies in all functional areas, with standard operating procedures, and quality management systems for revenue assurance
Monitor daily performance against key metrics to identify opportunities and anomalies
Constantly review current operational processes and be a strategic partner in making recommendations for improvements
Work with all departmental owners to implement and ensure controls are in place to support the lead to cash process for all (billing model) revenue streams
Develop and champion revenue leakage issues across organization by engaging key stakeholders on activity and resource requirements necessary to drive revenue maximization
Stay updated on the latest trends in Business Intelligence, data analytics and emerging technologies
Evaluate and incorporate new tools or techniques that could enhance BI capabilities.


Qualifications:


Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Math, Economics, or other quantitative fields.
Preference to additional training with Data Analytics / IT
Preference for industry experience with Utilities, Telecommunications, or other large consumer base businesses within North American juristictions (250k+ customers)
5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Operations, or relevant work experience at a fast-growing utility company is preferred.
High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL
Excellent collaboration skills to build strong working partnerships with stakeholders.
Understanding and experience working with statistical revenue and costing information to provide business insight and opportunities to reduce cost.
Strong technical skills to mine large volumes of data.
Ability to apply superior data knowledge & discovery skills into building effective analysis.
Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.
Industry or working experience with customer billing environments with large transaction volumes such as Utility or Telecommunications,
Attention to detail and quality, strong time management and project/work planning skills.
Proven ability to work with and deliver Industry Leading Best-in-Class reporting and analytical solutions.
Excellent interpersonal and customer interaction skills to include communications, presentation and conflict resolution skills


Any shown ranges reflects base salary. We offer discretionary bonus and additional benefits, including health and retirement, as part of our total rewards program.

Benefits & Perks

Fully company covered heath and dental benefits from day 1
Company funded Health Spending Account
Plan for retirement with Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP) and RRSP Matching
Grow with us! We provide support for continuous learning.
Paid personal and sick days on top of your vacation
Summer hours to enjoy the weather
Company sponsored social events & more!


This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our recruitment process includes accommodation for applicants with disabilities. All accommodations will consider the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability and are available upon request.
