Company Overview

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future. Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

Business Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Reporting and Analysis, the Data & Visual Insights Analyst supports the organization's reporting, analytics and business intelligence functions by gathering, organizing, analyzing and distributing insights that feed operational, financial and strategic decision-making. The role is responsible for maintaining recurring reports, designing dashboards, administering data feeds, monitoring data quality, performing foundational analyses, and assisting with reporting automation initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior analysts and business leaders, develop technical expertise in reporting, SQL, data management, visualization, and business intelligence while helping stakeholders understand business performance through accurate and timely information. They will also be detail-oriented, intellectually curious professionals with a passion for data and continuous learning.They combine strong analytical thinking, technical aptitude, and business awareness to deliver accurate reporting and actionable insights. Through reliable report delivery, strong stakeholder support, and ongoing development of SQL, reporting, visualization, and analytical skills, they build the foundation for progression into senior analytics and business intelligence roles.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Reporting & Performance Monitoring


Maintain and update daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports
Produce recurring operational, financial, and management reporting packages
Administer systematic reporting processes and ensure reports are delivered accurately and on schedule
Monitor business performance metrics and identify notable trends and exceptions
Assist with report enhancements and modifications based on stakeholder requirements
Coordinate reporting activities and support reporting schedules across business areas


Dashboard Development & Data Visualization


Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and visual reports that communicate business performance
Design basic visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
Support senior analysts in dashboard development and reporting projects
Prepare presentations and reporting materials that communicate analytical findings effectively
Apply visualization best practices and standardized reporting formats


Data Quality, Governance & Data Management


Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple systems
Maintain critical reporting tables, data repositories, and reporting datasets
Document source tables, data definitions, business rules, and reporting processes
Identify, investigate, and escalate data quality issues and reporting discrepancies
Support data governance initiatives and maintain compliance with reporting standards
Assist with the management of internal and third-party data feeds used for reporting and analysis


Data Analysis & Insights


Gather, organize, and analyze data from multiple sources
Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business questions and decision-making
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement
Support senior analysts in evaluating operational and financial performance
Provide meaningful business context and insights alongside analytical outputs
Assist with performance measurement and KPI reporting initiatives


Data Retrieval


Write and maintain basic queries to retrieve and validate data using the appropriate tool/scripting language for the task
Extract data for dashboards, reports, and analytical projects.
Learn relational database concepts, reporting structures, and data models.
Support reporting automation and data optimization initiatives.
Assist with maintaining reporting datasets and data warehouse structures


Reporting Automation & Process Improvement


Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities.
Assist with optimization of existing reports and reporting workflows.
Support efforts to improve reporting efficiency, speed, and usability.
Help eliminate redundant reports and streamline information delivery processes.
Participate in reporting enhancement and data management projects


Stakeholder Support & Training


Work closely with managers and business partners to understand reporting requirements.
Respond to data and reporting inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Assist in educating end users on reporting tools, data sources, and analytical capabilities.
Build positive working relationships across departments.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly and effectively


The Expertise You Bring


Analytics & Problem Solving
Data Management
Business Intelligence & Reporting, visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Business Objects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Communication & Professional Skills


Experience, Education


University Degree in Computer Science, Finance. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, related analytical discipline or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics or a related field
Experience working with data, spreadsheets, reports, or dashboards.
Exposure to SQL, BI tools, or reporting systems is considered an asset.
Experience analyzing data and communicating findings through reports or presentations is preferred


Nice to Have


Financial services experience considered an asset
Basic understanding of financial reporting and performance analysis
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts
CPA, or other analytical or business designations considered an asset

Job Description

WHO WE ARE:

We are TRACK – a member of the RAPP family– world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.  

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

How We Do It

At TRACK, our fearless super connectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning. 

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients. 

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets. The TRACK team makes up 100 of those.

Your Role

As a Senior Analyst, you will be responsible for contributing to campaign reporting and dashboarding projects that help our clients understand how their CRM marketing is performing and help them answer strategic questions about their customers using data.

The Analyst leverages data visualization, data manipulation and statistics knowledge to inform our CRM experience and testing strategy and evaluate impact of our marketing programs.

We seek an individual who is detailed and data driven – and who will continuously seek out new ways of working focusing on opportunities for automation and the use of AI.

We’re looking for a true teammate – someone willing to lend a hand, no matter the ask, so that we can all succeed together. We love crafting exciting, conceptual campaigns, but we are also passionate about bringing excellence to the day-to-day brand communications that our clients rely on. That’s how we make ourselves invaluable and earn their trust.

This role requires navigating fast-paced, client-focused environments with multiple deadlines and conflicting priorities.

Your Responsibilities


Contribute and/or lead client reporting and analysis projects
Create campaign labeling and tracking
Create timely and accurate reporting
Deliver insights that inform strategy and drive measurable outcomes.
Work closely with internal teams, clients, and partners to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
Analyze marketing and customer data to measure campaign performance, identify trends, and provide data-driven insights to optimize marketing strategies and improve ROI.
Build client-ready dashboards.
Manage your workload and identify risks.
Present complex analytical findings in a clear, engaging manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure high standards for data quality, integrity, and privacy across all client work.
Stay current on analytics tools, technologies (including AI) and industry trends; champion innovation and continuous improvement.


Required Skills


Undergraduate degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or related quantitative discipline
At least 3 years of analytics experience, preferably 1+ years with an Advertising, Marketing, Analytics, or Digital Media firm
Demonstrated experience with customer data, media & marketing measurement and CRM analytics. An understanding of core marketing analytics concepts including email, SMS and Web metrics.
Advanced Excel skills
Proficiency with analytics and data visualization tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Power BI).
Advanced level SQL programming skills. Familiarity with Python.
Hands-on skills in statistical analysis and/or modeling (regression, segmentation, forecasting, etc.)
Extensive knowledge of database marketing principles and database structure
Presentation skills, data storytelling and the ability to simplify and package complex ideas for presentation and into client-ready documents.
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Natural curiosity and an aptitude for continuous learning.
Demonstrated ability to effectively maintain focus while working on multiple complex projects and to work with minimal supervision.


Our Perks


Generous PTO policy
Comprehensive health and dental plans
Paid personal and sick days
Birthday day off
Hybrid work model
Tuition reimbursement program
Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning
Telecoms monthly allowance
RRSP company match
Referral bonus

TRACK's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, with in-office attendance the rest of the week from our Toronto office.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The salary range for this role is $75,000-$85,000. Salary range 75,000-100,000

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company Overview

Exacare ai is a leading health tech company on a mission to build the AI operating system for post-acute care. Our platform turns messy, unstructured referral packets into clear clinical insights and next steps, so teams can make faster, safer placement decisions with less administrative burden. Today, exacare ai powers more than 2,000 facilities, and is growing rapidly.




We recently raised a $30M Series A led by Insight Partners, and are bringing world-class talent together to transform healthcare. If you like building, learning, and want to make a real impact, come join us!




About the Role

Exacare ai is hiring a Data Analyst to develop and scale our customer-facing analytics offering and embed data in everyday workflows and processes. You will work hand-in-hand with the Data Lead to stand up this function and shape how data is leveraged internally and productized externally at exacare.




Exacare has a uniquely rich dataset and is well poised to provide immense value to its customers; it captures critical operational and clinical signals that are largely invisible to our customers today. Unlocking it represents one of the biggest opportunities to create differentiated product value and long-term competitive advantage. Data includes: benchmarking across 2000+ facilities, 3M+ referrals processed, and is growing in depth and in scope as we continue to roll out to more customers and introduce new product features. This data is heavily underleveraged today, and this role exists to transform it into a core product offering and competitive advantage.This role bridges robust analytical capabilities and customer-facing product value.




This individual will co-develop data solutions, working directly with customers and other stakeholders to communicate key insights and understand opportunities to embed our data and analytics into their workflows. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing complex data and building dashboards as they are presenting insights to customers and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. You’re a curious, data-minded problem-solver who can operate independently and translate complex data into products, insights, and workflows that drive measurable outcomes for customers and cross-functional stakeholders.




What You’ll Do




Data Product & Strategy

Identify and evaluate new opportunities to productize Exacare's data: determine which insights, analytics capabilities, and AI-driven features can deliver the most customer value and competitive differentiation
Work closely with the Product Team to scope and build-out reporting for new features as they are shipped, ensuring our reporting offering evolves to keep pace with broader enhancements being made to the product
Translate business and customer needs into clear data requirements for Product, Engineering, and technical data partners




Customer Enablement

Lead execution for all customer-facing data and reporting, including building and maintaining dashboards and reports, as well defining standardized processes/systems for bespoke reporting requests
Support high-stakes customer and prospect moments from a data and analytics perspective (i.e., preparing customer-ready materials, joining key meetings as the ‘voice of data’)
Serve as the primary escalation point for customer reporting issues, diagnosing and resolving problems independently




Internal Intelligence

Partner with Sales, BizOps, and other functions to develop internal dashboards, customer-facing artifacts, and other data tooling to embed data & analytics into key internal workflows and processes
Identify patterns in ad hoc requests and recommend ways to improve processes, dashboards, documentation, or product functionality
Support the roll-out of all internal data-related initiatives including developing training cadences for internal teams




What You’ll Bring




Core experience

1-2 years in data / product analytics, strategy consulting, business operations, or a similar analytical role
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Hands-on experience with BI and reporting tools; experience with Omni, Looker, Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms strongly preferred
Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including comfort with complex array/lookup formulas and experience building robust models to produce clear, usable outputs
Experience working directly with customers or key stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, validate ideas, communicate insights, and manage feedback loops
Track record of driving data initiatives from problem definition to delivery, including managing backlogs, making trade-offs, and aligning cross-functional teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations while garnering buy-in from stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to connect complex technical features directly to customer value, user needs, and business outcomes (like ROI, efficiency gains, or retention)
Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in a fast-moving startup environment




Preferred

Experience in strategy consulting or customer-facing analytics
Experience building analytics or data products in a high-growth B2B SaaS, health tech, or healthcare operations environment
Familiarity with product usage analytics, benchmarking, data exports, or recurring customer reporting workflows
Strong SQL skills and deep familiarity with relational database design
Exposure to modern data stack tools, data warehouses, or analytics engineering workflows




Benefits + Perks

Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup
Flexible PTO, take what you need
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Great startup culture, including company off-sites
High-achieving team, including ex-FAANG engineers and alumni of Bain, BCG, Goldman Sachs, and more







An insight into our Core Values




Only the best belong here

We are unapologetic about talent. This should be the best team you have ever been on. Protecting that standard is how we honor each other’s time, ambition, and craft.




We work even harder to keep our partners than we did to earn them initially

The work does not stop when a customer first onboards to our platform. It deepens over time. We partner with operators, listening and learning about real problems, and translate that into solutions that help them succeed in practice. We earn trust through consistent delivery.




We keep the patient downstream of every decision

At the end of the day, this is about the patient. We get there by deeply respecting and reflecting on our purpose: to develop software that aids teams in delivering better care.




Raise the bar on ownership

We grow because people here go beyond the minimum. We invest extra effort, care, and ownership into what we build.




The world is moving fast. We move faster.

This is a race. We work hard, we move early, and we stay ahead of problems and competitors. If we slow down, someone else will pass us.




Radical candor, zero politics

We say what’s true, early, and we keep communication direct and clean so the team can move.




Bring good vibes and win together

We win as a team. We bring energy, support each other, and make the workplace somewhere people are excited to show up.




If this sounds like you, we'd love to have a chat!

We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of work. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world.

What will you do?

Position Overview

The Senior Business Data Analyst translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

This is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

You will join the Smart Infrastructure, Asset Management Software Information Technology (SI AMS IT) Data & AI team and work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and other commercial functions. Marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in Marketing Analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

The role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative Data & AI team. You will work with modern technologies including Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and AI capabilities. We expect you to be an early adopter of generative AI, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES | You’ll make an impact by:

Business Partnership And Requirements Engineering


Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
Handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
Resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
Build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
Lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
Collaborate with global stakeholders across North America and Europe, with core working hours aligned to Eastern Time business operations.


Data Analysis and Insight Generation


Extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced SQL and analytical tools.
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
Apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
Assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
Use generative AI tools, such as Claude Code or GH Copilot, to accelerate SQL, dbt, and Power BI development, and share what works with the team.


Data Products and Business Intelligence


Design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using Power BI, Qlik, and other relevant tools.
Create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
Contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
Support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.


Data Modeling and Technical Delivery


Understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
Create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
Work with platforms such as Snowflake and tools such as dbt.
Investigate analytical data issues and partner with Data Engineering on production pipelines and shared models.


End to End Solution Ownership


Own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
Act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from Data Engineering, Data Science, BI, AI, and other specialists.
Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
Share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.


Data Quality and Governance


Apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
Identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
Maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
Support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.


Location: This is a REMOTE role, with a preference for those located in or near the Eastern Time Zone due to regular collaboration with global colleagues in Germany. Candidates must be able to sustainably accommodate the working hours required for effective cross-time-zone collaboration.

What will you need to succeed?

Experience & Business Partnership:


7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
Proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.


Data & Analytics Expertise:


Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
Strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using Power BI, Qlik, or comparable BI platforms.


Platforms & Technology:


Hands-on experience with Salesforce or other CRM data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
Experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or comparable technologies.


Core Competencies:


Ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.


You'll Thrive Even More If You Also Bring:


Experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
Experience supporting Marketing Analytics or other commercial functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Finance.
Hands on experience with Snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
Python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
Experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
Familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, AI enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
Experience supporting SaaS, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.


What Does Success Look Like?

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:


Become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
Handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
Turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
Deliver reliable analysis, data models, and BI solutions with limited day to day support.
Navigate SI AMS data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
Become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
Collaborate effectively with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and other specialist functions.
Produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
Contribute to a scalable and resilient Data & AI environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.
Define measurable success criteria and experimentation approaches to evaluate business initiatives, campaigns, and AI-driven solutions

Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects.

Analyze fraud trends, loss drivers, operational performance, and customer behavior.
Conduct ad hoc investigations and analytical deep dives to identify emerging fraud risks.
Develop, maintain, and enhance fraud dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting.

Preferred

Analytical thinking and critical problem-solving
Investigative mindset and intellectual curiosity
Strong stakeholder communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Continuous learning and process improvement mindset

Title: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence
Description:
As a Senior Analyst on the Market Intelligence team at Canadian Tire Corporation, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing competitive intelligence and pricing strategies across multiple banners. You will work collaboratively with cross‑functional partners to translate competitive pricing data into actionable insights that inform pricing decisions at both national and regional levels.

This role is ideal for a strong data analyst or analytics‑leaning candidate who enjoys working with complex datasets, building analytical workflows, and translating data into insights that directly inform pricing and executive decision‑making. Your insights will directly support pricing strategy, executive decision‑making, and the continued evolution of Market Intelligence as a more data‑driven, insight‑led capability.

What You'll Do


Own advanced analysis of competitive pricing data across banners, supporting national and regional initiatives, including competitive pricing behaviour, dispersion, and positioning
Design and execute structured, repeatable analytical approaches that move beyond ad‑hoc reporting to support scalable insight generation
Build and enhance analytical workflows (ex. KNIME-based workflows) to support ongoing pricing analysis, monitoring, and insight delivery, evolving processes from manual to more automated and standardized where appropriate
Translate complex competitive pricing datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform pricing strategy, regional decisions, and leadership discussions
Support the readiness, structure, and usability of competitive pricing data to ensure it is fit for downstream analytics, reporting, and decision‑making
Design, build, and maintain standardized reports and interactive dashboards (ex. Power BI) to monitor competitive pricing, trends, and performance across initiatives
Develop reporting that clearly communicates insights, key drivers, and exceptions to cross‑functional teams and leadership
Ensure all reporting and insights are delivered with appropriate context, assumptions, definitions, and implications to support informed decision‑making
Support executive‑level materials by embedding analytical depth, clear visuals, and concise narratives into competitive pricing updates and presentations
Collaborate closely with Pricing Strategy, Regional Pricing, and Merchandising teams to support and expand Market Intelligence initiatives
Partner with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate business questions into well‑structured, actionable analyses
Act as a senior contributor to ensuring competitive data accuracy, consistency, and analytical integrity.
Partner closely with internal teams and external vendor to investigate data issues, define business logic, and resolve data quality challenges.
Proactively identify data gaps or risks and recommend improvements to strengthen analysis and outputs.


What You Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics, pricing, market intelligence, business intelligence, or a related analytical role, preferably within retail, pricing, or a data‑driven business environment
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative or analytical discipline

Title: Business and Market Data Analyst
Description:
The Ontario Securities Commission (OSC) is the statutory body responsible for regulating Ontario’s capital markets in accordance with the mandate established in the provincial Securities Act and the Commodity Futures Act. The mandate of the OSC is to provide protection to investors from unfair, improper or fraudulent practices, to foster fair, efficient and competitive capital markets and confidence in the capital markets, to foster capital formation, and to contribute to the stability of the financial system and the reduction of systemic risk. This mandate is performed through policy, operational, and enforcement activities. The OSC also contributes to national and global securities regulation development.




We offer a diverse, fair, and flexible work environment and take pride in our challenging and rewarding work.




The Investment Management Division oversees the regulation of investment funds and structured products that offer securities to the public in Ontario. Our function in the OSC’s mandate of providing investors protection is a vital one. We have a leadership role in developing new rules and policies within the OSC and within the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA) to adapt to the changing environment in the investment fund and structured products industry. Our scope of activity includes reviewing and considering investor protection issues related to the offerings of investment products (including mutual funds, exchange traded funds, structured products, scholarship plans and labour-sponsored funds); assessing product disclosure, including prospectus and continuous disclosure filings; and considering applications for discretionary relief from Ontario securities legislation and rules.




The Business and Market Data Analyst position will involve playing a key role in profiling the activities of the Investment Management Division by reporting on the success and impact of Division initiatives and core work processes. The Divisions core processes include rule and policy consultation, prospectus and exemptive relief application reviews and issue-oriented reviews of important regulatory development. The Business and Market Data Analyst’s primary function will be to support the Division’s core processes by conducting research, collecting and interpreting market data and activities and supporting special policy projects the Division undertakes (i.e. Risk Methodologies, and Regulatory burden-reduction initiatives).




Reporting to the Manager, Analytics, the Business and Market Data Analyst will be instrumental in developing, maintaining and analyzing key financial data to measure, and report on, internally and for publication (i.e. quarterly and annual reports).




Key Duties and Responsibilities:




Market Research for Division Core Processes




Provide research, including conducting background research on topics relating to investment activities in the funds industry, novel investment products, capital market development, and investor protection concerns, as requested.
With division staff identify, plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative market research to inform on mutual funds industry trends which impact on core Division processes and decisions, including prospectus, application and continuous disclosure reviews.
Conduct analysis of investment products’ attributes and risks using internally developed analytical datasets and frameworks.
Monitor, assess and interpret trends in the investment funds and structured products markets, both in Canada and globally, and prepare and design requirements on these trends.
Proactively identify additional market data and information to collect, maintain and analyze which is conducive to the efficient and effective operation of Investment Management Division.
Identify problems whereby efficiencies can be achieved, research and evaluate various alternatives and proceed with the most efficient solution.
Assess data quality, completeness, and limitations, and document analytical assumptions and methodologies. Present research findings to the Division management team, senior staff, policy project leads and/or committees (i.e. CSA) and address questions and/or defend analysis.




Data Collection, Preparation and Analysis




Work with other divisions to identify, evaluate, access, organize, clean, validate, and maintain internal and external data sources required to support Division research, analysis, and reporting.
Maintain analytical datasets and models to support market monitoring, operational oversight, and risk‑based analysis.
With division staff interpret information related to Division operations, analyze market data, and present and report issues, findings and trends that impact on the work of the Division.




Reporting, Dashboards, and Performance Measurement




Develop, maintain dashboards and report, using Division-wide operational performance measures, to better reflect how the Division is meeting its mandate (i.e. for use in quarterly reports).
Analyze trends, anomalies, and emerging risks in market and operational data and surface issues that may require supervisory, policy, or operational action.




Enterprise Systems and Data Access




Leverage enterprise systems and platforms to extract and use data required for Division analysis and reporting.
Coordinate with enterprise system and digital teams as required to ensure appropriate data access and alignment with organizational standards.




Skills & Qualifications:




Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collect, organize, and translate data into clear insights.
Knowledge of financial markets and investment products, including mutual funds and ETFs, with the ability to analyze market trends and interpret data.
Excellent presentation, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills.
Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated tact and sensitivity when negotiating with diverse parties.
Ability to interact professionally with management and professionals at various levels.
Demonstrated ability to respond to ad hoc unstructured problems with planning, flexibility, communication and execution.
Demonstrated ability to conduct research and prepare dashboards.
Ability to work with minimal direction and prioritize and meet strict deadlines.
Knowledge or experience in the securities industry.
Understanding of investment funds regulation and funds’ operations.




Education & Training:




University degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
Experience working with data analysis and visualization skills with, data science tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Python and SQL for data preparation, automation and analytical initiatives.
A minimum of 3-5 years of intermediate-level experience in the financial and/or regulatory sector, performing a similar function. Equivalent combinations of education, experience, and demonstrated competencies will be considered.
Understanding of the Canadian securities regulatory environment, with the capability of assessing the impact of various regulatory actions on stakeholders and the capital markets.
Basic knowledge of the Ontario Securities Act, regulations, policy statements, rules and internal operating procedures.
High proficiency in the MS Office suite of products.
Completion of the Canadian Securities Course, an asset.




This opportunity is considered to be a business-critical role supporting the Investment Management Division.




Grow your career and make a difference working at the OSC.

The OSC is committed to diversity and providing an inclusive workplace and providing accommodation in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Human Rights Code. It is our priority to ensure employment opportunities are visible and barrier-free to all under-represented groups including but not limited to, Indigenous, Black and racialized groups, people with disabilities, women and people from the 2SLGBTQI+ community, to achieve an employee demographic profile reflective of the demographic profile of Ontarians.




The OSC is a proud partner with the following organizations: Ascend Canada, BlackNorth Initiative, Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion, and Pride at Work Canada




If you require an accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know by contacting our confidential inbox HRRecruitment@osc.gov.on.ca.

Title: Data & Analytics Analyst
Description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

The Data & Analytics Analyst enables data-driven decision-making across the organization by transforming complex data into meaningful insights and performance reporting. The role is responsible for designing and maintaining KPI dashboards and scorecards in Power BI, utilizing SAP SAC and Fiori to deliver detailed operational and business reporting. In addition, the position establishes strong data governance practices by documenting KPI definitions, business rules, ownership, and usage guidelines, ensuring alignment across functions and reducing inconsistencies in reporting. Through trusted analytics and standardized metrics, the role supports business leaders in making informed and timely decisions.

In this role, you will:

KPI Reporting & Dashboarding (Power BI)


Design, build, and maintain KPI dashboards/scorecards in Power BI to support performance management routines and faster decision-making.
Produce recurring KPI reporting packs (e.g., service/case fill, inventory health/DOS, forecast-related views) with clear commentary on trends and drivers.
Partner with stakeholders to translate KPI needs into usable visuals, filters, and drill paths that align to how teams manage the business.


Transactional & Detailed Reporting (SAC/Fiori)


Use SAC and Fiori to access SAP transactional and detailed reporting needed for root-cause analysis and operational deep dives.
Cross-check transactional views (SAC/Fiori) versus aggregated dashboards (Power BI) to improve confidence in KPI interpretation and decisions


Data Quality, Governance & Documentation


Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across reports; coordinate resolution with report owners/stewards and affected stakeholders.
Maintain and publish reporting documentation (definitions, intended use/purpose, sources, calculation logic, and ownership/stewardship), aligned to enterprise governance approaches.
Contribute to dashboard “link hygiene” and user guidance so that consumers can easily find the right source report and definitions for each KPI.


Problem Identification & Continuous Improvement


Identify performance risks/opportunities using variance, exceptions, and trend analysis; frame the “so what” and recommended actions for KPI owners.
Support continuous improvement by quantifying baseline, diagnosing drivers, and tracking impact through sustained KPI monitoring (e.g., case fill changes over time).


What we look for:

Years and Type of Experience:


2 - 3 years of experience in analytics and reporting, KPI performance management, and cross-functional problem-solving, preferably supporting supply chain, operations, or other business functions.
Experience working with operational/service and inventory metrics and producing recurring performance reporting packs.


Skills and Abilities:

Must-have


Hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting in Power BI (e.g., authoring in Desktop and publishing/sharing via the service).
Working knowledge of SAC and Fiori for SAP transactional and detailed reporting (or strong ability to learn quickly).
Strong analytical problem solving: ability to identify drivers, explain variance, and translate analysis into actions.
Documentation discipline: ability to write clear metric definitions, intended use, and calculation notes to improve shared understanding.
2+ years experience working in data or business analytics with a proven track record of validating AI assisted insights.
Handse-on exposure to modern BI or workspace tools featuring embedded o generative AI features (power BI copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise).


Nice-to-have


Familiarity with report governance/catalog practices (owners/stewards tracked centrally.
Continuous improvement methods (Lean/Six Sigma) applied to operations or supply chain analytics (optional, depending on your preference).
Exposure to Vista reporting change concepts and expectations (e.g., Fiori/SAC go-live and reporting evolution).

Highly motivated, results-oriented, team player

Experience in clinical and financial analysis to support reporting and policy development
Experience using Microsoft Office products such as Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Power BI
Personal drive and a strong ability to self-manage
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
Excellent communication (written and oral) including preparing and presenting planning, reporting, and knowledge transfer products, tools, and materials

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Who is Allstate:

Allstate Insurance Company of Canada is a leading home and auto insurer focused on providing its customers prevention and protection products and services for every stage of life. Serving Canadians since 1953, Allstate strives to reassure both customers and employees with its “You’re in Good Hands®” promise and is proud to have been named a Best Employer in Canada for nine consecutive years. Allstate is committed to making a positive difference in the communities in which it operates through partnerships with charitable organizations, employee giving and volunteerism. To learn more, visit www.allstate.ca. For safety tips and advice, visit www.goodhandsadvice.ca.

Through our Employee Value Proposition, we have worked hard to develop and nurture a culture where employees feel valued, experience personal growth, have career options and truly enjoy the work they do.

Benefits To Joining Allstate


Flexible Work Arrangements.
Employee discounts (15% on auto and property insurance, plus many other products and services).
Good Office program (receive up to $400 back after purchasing office equipment).
Student Loan Payment Matching Program for Government Student loans.
Comprehensive Retirement Savings Program with employer matched contributions.
Annual Wellness allowance to support employees with improving health and wellbeing.
Personal days.
Tuition Reimbursement.
Working within the community and giving back.


Role Designation: Hybrid with a requirement to go into our Markham office once or twice a month.

Job Description

In this role, you will support the delivery of business intelligence solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across Operations. You will work with large datasets to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and support the development of reporting and analytics solutions that improve operational performance.

You’ll play a key role in a new and evolving environment, contributing to the growth of Allstate’s direct sales channel. By combining strong analytical thinking with technical skills, you will help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable supporting both day-to-day business needs and longer-term strategic objectives.

Accountabilities:


Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for process improvement and growth
Aggregate, validate, and prepare data to ensure accuracy and reliability of reporting and insights
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to support operational and business decision-making
Partner with stakeholders to gather and document data and reporting requirements
Support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business needs and quality standards
Identify and resolve data issues, system discrepancies, and reporting challenges
Uncover actionable insights and communicate findings to support business improvements
Contribute to the development of metrics and ensure alignment across BI solutions
Support application and reporting projects as a data subject matter expert


Qualifications:


Must-have expertise in Microsoft Fabric ETL Pipelines, SQL, Power BI visualization, Excel, Microsoft 365, and marketing analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate insights
Demonstrated experience working with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, python and power automate.
Proficiency in Excel and working with large datasets
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify data quality issues and inconsistencies
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment
Effective communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and support requirements gathering
Curiosity and a proactive mindset, with a desire to explore data and uncover opportunities


Allstate Canada Group has policies and practices that provide workplace accommodations. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Business Intelligence (BI) Solutions, Data Analysis, Data-Driven Decision Making, ETL Pipelines, Marketing Analysis, Marketing Analytics, Market Trends, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI), Structured Query Language (SQL), User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

Title: Senior Analyst, Data Foundations and Infrastructure
Description:
About the Opportunity:

This is an exciting opportunity to join Commercial Banking's Data Foundations & Infrastructure team and play a key role in maintaining the accuracy, quality, and integrity of the data that powers reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across Commercial Banking.

The team sits at the intersection of business and technology, supporting foundational Commercial Banking datasets across Canada and the U.S. The successful candidate will combine financial acumen, strong SQL capabilities, and data analysis skills to investigate data discrepancies, perform reconciliations, improve operational processes, and support ongoing enhancements to Commercial Banking's data environment.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, understanding the business meaning behind data, and contributing to process improvements that drive operational efficiency. It offers excellent exposure to Commercial Banking data, financial systems, data infrastructure, and broader Data & Analytics initiatives across the organization.

BMO Commercial Bank Data Foundations team is focusing on revenue data reconciliation, processing, and operational data workflows. The role involves executing and improving recurring processes, ensuring data integrity, and supporting finance and business stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities


Executes and supports end-to-end revenue data processes, including monthly/periodic reconciliation, investigation, and adjustment workflows across multiple data sources.
Performs data reconciliation between financial systems and internal data platforms, identifying variances, root causes, and required adjustments to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Writes and maintains SQL queries and Python scripts to extract, transform, validate, and reconcile data across systems.
Supports the execution, monitoring, and troubleshooting of recurring data pipelines and batch processes, ensuring timely delivery of revenue datasets.
Works closely with finance and business teams to understand data discrepancies, validate outputs, and resolve issues in a timely manner.
Identifies opportunities to automate and streamline manual reconciliation and reporting processes using SQL, Python, and other workflow tools.
Develops and maintains operational reporting and dashboards to track reconciliation status, data quality, and process performance.
Documents data flows, reconciliation logic, and operational procedures to support transparency, auditability, and onboarding.
Ensures adherence to data quality standards (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) within revenue datasets.
Collaborates with data engineers and analytics teams to enhance data models and improve processing efficiency.
Provides ongoing support to business stakeholders by investigating data issues and responding to inquiries related to revenue data.



Qualifications

Must-have Skills


Strong hands-on experience with SQL (required) – ability to query, join, and troubleshoot large datasets
Experience with Python (required) for data processing, automation, or scripting
Working knowledge of data reconciliation, data validation, or data quality processes
Basic understanding of accounting principles (e.g., revenue, GL, reconciliations)



Good-to-have


Experience supporting financial or revenue data processes in banking or financial services
Familiarity with ETL/data pipelines
Experience with data quality frameworks or controls
Exposure to month-end or periodic processing cycles



Core Competencies

Foundational:


Data reconciliation & validation
Data operations & process execution
SQL & data manipulation
Systems thinking
Problem solving



Intermediate:


Process improvement & automation
Stakeholder communication (finance + business)
Analytical thinking & root cause analysis
Documentation & operational governance



Experience


Typically, 1–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, data operations, or financial data roles
Experience working with large, complex datasets and operational processes
Background in banking, finance, or revenue data environments preferred

Title: Analytics Consultant, Decision Support, Business Intelligence - FT (J0426-0587)
Description:
Company Bio

North York General is one of Canada’s leading community academic hospitals with a vision to deliver World-Class Care, 24/7. Affiliated with the University of Toronto, our multi-site campus supports our diverse community through every stage and life-defining moment by providing a wide range of acute care, ambulatory and long-term care services.

What defines North York General goes beyond exceptional quality care. Our superpower is how we deliver that care – the unparalleled compassion we bring to every encounter, during the moments that matter. Through partnerships, collaboration and academic endeavours, we seek to set new standards for People-Centred Care—a cornerstone of our culture and central to our Mission: People-Centred Care for a healthier community.

North York General is a member of the North York Toronto Health Partners, an Ontario Health Team that integrates local care with patients, primary care and community partners.

We are proud to be a place where the best people come to learn, grow and innovate. Join North York General to accelerate your career!

Position Summary

Analytics Consultant, Decision Support Your goal in this position is to work with health system administrators and professionals to facilitate evidence-based decision making that is aligned with North York General Hospital’s strategic directions. You will support the organization regarding information needs and analysis for decision making, quality improvement, internal/external reporting requirements and gaining insights into its business. You will provide support and assistance to various stakeholders on patient activities, resource utilization, evaluation of quality of care, benchmarking and validation and research. You have a solid understanding of population funding methodology including HBAM/HBAM Inpatient Group methodology and Quality Based Procedures. You have a good understanding of clinical and corporate data needs in a hospital setting. You have excellent oral and written communication skills. You have strong problem solving, data management and analytical skills. You are able to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders and work with all levels of management. You can multi-task and manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. You have strong organizational and time management skills. This position contributes to the shared responsibility of ensuring health and safety policies are followed to provide for a healthy environment for patients, staff, physicians, volunteers and families.

On a practical level, you will


Integrate and analyze clinical and utilization/administrative data to produce reports to support decision making
Provide centralized consulting services through education, communication and presentations to all levels of management (Directors, Managers, etc.)
Take a lead role in providing advice and recommendations on analytical approaches/methodologies to drive stakeholders toward making data-driven/evidence informed decisions
Extract data, develop and generate standard reports, and respond to ad-hoc requests using Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Cognos, PowerBI, Tableau), SQL, R, Python, Excel or other analytic tools
Assist with benchmarking activities related to clinical and corporate performance data
Provide critical analysis of data to assist clinical teams with optimizing the use of clinical practice guidelines
Prepare custom reports for day-to-day business use, and data quality and validation purposes
Perform quality control reviews including data processing flow analysis to ensure reliability and accuracy of collected data
Coordinate and implement Decision Support related projects through the phases of project management
Track and analyze key corporate performance indicators
Provide guidance and expertise with respect to indicator and metric development for performance monitoring
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to support reporting and evaluation projects
Support and help advance the Data & Analytics Governance program (e.g., data quality, metadata)
Coach and explain technical matters to other staff and assist BI Report writers and other staff in the hospital.


Qualifications


Degree in Health Information or a related field (Business Administration, Computer Science, Statistics, Health Sciences or Health Information Management, mathematics or data science), or equivalent education/experience. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Three to five years of experience working with databases and various health information systems
Experience with data science solutions, including data analysis and linkage, data modelling, and advanced analytics is an asset
In-depth knowledge of databases used to capture information in various health sectors including: Hospital databases (e.g., NACRS, DAD, OMHRS), data tools (e.,g., intelliHealth, CIHI Your Health System Insights)provincial/regional data repositories (e.g., Wait Times Information System) and Hospital standards including ICD-10CA
Expert knowledge of SQL and advanced Excel skills
Knowledge of statistical tools, such as R, Python, etc
Experience with BI tools, such as Cognos, PowerBI and Tableau
Proficient in the use of Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint, Word)
Strong data management and statistical analysis skills required
Experience with information systems used for managing and reporting clinical and corporate data


What We Offer

Working at NYGH means working with a dynamic team of fellow healthcare providers, staff, and volunteers in one of Canada’s leading hospitals. This is a Full-time Regular Position with 8 hour shifts,D ays shifts in the Decision Support, Business Intelligence department . We offer a highly competitive total compensation package that includes benefits, pension, and vacation. If you were searching for more reasons to consider joining the wonderful team at NYGH, check out some features of our Total Rewards package by visiting nygh.on.ca

Ensure to meet the deadline - only applications received by the closing date will be considered.
We will review all applications and will contact those selected for an interview.

At North York General, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. North York General is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Position Title: Business Intelligence Analyst




Position Status: Permanent

Posting Status: Open

Location: (On-site) 26 Prince Andrew Place, North York, ON, M3C 2H4

Salary Band: $75,185 - $105,116 per year

Hours of Work: 36.25 per week

Posting Date: October 13, 2026

Closing Date: October 27, 2026




Who we are

The Office of the Chief Electoral Officer (Elections Ontario) is an independent, non-partisan office of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario, responsible for administering provincial elections, by-elections, and referenda.




At the heart of our work is a commitment to democracy – making voting easy and accessible for all electors, while maintaining the integrity, security, and transparency of the electoral process.




Join our team

The Elector Data & Analytics Division is seeking a skilled and curious Business Intelligence Analyst to help assess the accuracy and the quality of Ontario's Register of Electors and related geographic products and services.




In this role, you will apply data management, spatial analysis, research, and information modelling techniques to support the Permanent Register of Electors of Ontario. You will work with large and complex datasets, including elector, address, property, and geographic information, to deliver insights that support decision making.




What you can expect in this role

Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence, you will:

Support the development and delivery of advanced analytics and research pertaining to the quality of information in the Permanent Register of Electors of Ontario.
Identify, integrate, and maintain information and models for assessing the provincial register of electors’ data. This involves integrating datasets of addresses, properties, and a repository of geographical and administrative spatial assets.
Define, implement, and track key quality metrics and performance indicators for evaluating the quality of information maintained in the provincial register and disseminated as list and geographical products and services to provincial and municipal stakeholders.
Provide education and guidance to team members and external stakeholders on understanding business intelligence research initiatives.
Consult and collaborate with staff from other functions to create actionable recommendations. Advise the Manager on the implications of business proposals, projects, and decisions affecting register information.




What you need to qualify

Required skills and experience:

Demonstrated knowledge of information modelling, data analysis, data processing methodologies, and research methods.
Experience writing SQL queries, procedures, and data processing workflows, preferably using Microsoft SQL Server/T-SQL.
Experience using version control systems, preferably Git, with a preference working with Azure DevOps.
Demonstrated experience in analyzing tabular and spatial data using GIS software, tools, and datasets.
Experience with business intelligence applications and development tools such as Microsoft Power BI, to design appropriate Business Intelligence applications, measures, and tests to evaluate data.

Assets:

Experience in a legislative, regulatory, public sector, or broader public service environment, particularly where data management and measurement frameworks support statutory obligations.
Experience conducting quantitative research and applying statistical methodologies to support decision making.
Experience working with Statistics Canada population and demographic datasets.
Experience working with Ontario-based datasets such as those from Land Information Ontario (LIO) and TERANET.
Experience with statistical tools or programming languages such as R, SAS, Python or similar analytical platforms.
Experience in automating processes such as the generation of quantitative reports would be an asset.
Education: A degree in one of the following disciplines: Mathematics, Statistics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Political Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be legally entitled to work in Canada.




This role requires in-office presence five (5) days per week. There is no hybrid option.




The successful candidate will be required to complete criminal background and social media checks as part of the hiring process.




How to apply

Our recruitment process reflects our mission to uphold the integrity and accessibility of the electoral process and to manage elections in an efficient, fair, and impartial manner. We offer career growth opportunities and a competitive rewards program.




Please submit your cover letter and resume as one PDF attachment, using format: EO-2026-116, First Name Last Name in the subject line, to jobs@elections.on.ca, no later than 4:00 PM on October 27, 2026.




Please note: Applications without a cover letter will not be accepted.




We thank all applicants for their submission, but only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.




How to request an accommodation

Elections Ontario is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment, where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.




Under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act and the Ontario Human Rights Code, we provide accommodation for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. If you require a disability-related accommodation to participate, please call 1-888-668-8683, send a fax to 1-866-714-2809, TTY at 1-888-292-2312 or email hr@elections.on.ca.




At Elections Ontario, all resumes are screened by the Talent Acquisition team and Hiring Managers, without the use of AI. Criminal record checks also do not use AI. However, AI technology is used when conducting social media checks.




Elections Ontario posts salaries in accordance with ESA pay/transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary range are determined through various factors, including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge and applicable skill sets.

Support improvements to the firm’s reporting capability by assessing and applying appropriate tools and approaches.
Prepare data from various sources for reporting and analysis in Excel, Power BI and other business intelligence tools.
Interpret financial and business information to identify trends, risks and relevant insights for stakeholders.

3 to 5 years of related experience, preferably within a professional services firm.

Experience in extracting data from a complex accounting system is required. Experience with 3E would be an asset.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly grasp complex assignments; the aptitude to analyze a variety of considerations, determine what’s important, and assess possible courses of action.
Ability to plan, organize, schedule, and deliver within tight deadlines in a high-pressure environment.
Strong client service orientation combined with the ability to manage multiple client needs at the same time.
Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to interact with individuals at all levels of the organization with tact and diplomacy.
Ability to build strong working relationships with key stakeholders of the firm.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work well both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong aptitude for utilizing technology and continuous process improvement.
Sound judgment including the ability to deal with confidential information with utmost discretion.
Exceptional attention to detail.



Hybrid

Allstate Insurance Company of Canada is a leading home and auto insurer focused on providing its customers prevention and protection products and services for every stage of life. Serving Canadians since 1953, Allstate strives to reassure both customers and employees with its “You’re in Good Hands®” promise and is proud to have been named a Best Employer in Canada for nine consecutive years. To learn more, visit www.allstate.ca. For safety tips and advice, visit www.goodhandsadvice.ca.

Flexible Work Arrangements.
Employee discounts (15% on auto and property insurance, plus many other products and services).

Personal days.

Job Description

In this role, you will partner with business stakeholders to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive customer-focused and data-driven decisions across Operations. You will work at the intersection of analytics and business strategy—breaking down problems, identifying trends, and delivering clear recommendations that influence operational efficiency and performance.

You’ll play a key role in a new and evolving space, supporting initiatives such as the launch and optimization of Allstate’s direct sales channels. By combining strong analytical thinking, storytelling, and technical expertise, you will help shape how data is used to guide decisions, improve customer experience, and uncover new opportunities for growth.

Accountabilities:


Analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and key business drivers
Translate business questions into structured analysis, delivering actionable insights and recommendations
Develop dashboards, reports, and scorecards to monitor performance and support decision-making
Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, align priorities, and provide consultative analytics support
Assess performance against targets, identify variances, and recommend data-driven solutions to improve outcomes
Forecast operational volumes and provide insights to support workforce planning and business strategy
Build compelling data stories and visualizations to communicate insights effectively to diverse audiences
Lead and deliver analytics projects of moderate complexity, including defining timelines, priorities, and deliverables
Contribute to continuous improvement by enhancing analytical methodologies, processes, and reporting capabilities


Qualifications:


Must have demonstrated experience working with data visualization and analytics tools such as in Fabric ETL Pipelines, SQL, Visualization/Power BI, MS 365, Adobe Workspace
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and generate actionable insights
Strong proficiency in Excel, including large dataset management, pivot table creation, and ad hoc analytical reporting.
Ability to translate data into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence decision-making
Experience gathering requirements and working in a consultative, business-facing analytics role
Familiarity with data querying or programming languages (e.g., SQL, DAX, or similar) is an asset
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment
Curiosity and a proactive mindset, with a passion for exploring data and uncovering insights.


Allstate Canada Group has policies and practices that provide workplace accommodations. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Skills

Business Analysis, Business Case Analyses, Data Analytics, ETL Pipelines, ETL Workflows, Microsoft Copilot for Power BI, Microsoft Office 365, MS SQL Development, MS SQL Queries, Structured Query Language (SQL)

Compensation

Compensation

Expected compensation for this role ranges from $ 73,500.00 - 116,850.00 annually. Actual salary offered to successful candidates will vary based on their skills and experience.
