Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Join the Zynga Poker Analytics Team

Zynga Poker is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. At Zynga, Principal is the next step above Senior; a great fit for analysts ready to take on broader ownership and scope. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design, conduct, and analyze statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which is doing significant strides in improving analytics workflows through AI
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Experience/ Interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies


What We Offer You

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $118,300 and $142,000 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please note that Zynga is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Metergy Solutions Inc. (“Metergy”)
Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Our Mission
Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with passion, thrives on positivity, and delivers with precision. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

Metergy office location is in Markham but will be moving to North York toward the end of 2026!
Position Summary
The Business Intelligence analyst is accountable for the management, development and execution of the Business Intelligence (BI) & Revenue Assurance Program, Annual Rate Increases, operations dashboards, and reporting, and overall Gross Margin (GM) Integrity.

Key Responsibilities:


Extract, clean, and analyze large volumes of data to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
Conduct deep dive business intelligence analysis into operational areas within Operations to provide analysis and insight on the interplay between the various key performance indicators (e.g., workforce performance & management, Revenue Assurance, productivity, cost and quality drivers).
Effectively collaborate with stakeholders to develop insights and recommendations to enable strategic discussions among leadership.
Provided monthly management insight for performance opportunities, financial Rate and Volume variance analysis to help identify resource allocation opportunities
Accountable for understanding regulation changes and launching organizational projects to implement changes in all impacted areas in submetering (includes non-responsible departments)
Plans, develops and approves all operational policies in all functional areas, with standard operating procedures, and quality management systems for revenue assurance
Monitor daily performance against key metrics to identify opportunities and anomalies
Constantly review current operational processes and be a strategic partner in making recommendations for improvements
Work with all departmental owners to implement and ensure controls are in place to support the lead to cash process for all (billing model) revenue streams
Develop and champion revenue leakage issues across organization by engaging key stakeholders on activity and resource requirements necessary to drive revenue maximization
Stay updated on the latest trends in Business Intelligence, data analytics and emerging technologies
Evaluate and incorporate new tools or techniques that could enhance BI capabilities.


Qualifications:


Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Math, Economics, or other quantitative fields.
Preference to additional training with Data Analytics / IT
Preference for industry experience with Utilities, Telecommunications, or other large consumer base businesses within North American juristictions (250k+ customers)
5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Operations, or relevant work experience at a fast-growing utility company is preferred.
High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL
Excellent collaboration skills to build strong working partnerships with stakeholders.
Understanding and experience working with statistical revenue and costing information to provide business insight and opportunities to reduce cost.
Strong technical skills to mine large volumes of data.
Ability to apply superior data knowledge & discovery skills into building effective analysis.
Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.
Industry or working experience with customer billing environments with large transaction volumes such as Utility or Telecommunications,
Attention to detail and quality, strong time management and project/work planning skills.
Proven ability to work with and deliver Industry Leading Best-in-Class reporting and analytical solutions.
Excellent interpersonal and customer interaction skills to include communications, presentation and conflict resolution skills


Any shown ranges reflects base salary. We offer discretionary bonus and additional benefits, including health and retirement, as part of our total rewards program.

Benefits & Perks

Fully company covered heath and dental benefits from day 1
Company funded Health Spending Account
Plan for retirement with Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP) and RRSP Matching
Grow with us! We provide support for continuous learning.
Paid personal and sick days on top of your vacation
Summer hours to enjoy the weather
Company sponsored social events & more!

About Joseph Brant Hospital

Joseph Brant Hospital (JBH) is a full-service hospital located in the growing and thriving community of Burlington, Ontario, serving more than 185,000 residents in Halton, Hamilton, Waterdown, Flamborough, Milton and Stoney Creek. JBH is honoured to be recognized as one of Hamilton Niagara’s Top Employers since 2015, with a skilled team of approximately 200 physicians, 2,000 employees, and more than 300 volunteers.

JBH is a Clinical Education site in conjunction with McMaster University, and is designated as an Academic Community Teaching Hospital. JBH is also a partner member of the Burlington Ontario Health Team (BOHT). JBH is deeply committed to providing exemplary care and living the hospital’s core values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect and Excellence.

JBH also inspires and empowers a culture of caring and this is demonstrated in many ways including our commitment to the health, safety, and wellbeing of our people. For more information, visit www.josephbranthospital.ca.

Responsibilities


Develop, produce, and analyze reports to support decision making, planning, impact/market share analysis, and proposals.
Manage the maintenance, improvement, and presentation of program scorecards and dashboards, performance indicators and ad-hoc reports for various users and user groups within the organization.
Extract, interpret, analyze and synthesize complex and diverse data sets to generate meaningful insights and actionable findings.
Provide education and subject matter expertise to the leadership teams and clinicians on data interpretation, and effective use of decision support tools, and analytic applications.
Manage and ensure the accurate and timely submission of external data, reports and required deliverables in accordance with established deadlines and reporting requirements.
Stay informed of emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in healthcare, business intelligence, data analytics and information management.


Qualifications


Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, and contribute effectively within multidisciplinary teams, supported by strong interpersonal skills and sound analytical and statistical capabilities.
Related undergraduate degree or diploma; Master’s degree considered an asset (MBA/Health Information Management/Computer Science).
Minimum 3 years experience in a decision support setting (hospital/health care environment) or relevant field.
At least 2 years previous experience in SQL Data Query Language is required.
Knowledge of statistical tools, such as R, Python, SAS etc.
Knowledge of databases and report writing tools/ business intelligence solutions like Tableau, PowerBI and Crystal Reports.
Strong computer knowledge and skills with proficiency in decision support tools and applications, databases, designing and generating reports and knowledge of business intelligence tools.
Essential experience with ATC/WTIS, CIHI acute and post-acute databases (DAD, NACRS, OMHRS, NRS, CCRS), MIS/OHRS, Meditech, EPIC, Integrated Decision Support (IDS) BI, Intellihealth Ontario is essential.
EPIC Cogito certification is an asset.
Experience with funding models (HBAM/GEM, QBPs, PCOP) is an asset.
Proficiency in data analysis, interpretation and presentation using MS Office tools is essential;
Project management abilities including excellent organization and time management skills to manage a demanding workload effectively in an environment of many conflicting and competing deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to establish and maintain strategic relationships and collaborative partnerships with diverse healthcare providers and stakeholders.

Title: Senior Business Data Analyst - Asset Management Software
Description:
Change the future with us.

We are looking for dedicated and talented people who tackle ever-changing challenges, customer needs, and questions from colleagues with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of work. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world.

What will you do?

Position Overview

The Senior Business Data Analyst translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

This is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

You will join the Smart Infrastructure, Asset Management Software Information Technology (SI AMS IT) Data & AI team and work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and other commercial functions. Marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in Marketing Analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

The role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative Data & AI team. You will work with modern technologies including Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and AI capabilities. We expect you to be an early adopter of generative AI, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES | You’ll make an impact by:

Business Partnership And Requirements Engineering


Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
Handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
Resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
Build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
Lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
Collaborate with global stakeholders across North America and Europe, with core working hours aligned to Eastern Time business operations.


Data Analysis and Insight Generation


Extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced SQL and analytical tools.
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
Apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
Assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
Use generative AI tools, such as Claude Code or GH Copilot, to accelerate SQL, dbt, and Power BI development, and share what works with the team.


Data Products and Business Intelligence


Design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using Power BI, Qlik, and other relevant tools.
Create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
Contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
Support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.


Data Modeling and Technical Delivery


Understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
Create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
Work with platforms such as Snowflake and tools such as dbt.
Investigate analytical data issues and partner with Data Engineering on production pipelines and shared models.


End to End Solution Ownership


Own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
Act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from Data Engineering, Data Science, BI, AI, and other specialists.
Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
Share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.


Data Quality and Governance


Apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
Identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
Maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
Support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.


Location: This is a REMOTE role, with a preference for those located in or near the Eastern Time Zone due to regular collaboration with global colleagues in Germany. Candidates must be able to sustainably accommodate the working hours required for effective cross-time-zone collaboration.

What will you need to succeed?

Experience & Business Partnership:


7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
Proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.


Data & Analytics Expertise:


Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
Strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using Power BI, Qlik, or comparable BI platforms.


Platforms & Technology:


Hands-on experience with Salesforce or other CRM data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
Experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or comparable technologies.


Core Competencies:


Ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.


You'll Thrive Even More If You Also Bring:


Experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
Experience supporting Marketing Analytics or other commercial functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Finance.
Hands on experience with Snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
Python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
Experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
Familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, AI enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
Experience supporting SaaS, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.


What Does Success Look Like?

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:


Become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
Handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
Turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
Deliver reliable analysis, data models, and BI solutions with limited day to day support.
Navigate SI AMS data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
Become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
Collaborate effectively with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and other specialist functions.
Produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
Contribute to a scalable and resilient Data & AI environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.
Define measurable success criteria and experimentation approaches to evaluate business initiatives, campaigns, and AI-driven solutions


Why you’ll love working for Siemens!


Freedom and a healthy work- life balance– Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces.
Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects.
Engaging, challenging, and fast evolving, cutting edge technological environment.
Opportunities to advance your career and mentorship programs on a local and global scale.
Competitive total rewards package.
Profit sharing available.
Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell your vacation depending on your lifestyle.
Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives focused on access to education, access to technology and sustaining communities and make a positive impact on the community.
Participate in our celebrations, social events and offsite business events.
Opportunities to contribute your innovative ideas and get paid for them!
Employee perks and discounts.

Position Overview

The Senior Business Data Analyst translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

This is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

We expect you to be an early adopter of generative AI, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

Business Partnership And Requirements Engineering

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.

  • Extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced SQL and analytical tools.

Data Products and Business Intelligence

  • Design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using Power BI, Qlik, and other relevant tools.

  • Contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
  • Support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.

  • Understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.

  • Identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
  • Maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
  • Support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.

Experience & Business Partnership:

  • 7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

  • Proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.

Data & Analytics Expertise:

  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
  • Strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
  • Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using Power BI, Qlik, or comparable BI platforms.

Platforms & Technology:

  • Experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or comparable technologies.

Description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As the Senior Analyst, Risk Analytics you will provide support on developing and producing portfolio risk dashboards and other regular reports to monitor Retail Lending portfolio performance, and provide insights for senior management to make decisions. This position will also be involved in in-depth analysis on credit losses and delinquency based on large amount of data from a variety of data sources to understand risk trend and generate insights.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed


Reporting – You will prioritize work items to make sure reports/analyses are delivered on time. You will use tools such as SAS EG and MS Office to prepare risk dashboards and other reports and perform analyses to monitor portfolio performance and develop insights. You will work closely with Finance and Collection to validate credit loss numbers and
understand impact of their operation on portfolio performance.
Risk analysis – With good understanding of risk data from TSYS, Capstone and Triad you translate portfolio performance questions to analysis design to derive actionable information from large number of data. You work with Account Management and Acquisition teams to provide portfolio impact analysis of risk strategy changes and optimization.
Business acumen and data control – You understand our clients and keep up to date on retail lending products , processes, data sources, and overall Canadian economy to understand the impact on portfolio performance. You will ensure that numbers in dashboards are accurate by maintaining and enhancing data preparation process control and documenting data/process changes. You participate in process design and risk-related projects.


Who You Are


You can demonstrate experience in SQL and other programming languages, mathematical or statistical analysis software tools (SAS or Databricks preferred), database management, and advanced Microsoft Excel skills. It is an asset if you have undergraduate degree in quantitative areas such as mathematics, statistics, physics, economics, or another applicable discipline.
You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
You put our clients first. You engage with purpose to find the right solutions. You go the extra mile, because it's the right thing to do.
You understand that success is in the details. You notice things that others don't. Your critical thinking skills help to inform your decision making.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values – trust, teamwork and accountability.


What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

Title: Analytics Consultant, Decision Support, Business Intelligence - FT (J0426-0587)
Description:
Company Bio

North York General is one of Canada’s leading community academic hospitals with a vision to deliver World-Class Care, 24/7. Affiliated with the University of Toronto, our multi-site campus supports our diverse community through every stage and life-defining moment by providing a wide range of acute care, ambulatory and long-term care services.

What defines North York General goes beyond exceptional quality care. Our superpower is how we deliver that care – the unparalleled compassion we bring to every encounter, during the moments that matter. Through partnerships, collaboration and academic endeavours, we seek to set new standards for People-Centred Care—a cornerstone of our culture and central to our Mission: People-Centred Care for a healthier community.

North York General is a member of the North York Toronto Health Partners, an Ontario Health Team that integrates local care with patients, primary care and community partners.

We are proud to be a place where the best people come to learn, grow and innovate. Join North York General to accelerate your career!

Position Summary

Analytics Consultant, Decision Support Your goal in this position is to work with health system administrators and professionals to facilitate evidence-based decision making that is aligned with North York General Hospital’s strategic directions. You will support the organization regarding information needs and analysis for decision making, quality improvement, internal/external reporting requirements and gaining insights into its business. You will provide support and assistance to various stakeholders on patient activities, resource utilization, evaluation of quality of care, benchmarking and validation and research. You have a solid understanding of population funding methodology including HBAM/HBAM Inpatient Group methodology and Quality Based Procedures. You have a good understanding of clinical and corporate data needs in a hospital setting. You have excellent oral and written communication skills. You have strong problem solving, data management and analytical skills. You are able to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders and work with all levels of management. You can multi-task and manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. You have strong organizational and time management skills. This position contributes to the shared responsibility of ensuring health and safety policies are followed to provide for a healthy environment for patients, staff, physicians, volunteers and families.

On a practical level, you will


Integrate and analyze clinical and utilization/administrative data to produce reports to support decision making
Provide centralized consulting services through education, communication and presentations to all levels of management (Directors, Managers, etc.)
Take a lead role in providing advice and recommendations on analytical approaches/methodologies to drive stakeholders toward making data-driven/evidence informed decisions
Extract data, develop and generate standard reports, and respond to ad-hoc requests using Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Cognos, PowerBI, Tableau), SQL, R, Python, Excel or other analytic tools
Assist with benchmarking activities related to clinical and corporate performance data
Provide critical analysis of data to assist clinical teams with optimizing the use of clinical practice guidelines
Prepare custom reports for day-to-day business use, and data quality and validation purposes
Perform quality control reviews including data processing flow analysis to ensure reliability and accuracy of collected data
Coordinate and implement Decision Support related projects through the phases of project management
Track and analyze key corporate performance indicators
Provide guidance and expertise with respect to indicator and metric development for performance monitoring
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to support reporting and evaluation projects
Support and help advance the Data & Analytics Governance program (e.g., data quality, metadata)
Coach and explain technical matters to other staff and assist BI Report writers and other staff in the hospital.


Qualifications


Degree in Health Information or a related field (Business Administration, Computer Science, Statistics, Health Sciences or Health Information Management, mathematics or data science), or equivalent education/experience. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Three to five years of experience working with databases and various health information systems
Experience with data science solutions, including data analysis and linkage, data modelling, and advanced analytics is an asset
In-depth knowledge of databases used to capture information in various health sectors including: Hospital databases (e.g., NACRS, DAD, OMHRS), data tools (e.,g., intelliHealth, CIHI Your Health System Insights)provincial/regional data repositories (e.g., Wait Times Information System) and Hospital standards including ICD-10CA
Expert knowledge of SQL and advanced Excel skills
Knowledge of statistical tools, such as R, Python, etc
Experience with BI tools, such as Cognos, PowerBI and Tableau
Proficient in the use of Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint, Word)
Strong data management and statistical analysis skills required
Experience with information systems used for managing and reporting clinical and corporate data


What We Offer

Working at NYGH means working with a dynamic team of fellow healthcare providers, staff, and volunteers in one of Canada’s leading hospitals. This is a Full-time Regular Position with 8 hour shifts,D ays shifts in the Decision Support, Business Intelligence department . We offer a highly competitive total compensation package that includes benefits, pension, and vacation. If you were searching for more reasons to consider joining the wonderful team at NYGH, check out some features of our Total Rewards package by visiting nygh.on.ca

How To Apply

Think you're the right person for the job? Here's your first chance to show us why:


Ensure to meet the deadline - only applications received by the closing date will be considered.
We will review all applications and will contact those selected for an interview.


Closing Statement

At North York General, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the community in which we live, including those with disabilities. North York General is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the hiring process. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a Digital Reporting Lead to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across Digital Workplace services. This role combines advanced analytics, Power BI development, executive reporting, and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) measurement to help leaders optimize operations, adoption, support experience, productivity, and financial performance. The successful candidate will develop enterprise-level dashboards, KPI frameworks, OKR reporting, and executive scorecards while delivering impactful data storytelling that enables business outcomes.

What You'll Do


Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions for Digital Workplace operations.
Partner with business, technology, governance, and operational stakeholders to identify reporting needs and continuously improve analytics capabilitiesBuild data models, semantic models, and scalable reporting datasets that support business intelligence initiatives.
Develop executive KPI, OKR, and scorecard reporting frameworks that provide insights into operational performance and strategic goals.
Create executive-ready visualizations and storytelling narratives that translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
Analyze Digital Employee Experience (DEX) metrics using platforms such as Nexthink and related experience analytics tools.
Utilize SQL and data transformation techniques to integrate, cleanse, and prepare data from multiple enterprise sources.
Measure and report on service adoption, support experience, productivity, operational effectiveness, and financial health.



Basic Requirements


4+ years of professional experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, or related analytical roles.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Experience developing Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models in an enterprise environment.
Experience creating executive-level KPI, OKR, and scorecard reporting.
Proficiency in SQL and Azure for data analysis, data extraction, and transformation.
Experience with data visualization and communicating insights to business and executive audiences.
Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems and data sources.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data-driven recommendations.



Preferred Skills/Experience


Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms, including Nexthink or similar solutions.
Experience supporting Digital Workplace, Content Management Systems, Employee Experience, IT Operations, or End User Services organizations.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and enterprise reporting best practices.
Experience with cloud-based analytics and data warehousing environments.
Familiarity with reporting automation and self-service analytics solutions.
Experience conducting operational, financial, adoption, and service performance analytics.
Strong consultative, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced experience with executive storytelling, strategic reporting, and performance management frameworks.

Title: Workforce Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Workforce Intelligence Analyst – Markham, ON. - Full Time – ID# 7200
Are you ready to make an impact in the major Capital Projects Industry? Join PTAG, a leading Project Management Advisory & Services firm, recognized across North America for helping world-class clients deliver major capital projects successfully.
We are seeking a Workforce Intelligence Analyst to support our growing team in Markham, ON. In this role, you’ll play a key part in driving project excellence, collaborating with industry leaders, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across complex initiatives.
About PTAG
At PTAG, we help our clients plan, manage, and execute their most challenging projects with innovation, integrity, and collaboration.
Our mission is to help our clients achieve successful delivery and efficient operation of their capital projects.
Our vision is to support global leaders in the selection, planning, and execution of their major initiatives.
Our Values Include

Safety: The safety of our employees, suppliers, and clients is always the top priority.
Collaboration: We build true partnerships with clients and service providers.
Leadership: We elevate project performance through the application of best practices.
Accountability: We take responsibility for every aspect of our engagements.
Client Satisfaction: We strive for 100% satisfaction on every project.
Integrity: We believe in open and transparent communication at all levels.

Role & Responsibilities
The Workforce Intelligence Analyst reports directly to Senior Director, Workforce Development and works closely with Senior Advisors. The role combines workforce analytics, data management, business intelligence, and statistical analysis to identify workforce trends, skill and competency gaps, talent availability, capacity constraints, and future workforce requirements.

Design and build the initial data architecture for the labour intelligence data lake, structured around the KSBA framework (Knowledge, Skill, Behaviour, Attitude) and aligned to NCCER, CII, PMI, and AACE credentialing standards.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source, and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.

Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.

Salary Range for Role $ 150 -$155 + bonus
Compensation at PTAG varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience.
Why Join PTAG?
At PTAG, you’ll be part of a dynamic, growing consulting firm that values professional development, collaboration, and innovation.
Opportunity to work on major infrastructure and capital projects.

Exposure to industry-leading clients and partners.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Flexible work environment and opportunities for advancement.
Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP).
A culture that values safety, accountability, and excellence.

Title: Senior Analyst, Revenue Strategy, Analytics & Operations
Description:
About OpenTable

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

The Role

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Revenue Strategy, Operations, and Analytics, this position is responsible for supporting a variety of sales and services related programs, operations, initiatives, and analytics in the United States. Candidates for this role must have experience manipulating large sets of data to discover trends and make recommendations. The role will work cross-functionally with multiple departments including executive leadership, sales, marketing, operations, finance, product, and data analytics to support the design, implementation and continued optimization of multiple business needs. This includes delivering data-driven insights to internal partners to inform short and long term strategy and action plans. The ideal candidate will be able to recognise and understand the relationship between clean data, clear & efficient processes, and reporting.

The Sr. Analyst level position is expected to have an excellent understanding of the OpenTable Sales and Services organization, the ability to learn quickly, and to be able to work in ambiguity. You'll be able to navigate the roles, reporting, and reality of the business in the field. This position needs to have excellent communication, project management and data analysis skills and be comfortable building recommendations. Experience with Salesforce, Tableau, SQL queries, and a finance or analytics background preferred. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Responsibilities


Sophisticated analytics to support global Sales, Services, and Marketing decisions, including recurring monitoring of key performance metrics and the health of specific business segments
Prepare and present analyses and narratives for audiences ranging from field sales to senior leadership
Translate data sets into impactful insights, recommendations, dashboards, and reports for the larger sales, marketing and operations teams
Cultivate and manage strategic relationships with various sales leaders, partnering with them to drive key initiatives and measurable results across diverse business segments
Manage flow of inbound requests from the Global Restaurant Sales and Services (RSS) team for various ad hoc analyses, reporting needs, process and system enhancement requests
Partner with Salesforce and BI teams to implement process and data optimizations
Build and maintain financial models, forecasts and dashboards for various business scenarios
Salesforce.com (SFDC) data stewardship and improvement; dashboard and report creation and upkeep; end user support and documentation management


Minimum Qualifications


4+ years of experience in an analytics, operations, or strategy role
Experience with Snowflake or any other relational database
Strong SQL coding skills + experience with design and development of ETL processes
Advanced Excel skills required, including proficiency with pivot tables and VLOOKUP. Equivalent Google Sheets experience preferred
Knowledge in Salesforce, Preset/Superset, Snowflake
Operational experience in measuring and improving efficiency, utilization, scale initiatives etc.
High energy and contagious enthusiasm. Willing to take on tough projects and be a peer leader in order to support growth
Shown strong verbal and written communication skills; including detailing business processes, use cases, and business requirements


Preferred Qualifications


Excellent analytical and reporting capabilities, problem solving, negotiation, task and project coordination, and organization skills
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, reporting, and workflow automation
Understanding of sales process within OpenTable, or equivalent sales process experience
Background in finance or advanced business analytics.


Benefits And Perks


Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to Headspace
Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
20 days of paid time off
Private health and dental insurance
Life and Disability insurance

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

The expected range of compensation for this position based in Toronto, Canada, including commission and/or bonuses, is $84,000-$95,000 CAD. There are a variety of factors that go into determining a compensation range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

Who are we?

At Leadership Connect, we believe that relationships are everything in business and in life. Founded by two former CEOs of S&P 500 companies and a former presidential press secretary, our premier information service is built for developing relationships that impact decisions in government, business, and media. Utilizing deep research expertise and cutting-edge technology, we help our clients win business and influence policy across various specialties and verticals. We are a close-knit team dedicated to helping each of our users make a difference.

Leadership Connect Canada (LCC), a subsidiary of Leadership Connect Inc., is our Canadian entity operating in the Quebec and Ontario Provinces.

About The Role

Title: Pricing Analyst / Analyste de la tarification
Description:
About Carrier Enterprise Canada

Carrier Enterprise Canada is a leading distributor of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) products, parts, and supplies across Canada. We are committed to delivering excellence to our customers and partners through innovative solutions, operational efficiency, and a customer-first approach.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytically driven Pricing Analyst to join our team at Carrier Enterprise Canada, a leading distributor in the HVAC industry. Located at our Brampton, ON offices, this role reports directly to the Director of Pricing and plays a critical part in shaping our pricing strategy by leveraging market analysis and structured price studies to surface pricing and cost opportunities, monitoring and analyzing pricing governance, delivering KPIs and data-driven insights to inform decision-making, and serving as a key execution partner for any company strategy that touches pricing. If you are passionate about data, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a knack for turning complex datasets into actionable insights , we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Leverage BI and Pricing tools to mine and interpret large datasets delivering regular dashboards, reports, and ad hoc analyses that support strategic pricing decisions and business objectives
Present findings and recommendations based on opportunities uncovered through in-depth market and price studies
Analyze pricing governance and deliver reports and KPIs
Develop, maintain, and enhance pricing models and analytical frameworks
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to align pricing strategies with business objectives
Maintain data integrity within pricing systems and tools, ensuring accuracy and consistency

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
Strong proficiency in data mining and data analytics — ability to extract, clean, and interpret large volumes of data
Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Omni, Looker, Sigma Computing, Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy, or equivalent)
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills — pivot tables, complex formulas, and Power Query
Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail
Excellent communication skills — ability to present data-driven insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred / Assets

Prior experience in a pricing, revenue management, or financial analysis role
Familiarity with SQL for data extraction and manipulation
Experience with pricing software (e.g., PriceFX, PROS, Vendavo, or equivalent)
Experience with ERP systems (e.g., CSD or equivalent)
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms

What You'll Bring

A natural curiosity for data analysis and a proactive approach to problem-solving
An intellectual drive to dig deep and uncover the full picture, paired with the discipline to manage priorities and deliver insights within deadlines
A collaborative spirit that thrives in a team environment while respecting and upholding pricing governance and processes
Exceptional attention to detail
A commercial mindset — always connecting analysis back to business impact

What We Offer

A high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership
A genuine investment in your professional growth, with a defined path toward senior pricing leadership for the right candidate
A collaborative, data-driven culture that values innovation
Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities

*Carrier Enterprise Canada is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes and work environments. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise the Recruiter of any accommodations needed, in accordance with applicable human rights legislation, and in Ontario, in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (“AODA”) to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed and treated with confidentiality.




Un mot sur Carrier Enterprise Canada

Carrier Enterprise Canada est un important distributeur de produits, de pièces et de fournitures de chauffage, de ventilation et de conditionnement d’air (CVCA) dans tout le Canada. Nous nous engageons à offrir l’excellence à nos clients et partenaires grâce à des solutions innovantes, l’efficacité opérationnelle et une approche axée sur le client.

Un mot sur le poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne rigoureuse et dotée d’un esprit analytique pour occuper le poste d’analyste de la tarification qui se joindra à l’équipe de Carrier Enterprise Canada, un distributeur de premier plan dans le domaine du CVCA. Basé dans nos bureaux de Brampton, en Ontario, ce poste relève directement du directeur de la Tarification et joue un rôle essentiel dans l’élaboration de notre stratégie tarifaire. Il consiste à tirer parti d’analyses de marché et d’études tarifaires structurées pour identifier les possibilités en matière de tarification et de coûts, à surveiller et à analyser la gouvernance tarifaire, à fournir des indicateurs de rendement clés (IRC) et des analyses fondées sur les données afin d’éclairer la prise de décision, et à agir en tant que partenaire clé dans la mise en œuvre de toute stratégie d’entreprise ayant un impact sur la tarification. Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les données, que vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement dynamique et que vous avez le don de transformer des ensembles de données complexes en informations exploitables, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter.

Principales responsabilités

Tirer parti des outils de veille stratégique et de tarification pour exploiter et interpréter de grands ensembles de données en produisant régulièrement des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des analyses ad hoc qui soutiennent les décisions stratégiques en matière de tarification et les objectifs commerciaux
Présenter les conclusions et les recommandations basées sur les possibilités mises en évidence par des études approfondies du marché et des prix
Analyser la gouvernance des prix et remettre des rapports et des indicateurs de rendement clés
Élaborer, tenir à jour et améliorer les modèles de prix et les cadres d’analyse
Établir des partenariats interfonctionnels avec les équipes des Ventes, des Finances et de l’Exploitation pour que les stratégies de tarification correspondent aux objectifs commerciaux
Maintenir l’intégrité des données au sein des systèmes et outils de tarification, en assurant l’exactitude et la cohérence

Qualifications et Exigences

Obligatoires

Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, mathématiques, ou statistique ou dans un domaine connexe
Forte maîtrise de l’exploration de données et de l’analyse de données — capacité d’extraire, de nettoyer et d’interpréter de grands volumes de données
Expérience pratique des outils de veille stratégique (par exemple, OMNI, Looker, Sigma Computing, Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy ou équivalent)
Compétences Microsoft Excel avancées — tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes et Power Query
Solide esprit d’analyse et souci exceptionnel du détail
Excellentes compétences en communication — capacité à présenter clairement des informations basées sur les données à des publics techniques et non techniques

Compétences et atouts souhaités

Expérience antérieure dans un rôle de tarification, de gestion des revenus ou d’analyse financière
Connaissance de SQL pour l’extraction et la manipulation de données
Expérience des logiciels de tarification (par exemple, PRICEFX, PROS, Vendavo ou l’équivalent)
Expérience des systèmes intégrés de gestion d’entreprise (par exemple, CSD ou l’équivalent)
Expérience de Salesforce ou de plateformes similaires de gestion de la relation client

Vos forces

Une curiosité naturelle pour l’analyse des données et une approche proactive de la résolution de problèmes
La volonté intellectuelle de creuser en profondeur et de découvrir l’image complète, associée à la discipline pour gérer les priorités et fournir des informations dans les délais impartis
Un esprit de collaboration qui s’épanouit au sein d’une équipe, tout en respectant et en appliquant rigoureusement la gouvernance et les processus en matière de tarification
Une attention exceptionnelle aux détails
Un esprit commercial — toujours relier l’analyse à son impact sur l’entreprise

Notre offre

Un poste très en vue, en contact direct avec la haute direction
Un véritable investissement dans votre croissance professionnelle, avec un parcours défini vers la direction de la tarification pour le bon candidat
Une culture collaborative axée sur les données qui valorise l’innovation
Rémunération concurrentielle, avantages sociaux et possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel

*Carrier Enterprise Canada est un employeur qui respecte l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à offrir des processus de recrutement et de sélection inclusifs et sans obstacles, ainsi que des milieux de travail accessibles. Si vous êtes contacté(e) au sujet d’une possibilité d’emploi, veuillez en informer le/la recruteur/recruteuse des accommodements dont vous pourriez avoir besoin, conformément aux lois applicables en matière de droits de la personne et, en Ontario, conformément à la Loi de 2005 sur l’accessibilité pour les personnes handicapées de l’Ontario (« L.A.O. »), afin de vous assurer d’avoir accès à un processus juste et équitable. Toute information reçue concernant des accommodements sera traitée avec confidentialité et abordée de façon appropriée.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits
