Title: Data Analyst (Claims)
Description:
Luminary People Collective is a boutique recruitment and People advisory firm connecting great people with great opportunities. We partner with ambitious businesses to find exceptional talent, build strong teams, and create meaningful connections that last.




Luminary People Collective is partnering with Moe's Home Collection to find a detail-oriented, analytical and proactive Data Analyst (Claims) to join their growing team.




Moe's Home Collection is a family-run furniture and design company with a passion for creating thoughtfully designed pieces for the modern home. With an entrepreneurial mindset and a people-first approach, Moe's continues to evolve, challenge the status quo and find new ways to better serve its customers.







The Opportunity

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented and solutions-focused Data Analyst (Claims) to join the Moe's Home Collection team.




As Moe's first dedicated Data Analyst, this is an exciting opportunity to build structure, establish reporting processes and make a meaningful impact on how data is collected, analyzed and used across the business.

You will work with data from multiple sources, identify trends and recurring product issues, and translate your findings into practical recommendations that help the Quality team and broader business take action.




This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both the technical side of data and the opportunity to collaborate with different teams, solve problems and see the real-world impact of their work.







What You'll Be Responsible For

Claims Data Analysis & Insights

Consolidate claims, returns, damage and customer feedback data from multiple sources, including SAP, Resolutions Team logs, customer data and brand channels.
Clean, standardize and organize data to create a reliable and consistent dataset for analysis and reporting.
Categorize claims by product, SKU, vendor, defect type, sales channel and region to identify meaningful trends.
Analyze recurring defects, product issues and potential root causes across Moe's, Sundays and Hetta.
Identify patterns and emerging risks, providing clear insights into claim volumes, associated costs and affected products or vendors.
Present findings to the Quality team in a clear, actionable format that supports investigation and corrective action.
Use data to help measure the effectiveness of product quality improvements and identify opportunities to reduce future claims.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with the Resolutions Team and Customer Data teams to understand how claims information is collected, categorized and maintained.
Work closely with Quality Control to track product issues from identification through corrective action and measure whether improvements are delivering results.
Share relevant findings with Product Development, Sourcing and brand teams to support product decisions and vendor conversations.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure reporting reflects business needs and supports decision-making.
Build strong relationships with teams across North America and Asia, bringing a collaborative and solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.




Data Quality & Process Improvement

Map existing claims data sources and workflows, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities for improvement.
Develop a more structured and reliable approach to consolidating data across different systems and teams.
Recommend improvements to how claims information is captured, including standardized defect codes, required data fields and product or photo references.
Establish and maintain data quality standards to improve accuracy, consistency and reporting reliability.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve efficiency through automation and better data management practices.
Help build scalable processes that support future growth and evolving business needs.




Reporting, Dashboards & Documentation

Develop and maintain recurring claims reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.
Create clear, accessible reporting that highlights key issues, trends and opportunities, including weekly claims summaries and monthly analysis by vendor, product and SKU.
Translate complex datasets into concise, meaningful insights that non-technical stakeholders can easily understand and act on.
Prepare ad hoc analysis and reporting to support leadership and cross-functional teams.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering data collection, cleaning, analysis and reporting.
Ensure reporting processes are well documented, repeatable and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Leverage AI tools, including Claude and ChatGPT, to support analysis, documentation, process improvement and productivity while maintaining appropriate data confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important function and build something meaningful from the ground up.

Within your first 12 months, success will look like:

Reliable claims visibility: The Quality team has access to consistent, trusted reporting that clearly identifies the most significant product claims and quality issues, eliminating the need for manual data gathering.
Consolidated data: All key claims data sources have been mapped, cleaned and brought together into a reliable dataset used across the business.
Actionable dashboards: Recurring Power BI dashboards and claims reports are established and actively used by Quality Control, Resolutions and brand teams.
Documented processes: Clear SOPs are in place for the end-to-end claims data process, ensuring consistency and continuity.
Measurable improvements: Insights from your analysis have helped drive corrective actions that result in measurable reductions in claims for targeted products, SKUs or vendors.
Strong partnerships: You have built credibility across departments and established yourself as a trusted resource for accurate data, meaningful insights and practical recommendations.

What You Bring
2 to 4 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst or similar analytical role, ideally within retail, e-commerce, furniture or consumer products.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH and data cleaning techniques.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI.
Experience extracting, consolidating and analyzing data from SAP or a comparable ERP system.
Strong understanding of data quality, data validation and working with information from multiple systems.
Ability to identify trends, investigate inconsistencies and translate data into clear business insights.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to non-technical audiences in a concise and engaging way.
Strong written communication skills, including experience documenting processes, procedures and SOPs.
Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, with an interest in using technology to improve efficiency and workflows.
Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A self-directed approach, with the confidence to take initiative, solve problems and build processes where they do not yet exist.




Nice to Have

Experience working with claims, returns, warranties, customer resolutions or product quality data.
Familiarity with quality control, product development, sourcing or vendor management.
Experience collaborating with teams across multiple time zones, particularly North America and Asia.
A degree in Business, Statistics, Data Analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in the furniture, fashion, retail or broader consumer goods industry.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys working with data and understands that great analysis is only valuable when it leads to meaningful action.




You bring a combination of analytical thinking and practical problem-solving. You are not someone who simply produces reports. You want to understand the business, uncover opportunities and contribute to better outcomes.




You are organized, resourceful and comfortable working independently. As the first dedicated analyst in this area, you are excited by the opportunity to build processes, introduce structure and take ownership of how things are done.




You also enjoy collaboration. You know how to work with different teams, communicate findings clearly and build relationships with stakeholders who may not share your technical background.

Above all, you are proactive, adaptable and motivated by the opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business.




Why Join Moe's Home Collection?

This is an opportunity to join a creative, entrepreneurial and people-first organization that values fresh ideas, collaboration and continuous improvement.




Make an impact: Step into a newly established role where you can shape reporting processes, build systems and directly influence product quality improvements.
Collaborative environment: Work alongside passionate and creative colleagues across multiple brands and departments.
Flexible work arrangements: Full-time hybrid/remote opportunity, with Vancouver, BC preferred.
Competitive compensation: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $70,000, plus bonus.
Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental and vision coverage, including enhanced mental health resources.
Time to recharge: Three weeks of vacation in your first year.
Professional development: Opportunities to learn, grow and expand your skills as the business evolves.
Product discounts: Generous discounts for employees, friends and family.
Workplace perks: A casual and open Vancouver office with views of downtown and the North Shore mountains, ergonomic sit-stand workstations, a stocked kitchen, free EV charging and an office gym.
Wellness benefits: Complimentary weekly spin classes at Ride Cycle Club in Vancouver and Toronto.

Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.

Title: Senior Growth Data Analyst
Description:
About Binance.US:

Binance.US is a licensed and regulated U.S. cryptocurrency exchange where users can buy, trade, hold, and earn digital assets. Recognized as a top U.S. crypto platform by Forbes (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2026) and Business Insider (Best Crypto Exchanges of 2025), Binance.US leads the industry with its low fees, advanced trading engine, strong security and reliability, and robust compliance framework. Learn more at www.binance.us. All roles supporting Binance.US are employed via BAM Management US Holdings Inc. or BAM Management Canada Holdings Inc.

About This Role

Binance.US, one of the most recognized brands in cryptocurrency, is looking for a Senior Growth Data Analyst to join our Data organization as a dedicated partner to the Marketing team. You'll sit within Data — with the rigor, tooling, and standards that come with it — while working day-to-day alongside performance, lifecycle, brand, and growth teams to shape and measure marketing strategy. This is a high-ownership individual-contributor role for someone who wants to build the analytical foundation a fast-growing marketing org needs, and to influence where and how we invest. As the function matures, there's a clear path for this role to grow a team underneath it.

What You'll Do


Serve as the embedded data partner to Marketing, bringing rigorous, data-driven decision-making to a team that today lacks dedicated analytical support.
Stand up and own the marketing measurement foundation across AppsFlyer, GA4, Firebase and Braze: event tracking plans, QA with Product and Engineering, unified attribution windows, and KPI frameworks.
Connect that data into clean, reconciled datasets in the warehouse, so channels can be compared apples-to-apples and discrepancies are caught and fixed.
Develop self-serve dashboards and recurring reporting that give Marketing and leadership clear visibility into performance.
Analyze the full funnel (acquisition → activation → engagement → retention → monetization), surface the highest-impact growth opportunities, and size them.
Design, run, and read out experiments and A/B tests across acquisition and the customer lifecycle, and set the experimentation standard for the marketing org.
Build and maintain the core models that drive spend decisions: LTV, ROAS, CAC/payback, and retention; translate them into channel strategy and budget allocation recommendations.
Translate analysis into clear, persuasive recommendations, and influence marketing investment decisions with stakeholders up to leadership.


What You'll Bring


4-7 years in marketing/growth analytics or data science, ideally at a consumer-facing tech, fintech, or startup, with a track record of driving measurable growth.
Hands-on experience with AppsFlyer and GA4/Firebase, from tracking plans to raw data exports.
Advanced SQL and comfort working with large-scale data in modern warehouse environments.
Strong grounding in marketing attribution, experimentation and statistics, funnel analysis, retention, ARPU, and LTV.
Proficiency with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar).
Clear communicator who turns analysis into recommendations for Marketing and leadership.
A self-starter comfortable building from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.


Nice to have


Crypto, fintech, or financial services experience.
Python or R for analysis and modeling.
Prior experience building LTV or retention models.
Experience building audience segments and activating warehouse data into ad platforms.
Bachelor's in a quantitative field.


Salary:

The starting pay range for this role is between CAD $123,768 - CAD $140,327 per year for all Canadian remote locations and between USD$131,760 - $154,200 per year for all U.S. remote locations. The actual base pay will vary, and is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skill sets, work experience, business needs, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change.

At Binance.US, our mission is to create a more inclusive financial system through Web3 technologies. As a U.S. regulated crypto platform, we’re committed to earning trust through compliance and empowering people to do more with their money, bringing financial freedom within reach for all.

Our Values:

Our values shape how we work, make decisions, and support our users every day:


Act with Integrity: We do what’s right, even when no one is watching.
Be Collaborative: We work together with respect and transparency to achieve shared goals.
Customers First: We listen to, advocate for, and prioritize our users in every decision we make.
Do the Work: We take ownership, follow through, and deliver results that move the mission forward.
Embrace Change: We stay adaptable and curious, thriving in a fast moving industry.


Our Benefits:

We believe in supporting our people with flexibility, balance, and opportunities to grow. One of the ways we demonstrate this commitment is through our benefit offerings.


Time Off: Unlimited PTO (for salaried FTE roles).
Well-Being: Mental wellness benefits; free 1:1 virtual visits with a licensed mental wellness professional; comprehensive competitive health benefits.
Remote-First Culture: Fully remote, cameras-on culture with work-from-home equipment reimbursements available to new hires.
Professional & Financial Growth: Annual professional development budget; free 1:1 virtual visits with a career coach; 401k plan with employer match.

Our mission is to give our customers access to a broad array of digital assets, and we thrive because of the diverse and inclusive team that we are building. Title: Operations Data Analyst
Description:
ABOUT 49North

49North is a Canadian defence company delivering secure, multi-domain C4ISR capabilities that provide decision advantage in complex and contested environments. A wholly-owned subsidiary of MDA Space, building on more than five decades of trusted Canadian defence delivery, 49North operates as a sovereign Canadian provider of mission-critical C4ISR systems, bringing disciplined prime-contractor execution to defence and security programs.

Visit 49North | An MDA Space Company.

49North is rooted in the execution of large, complex, and mission-critical programs developed within 49NORTH. This legacy reflects a record of delivery where engineering rigour, operational reliability, and national trust are non-negotiable.

49North Defence strengthens Canada’s sovereign defence capability by delivering integrated mission systems and multi-domain C4ISR integration, enabling trusted Canadian and coalition operations, assured interoperability, and sustained readiness.

Role

The role of Operations Data Analyst reports to the Director, Mission Assurance and resides within the Administration function of the larger Programs & Operations Team of 49North, an MDA Space business. As an Operations Data Analyst, you will work with business stakeholders to realize business intelligence through structured data analysis, processing and visualization. This role also includes Process Specialist responsibilities, you will work with process stakeholders to define, realize (implement), deploy and maintain in-scope processes as well as administrate supporting systems, notably the 49North Business Process System (BPS). As an ISO 9001 certified Quality System and plans to implement Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), you will help continuously improve select enterprise systems to meet local needs and assist in the deployment of OneMDA Corporate improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities of the Operations Data Analyst includes those associated with continual improvement as a Process Specialist. In terms of data analysis, two aspects are considered: business intelligence initiation and business intelligence realization.

Business Intelligence Initiation

Works With Business Leadership And Performs The Following


Identifies the means to quantitatively or qualitatively support assessment of key business objectives and their corresponding Critical Success Factors through identification of Key Performance Indicators and associated metrics
Creates plans describing the bringing together of data sources, working with Corporate stakeholders (e.g. IT) as necessary


Business Intelligence Realization


Identifies and assesses data sources for suitability and takes actions to remediate data quality and integrity as necessary
Connects data sources in a way that enables collective analysis
Develops dashboards, reports and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to performance
Performs analyses identifying trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement
Provides and/or presents evidence-based data interpretations and recommendations


In terms of continual improvement, two aspects are considered: facilitating implementation and change initiatives and administrating supporting systems.

Implementation and Change Initiatives Facilitation

Sources of improvement efforts can include ongoing activities (e.g. maintaining the BPS), local business initiatives (e.g. implementing CMMI), and enabling the deployment of Corporate-sponsored OneMDA initiatives.


Collaborates with leaders and subject matter experts to understand business challenges and information needs
Administrates the identification, prioritization and effort reporting of process improvement initiatives
Assesses processes (e.g. preforms value stream mapping), including creating as-is and to-be depictions of process, to identify and eliminate inefficiencies, waste, and ineffectiveness
Facilitates discovery activities working with process stakeholders and subject matter experts
Creates/revises process descriptions (e.g. procedures) and associated process artifacts (e.g. forms, templates) and training materials


Supporting Systems Administration


Establishes and maintains the process improvement roadmap reflecting the priorities of Operational Excellence and, as applicable, upgrades to the content of the BPS
Maintains the BPS through the evaluation of process Change Requests (CRs) and administration of Change Control Board (CCB) meetings with Process Owners
Participates in the review of Lessons Learned reports to identify potential opportunities for improvement (OFIs)
Leads the disposition of OFI records
Serves as the local MS SharePoint administrator and maintains the BPS infrastructure and associated instructional information on use and administration of the BPS
Performs process change impact assessments for proposed or planned changes
Establishes and maintains a process improvement performance dashboard and periodically reports on process improvement performance


Requirements (experience/skills)


A two- or three-year accredited diploma or certificate program in data analysis
Minimum 2 years of experience in the definition, implementation, maintenance and administration of business processes
Working knowledge of and administrator-level hands-on experience with Power BI
Experience with database management systems and related query language, notably SQL
Microsoft SharePoint site-level administrator experience including HTML and Java scripting capabilities
Experience with a structured change implementation methodology as applied to business processes is required. Experience in process value-stream mapping is considered an asset
Willingness to extend one’s own technical capabilities through learning
Experience working within a quality management system or an ISO- or CMMI-certified workplace is considered an asset
Experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g. Infor LN) is considered an asset
History of taking the initiative while diplomatically keeping leadership stakeholders informed along the way
Strong interpersonal skills, particularly in the areas of peer collaboration and teamwork; comfortable interfacing with the senior management team and able to ‘sell’ improvement initiatives
Proven communication skills with an ability to present to multiple stakeholder groups and achieve their buy-in for improvement initiatives


We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join 49North to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward.

Comments/Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold Canadian security clearance at the secret level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP).

Benefits Statement

49North provides competitive compensation and benefits packages for its employees at all locations. As a team member of 49North, you and your qualified dependents are eligible to participate in a benefit plan that ensures a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care including; extended healthcare and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans; and an employee and family assistance program.

Equal Opportunity Statement

49North is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please feel free to notify us.

Accommodations

49North is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

#IND

The compensation range for this position is $75,000.00 - $102,000.00 annually. The specific compensation offered will be based on the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The expected base salary range for this position is $60,000–$90,000. The midpoint represents our general market target for a fully qualified and experienced individual performing the role. Actual starting salary may fall below or above the midpoint depending on the candidate's relevant experience, skills and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

What We Offer

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:


Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.


For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt
Description:
About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract) will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:


Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs
Develop and maintain business logic, portfolio calculations, and data transformation rules that underpin reporting outputs
Serve as the primary business-side liaison to IT and ED&A, translating reporting requirements into data specifications and validating platform outputs
Support data enablement initiatives and ongoing data management and governance priorities across the RE Debt portfolio
Validate and reconcile data collected from different systems using AI-powered anomaly detection to improve data quality and identify process improvement opportunities


Experience And Qualifications:


University degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field) OR a background in Economics, Finance or a related business field. CFA or similar designation is a plus
2–3 years of experience working in a data analyst role, ideally in investment management or real estate.
Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrates an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages.
Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction.
Advanced knowledge of SQL, Power Query, Excel, and Power BI is required. Familiarity with Anaplan or a similar planning tool is an asset. Experience with Tableau or Python is considered a plus.
Proactive approach to leveraging technology for process improvement and analytical enhancement. Comfortable learning and applying new tools, automation techniques, GenAI applications (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot), and advanced analytics platforms to solve complex problems, automate data analysis, rapidly prototype financial models, and deliver higher-quality insights.
Has a questioning frame of mind, asks “why” and challenges the status quo with improvements to drive change when needed.


The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $74,000-$84,000.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

26WD100682, Spécialiste en analyse marketing

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que spécialiste des analyses marketing, vous contribuerez à établir des liens entre les différents points de contact clients, numériques et non numériques, chez Autodesk, afin de générer des résultats commerciaux clés. Vous aurez l’opportunité d’influencer directement la croissance du marketing et du commerce électronique, ainsi que d’améliorer l’expérience client. Ce poste est fortement transversal et collaboratif ; vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des parties prenantes internationales ainsi qu’avec d’autres équipes en dehors de votre structure immédiate.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité de carrière passionnante pour un(e) analyste marketing chevronné(e) et doté(e) d'un sens aigu des affaires, animé(e) par la passion de l'analyse, de la mise en valeur des données et de l'amélioration de l'impact du marketing sur l'activité, ainsi que de l'amélioration de l'expérience client et des résultats. Si vous recherchez un poste stimulant, mais aussi très gratifiant et à fort impact, alors poursuivez votre lecture !

Responsabilités


Prendre en charge divers projets d’analyse liés au numérique, au marketing et au commerce électronique afin d’accompagner les équipes internationales à l’aide de données, de tableaux de bord et d’informations sur les éléments standards du cycle de vie des clients par abonnement, notamment l’acquisition, la fidélisation et l’expansion
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux et les membres de l’équipe pour explorer divers sujets, tels que les opportunités de marché, les parcours sectoriels/produits, la contribution du numérique, l’entonnoir d’achat et les analyses du comportement client, afin d’en extraire des informations précieuses
Collecter, analyser et visualiser les données à l’aide d’outils permettant d’exploiter et de synthétiser efficacement les informations pour présenter un récit concis et exploitable, et communiquer des conclusions qui éclairent les décisions commerciales
Collaborer de manière proactive et efficace avec d’autres équipes d’Autodesk afin d’harmoniser les indicateurs et les définitions. Identifier les éventuelles lacunes dans les mesures et/ou les indicateurs, définir les rapports et analyses supplémentaires requis et rationaliser les rapports existants
Encourager l’autogestion et permettre aux parties prenantes de mieux comprendre les données


Qualifications Minimales


3 ans ou plus d’expérience pertinente.
Solides aptitudes logiques, avec la capacité de présenter des données complexes sous forme de récits et de visualisations simples, concis et captivants qui mettent les informations clés en avant.
Un sixième sens pour les « données pertinentes », avec la capacité de trouver des solutions créatives mais pragmatiques à des problèmes liés aux données.
Esprit d’initiative, capable de prendre des initiatives et ayant fait ses preuves dans la collaboration et l’influence auprès des parties prenantes et des partenaires commerciaux de manière transversale.
Attitude positive et volontariste – Capacité à faire preuve de flexibilité et d’ouverture face aux changements d’exigences, d’orientations ou de circonstances, avec un besoin minimal de réorientation


Qualifications Souhaitées


Solides connaissances de l’environnement numérique et marketing (e-commerce), avec une expérience des indicateurs et analyses liés au marketing, au e-commerce ou aux modèles d’abonnement
Capacité à réfléchir de manière stratégique aux problèmes commerciaux concrets dans le domaine du marketing et à les mettre en corrélation avec les données sous-jacentes afin de mener des analyses approfondies et d’identifier des solutions innovantes
Solides compétences en matière de présentation et d’expression orale, avec une expérience des présentations devant la direction
Solide expérience des outils de visualisation tels que Power BI (y compris DAX), Tableau, etc.
Solides bases en manipulation de données à l’aide de SQL ainsi que d’Excel avancé (visualisation, tableaux croisés dynamiques, etc.) ; une expérience des macros et/ou de VBA constitue un atout certain
Expérience en analyse web avec des outils tels qu’Adobe Analytics ou Google Analytics
Une expérience en modélisation analytique et dans les langages de programmation associés (R, Python) est un atout


26WD100682, Marketing Insights Specialist

Position Overview

As a Marketing Insights Specialist, you will help connect the dots across various digital and non digital customer touch points at Autodesk that lead to key business outcomes. You will have the opportunity to directly influence Marketing and eComm growth and improve customer experience. This position is highly cross-functional and collaborative, working closely with global stakeholders as well as other teams outside of the immediate organization.

This is an exciting career opportunity for a strong, business-savvy Marketing analyst, with a passion for measurement, data story telling and improving marketing's impact on the business as well as improving customer experience and outcomes. If you are searching for a challenging, yet highly rewarding role with great impact, then read on!

Responsibilities


Take ownership of a variety of Digital, Marketing and eCommerce related analytics projects to support global teams with data, dashboards and insights around standard Subscription customer life cycle elements including acquisition, retention and expansion
Work closely with business partners and team members to explore a variety of topics, such as market opportunity, industry/product journeys, digital contribution, purchase funnel and customer behavior analyses to extract valuable insights
Source, analyze and visualize data using tools to effectively mine and condense insights to tell a concise and actionable story and communicate findings that inform business decisions
Collaborate proactively and effectively with other Autodesk teams to align on metrics and definitions. Identify any gaps in measurements and/or metrics, define the additional reports and analyses required and streamline existing reporting
Encourage self-service and enable stakeholders to better understand data


Minimum Qualifications


3 + years of relevant experience.
Strong logical aptitude with the ability to present complex data as simple, concise, and engaging stories and visualizations that bring insights to the forefront.
Sixth sense for “meaningful data” with the ability to find creative, yet pragmatic solutions to data-oriented problems.
Self-starter, who takes initiative and demonstrated success in working with and influencing stakeholders, business partners cross-functionally.
Positive, can-do attitude – Ability to be flexible and open to changes in requirements, directions or circumstances with minimal need for reorientation


Preferred Qualifications


Solid knowledge of digital and marketing (eCommerce) environment with experience in related Marketing, eComm or Subscription model-based metrics and analytics
Ability to think strategically about real-world business problems in Marketing and co-relate them with underlying data to conduct deeper analyses and identify innovative solutions
Strong presentation and language skills with experience presenting to upper management
Strong experience in visualization tools such as Power BI (including DAX), Tableau etc.
Solid foundation in manipulating data using SQL as well as advanced Excel (visualization, pivot tables etc.), experience with macros and/or VBA is a definite plus
Experience in web analytics with tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics
Experience with analytical modelling and related programming languages (R, Python) a plus

Il s'agit d'une opportunité de carrière passionnante pour un(e) analyste marketing chevronné(e) et doté(e) d'un sens aigu des affaires, animé(e) par la passion de l'analyse, de la mise en valeur des données et de l'amélioration de l'impact du marketing sur l'activité, ainsi que de l'amélioration de l'expérience client et des résultats. Responsabilités

  • Prendre en charge divers projets d’analyse liés au numérique, au marketing et au commerce électronique afin d’accompagner les équipes internationales à l’aide de données, de tableaux de bord et d’informations sur les éléments standards du cycle de vie des clients par abonnement, notamment l’acquisition, la fidélisation et l’expansion
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux et les membres de l’équipe pour explorer divers sujets, tels que les opportunités de marché, les parcours sectoriels/produits, la contribution du numérique, l’entonnoir d’achat et les analyses du comportement client, afin d’en extraire des informations précieuses
  • Collecter, analyser et visualiser les données à l’aide d’outils permettant d’exploiter et de synthétiser efficacement les informations pour présenter un récit concis et exploitable, et communiquer des conclusions qui éclairent les décisions commerciales
  • Collaborer de manière proactive et efficace avec d’autres équipes d’Autodesk afin d’harmoniser les indicateurs et les définitions.   • Encourager l’autogestion et permettre aux parties prenantes de mieux comprendre les données

  • Solides compétences en matière de présentation et d’expression orale, avec une expérience des présentations devant la direction

Description

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, this is your opportunity to be at the intersection of data, analysis, hiring, and strategy that will make it possible for our teams to fulfill that customer promise every day.

In this role, you will own data analytics projects from beginning to end, and will build reports, compile metrics, and own ad hoc and trend analysis. You will work with Talent Acquisition leadership to achieve business objectives and communicate insights to key stakeholders. You will provide analytical support for various Talent Acquisition programs, and build tools to surface timely, meaningful, and actionable data that will drive proactive decision making. Your analysis will contribute deeply to the development of our strategy and drive impact against our hiring objectives. You will collaborate with subject matter experts across Amazon to work through complex problems and to create unified scalable reporting solutions at an enterprise-wide level. You will have the opportunity to partner with the central HR Information Systems teams as an influencer on their next generation road map.

Key job responsibilities


Collaborate with recruiting operations, data scientists, and business leaders to define business processes and provide analytical support
Leverage code to analyze complex datasets and design, develop and evaluate data transformations to solve specific business problems
Build scalable, efficient, and automated data processes to facilitate customer-facing reporting
Automate TA processes to streamline business operations
Communicate verbally or in writing to business customers / leadership for sharing insights and recommendations
Build dashboards and reports for both recruiting leaders and the businesses they support
Perform complex data analysis across multiple systems to support both scheduled and ad-hoc reporting requests
Mine key performance indicators to discover root causes
Analyze business outcome data in order to identify relationships and trends; incorporate data visualization and statistical analyses


About The Team

Amazon delights millions of customers around the world, and the Talent Acquisition team enables our business leaders to make informed and effective hiring decisions.

Basic Qualifications


5+ years of professional or military experience
5+ years of SQL experience
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
Experience with AWS technologies


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Us:

With over 60 years of industry experience, Gescan has 29 branches located across Western Canada. At Gescan, we leverage our strong global resource base, our local expertise, and our family-oriented values to deliver the best service to our customers and suppliers.

We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 110 locations with coverage in 9 provinces.

To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com




What’s In It For You?

You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
You will be working for the world's #1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.




Scope

Under the supervision of the Pricing Manager, the primary mandate of the Pricing Analyst is to analyze any trend, from products, categories, customers and suppliers. The analyst will be responsible for the creation, structure and management of the product database.




Responsibilities

Tool development
Develop dynamic pricing tools and models to effectively meet business needs.
Extract, process, and edit reports from Cognos and Power BI (Excel file, Access, pivot tables).
Perform complex analyses of our current pricing, product, vendor customer data using Excel, Power BI, Cognos, and our internal and external databases.
Analyze and interpret market trends in collaboration with internal teams for the purpose of developing competitive pricing strategies;
Analyze data from a variety of sources to better understand pricing strategies, better structure our customer types, and better aggregate our products and suppliers.
Prepare and present the results of the pricing and profitability analysis to management.
Keep abreast of different methods of price analysis, industry trends, and database management
Develop dynamic tools to improve database management.
Participate in the management of the information of the database and ensure the compliance of the information found therein and propose solutions.Team Support
Validate and approve pricing agreements on a daily basis to understand the pricing cycle and support the team as needed.
Assist the team in preparing for IT changes on products, categories, customers and suppliers.
All other related tasks.




Required

Bachelor's degree in administration or related field.
Excellent command of Microsoft Office suite tools (Excel, Access, Outlook, Teams).
Good knowledge of technological tools such as MS VBA/SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Apps.
Knowledge of Cognos (an asset). • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in the field and/or related field.
Experience in interpretation, data analysis, database management, and dashboard creation.
Programming experience (basic).




Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits.

Benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account & RRSP matching.
Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

Title: Process & Data Mapping Associate
Description:
About Wesgar
Wesgar is a leader in the custom sheet metal fabrication industry, specializing in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing for a wide range of global sectors. Based in Port Coquitlam, we pride ourselves on a workplace culture built on empathy, professional development, and operational excellence. We are committed to maintaining a professional, inclusive, and high-energy environment where every team member has the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects.

Position Summary
Wesgar is seeking an early-career Process & Data Mapping Associate to support continuous improvement across our production and warehouse operations.

The primary focus of this role is analyzing and interpreting manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement. You will work with large operational datasets, production KPIs, and information from multiple systems to understand what is happening on the shop floor and translate findings into practical recommendations.

The role also includes direct observation of production processes, working with operators and supervisors to validate findings, and documenting current and improved workflows. This is a hands-on position that combines data analysis with a practical understanding of manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

Production Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect, organize, clean, and analyze production and operational data from multiple sources
Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, downtime, process variation, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities
Work with large datasets and validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency before drawing conclusions
Develop and maintain Excel reports, dashboards, trackers, and analytical tools to support operational decision-making
Compare production performance across processes, equipment, products, shifts, or time periods to identify meaningful patterns
Translate data findings into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for production and operational teams
Establish and monitor relevant KPIs to measure process performance and the impact of implemented improvements
Present analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Process Improvement & Operational Analysis
Work directly with production teams to understand the operational context behind the data and validate analytical findings
Observe production and warehouse processes firsthand to understand workflows, material movement, equipment use, and operator practices
Investigate production issues using data, direct observation, and input from operators and supervisors
Support root cause analysis and corrective actions related to productivity, quality, workflow, and other operational issues
Develop and evaluate practical process-improvement options based on quantitative and observational findings
Support pilot activities, implementation, and follow-up to determine whether improvements are achieving the expected results
Process Mapping & Documentation
Document current-state workflows and key process steps based on production-floor observation and stakeholder input
Create and update process maps, flowcharts, SOPs, work instructions, and other process documentation
Help develop improved future-state workflows where process changes are required
Work with operators, supervisors, and process owners to ensure documentation accurately reflects how work is performed
Support the transition of successful process improvements into clear and sustainable standard work


Requirements

Experience working with HRIS platforms such as SAP and SuccessFactors, and large, complex datasets

BC Mental Health Program

Burnaby, BC

In accordance with the Mission, Vision and Values, and strategic directions of PHSA safety, including both patient and employee safety, is a priority and a responsibility shared by everyone at PHSA. As such, the requirement to continuously improve quality and safety is inherent in all aspects of this position. The Senior Business Analyst, performs a variety of roles to contribute and promote excellent practices in performance measurement and the alignment of measurement standards across PHSA’s agencies and services. Working on multiple executive’s projects simultaneously, the Senior Business Analyst is self-driven in carrying out duties such as researching and evaluating performance measurement best practice approaches, proposing and implementing improvements to PHSA’s processes and measurements and conducting and summarizing broad subject research to ensure successful delivery of performance measurement solutions.

What You’ll Do


Develop strategies and project plans, evaluate progress and realigns resources on high profile projects that involve analyzing data from multiple data sources, developing/improving performance indicators and preparing/publishing reports for various audience groups.
Liaise with a variety of internal and external stakeholders such as program managers, data custodians, patient quality directors, health authorities and MoH business analysts and managers to collaborate and obtain feedback to deliver performance measurement solutions for PHSA and other agencies.
Propose and implement solutions based on evidence and literature reviews on how best to access, use and interpret performance results to various levels of PHSA leaders such as Directors, Executives and Board Committee members.
Provide technical and business guidance and direction to other project staff by identifying resources required, assigning tasks to staff, setting priorities and reassigning work when necessary to ensure project deadlines are met. Document projects and change processes and ensure stakeholder feedback and approval is captured.
Ensure internal, external and public reporting needs are met by gathering and negotiating reporting requirements from customers and stakeholders, communicating requirements and following up with stakeholders regularly to develop and implement an examination process for the final reports.
Identify issues with data and takes initiative in working out optimal solutions with appropriate stakeholders to improve accuracy, timeliness, connectivity and other data issues.
Produce high quality research reports on subjects related to SIM, BCMHSUS and related agencies and services through literature researches and the identification and examination of relevant SIM websites. Create and maintain systems that allow information to be easily searched and retrieved and determines how information should be shared.
Conduct multi-layer data analysis independently by linking data from multiple health information data sources such as patient registries, admissions databases and vital statistics.


Qualifications

What you bring


A level of education, training and experience equivalent to a Master’s degree in Health Informatics or related program plus a minimum of three (3) years of recent experience in health care or information management.
Demonstrated knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples in social and health contexts, including supported by significant knowledge of Indigenous-specific mandates, including clear understanding of and commitment to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism and discrimination and embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility.
Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism and systemic racism on Indigenous Peoples within social and health contexts. Show a clear commitment to identifying, challenging, and eradicating Indigenous-specific racism and all forms of discrimination impacting equity-deserving groups within health care settings. This involves familiarity and understanding Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility recognizing personal biases, institutional barriers, engaging in anti-racism education and training and advocating for systemic change.
Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of legislative obligations and provincial commitments within BC Mental Health Program contexts found in the foundational documents including Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan and Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study - BC Human Rights Code, BC Anti-racism Act and how they intersect across the health care system.

Brings an understanding of the Indigenous specific racism and the broader systemic racism that exists in the colonial health care structure, and has demonstrated initiatives in breaking down barriers and ensuring a safe environment ensuring a sense of belonging to all and informed by Indigenous Cultural Safety.
Awareness of social, economic, political and historical realities of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples and familiarity with addressing Indigenous-specific anti-racism, anti-racism and Indigenous Cultural Safety and foundational documents and legislative commitments (the Declaration Act, the Declaration Action Plan, TRC, IPS, Remembering Keegan, etc.).


Skills & Knowledge


Ability to understand and interpret data management concepts and processes. Ability to communicate complex and technical ideas in simple language. Demonstrated ability to perform accurate advanced data manipulation, analysis and information presentation using Microsoft Office suite, database and statistical software. Knowledge of library databases searching tools and methods. Ability to conduct brief and detailed subject researches depending on the request. A commitment to customer service and strong skills in preparing professional presentation material. Knowledge and adherence to privacy and confidentiality policies and measures to protect data and information sources. Ability to write, edit, and publish reports professionally. Knowledge and experience in project management, strategic planning and implementation.
Demonstrates a commitment to beginning and/or continuing their personal learning journey related to Indigenous-specific racism and dismantling systems of oppression, as well as addressing racism more broadly. Shows willingness to articulate and share their learning experiences to contribute to a culture of motivation and inspiration among peers.
Demonstrates foundational knowledge of the social, economic, and political realities of settler-colonialism and its impacts on Indigenous peoples and equity-deserving groups within social and health contexts. Understands the impact of social determinants of health-on-health outcomes. Shows a commitment to learning about and upholding legislative obligations and provincial commitments outlined in foundational documents such as the Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place: Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan, Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study, the BC Human Rights Code, Anti-Racism Data Act, and the Distinctions Based Approach.


What We Bring

Every PHSA employee enables the best possible patient care for our patients and their families. Whether you are providing direct care, conducting research, or making it possible for others to do their work, you impact the lives of British Columbians today and in the future. That’s why we’re focused on your care too – offering health, wellness, development programs to support you – at work and at home.

BC Mental Health Program

Burnaby, BC

In accordance with the Mission, Vision and Values, and strategic directions of PHSA safety, including both patient and employee safety, is a priority and a responsibility shared by everyone at PHSA. As such, the requirement to continuously improve quality and safety is inherent in all aspects of this position. The Senior Business Analyst, performs a variety of roles to contribute and promote excellent practices in performance measurement and the alignment of measurement standards across PHSA’s agencies and services. Working on multiple executive’s projects simultaneously, the Senior Business Analyst is self-driven in carrying out duties such as researching and evaluating performance measurement best practice approaches, proposing and implementing improvements to PHSA’s processes and measurements and conducting and summarizing broad subject research to ensure successful delivery of performance measurement solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop strategies and project plans, evaluate progress and realigns resources on high profile projects that involve analyzing data from multiple data sources, developing/improving performance indicators and preparing/publishing reports for various audience groups.
  • Liaise with a variety of internal and external stakeholders such as program managers, data custodians, patient quality directors, health authorities and MoH business analysts and managers to collaborate and obtain feedback to deliver performance measurement solutions for PHSA and other agencies.
  • Propose and implement solutions based on evidence and literature reviews on how best to access, use and interpret performance results to various levels of PHSA leaders such as Directors, Executives and Board Committee members.
  • Provide technical and business guidance and direction to other project staff by identifying resources required, assigning tasks to staff, setting priorities and reassigning work when necessary to ensure project deadlines are met. Document projects and change processes and ensure stakeholder feedback and approval is captured.
  • Ensure internal, external and public reporting needs are met by gathering and negotiating reporting requirements from customers and stakeholders, communicating requirements and following up with stakeholders regularly to develop and implement an examination process for the final reports.
  • Identify issues with data and takes initiative in working out optimal solutions with appropriate stakeholders to improve accuracy, timeliness, connectivity and other data issues.
  • Produce high quality research reports on subjects related to SIM, BCMHSUS and related agencies and services through literature researches and the identification and examination of relevant SIM websites. Create and maintain systems that allow information to be easily searched and retrieved and determines how information should be shared.
  • Conduct multi-layer data analysis independently by linking data from multiple health information data sources such as patient registries, admissions databases and vital statistics.

Qualifications

What you bring

  • A level of education, training and experience equivalent to a Master’s degree in Health Informatics or related program plus a minimum of three (3) years of recent experience in health care or information management.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism on Indigenous Peoples in social and health contexts, including supported by significant knowledge of Indigenous-specific mandates, including clear understanding of and commitment to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism and discrimination and embed Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the historic and ongoing impacts of settler colonialism and systemic racism on Indigenous Peoples within social and health contexts. This includes understanding how these factors contribute to current health disparities and barriers to care. Show a clear commitment to identifying, challenging, and eradicating Indigenous-specific racism and all forms of discrimination impacting equity-deserving groups within health care settings. This involves familiarity and understanding Indigenous Cultural Safety and Humility recognizing personal biases, institutional barriers, engaging in anti-racism education and training and advocating for systemic change.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of legislative obligations and provincial commitments within BC Mental Health Program contexts found in the foundational documents including Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan and Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study - BC Human Rights Code, BC Anti-racism Act and how they intersect across the health care system.

Title: Pipe Integrity Analyst
Description:
About DarkVision Technologies Inc.

DarkVision is a Vancouver-based tech company that has been disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013. We have created the world’s most advanced acoustic-based imaging platform, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.

Backed by Blackstone, one of the world’s largest private equity firms, DarkVision’s team of Software, Mechanical, and Machine Learning Engineers and Data Analysts is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company’s current and upcoming products.

Our employees work on cutting-edge technologies that blend science with real-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.

Your Job

DarkVision is seeking a Pipe Integrity Analyst to join our Well Integrity Data Analysis Team in North Vancouver, BC. In this role, you will analyze high-resolution ultrasound scans of oil and gas wells and transform the results into actionable reports, 3D images, detailed models, and quantifiable insights that help clients make informed decisions about the safe and efficient operation of their multi-million-dollar assets.

This position requires 100% on-site work at our North Vancouver (day shifts) and Downtown Vancouver (night shifts) offices. A willingness to work nights is necessary to be considered for this role.

Please note that this role does not offer work permit or permanent residency sponsorship.

Scheduling

Below is a general outline of what your schedule will look like:


Training Period: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Post-Training: Up to 8-week rotation of 12-hour shifts (Tuesday to Tuesday):
8 days on (7:00 AM – 7:30 PM), 6 days off
A half-shift on Tuesdays for live handover
Future scheduling: Analysts will be assigned to night coverage schedules, with rotating weeks of days and nights coverage. You can expect up to 50% of your shifts to be night shifts.

Our Team

DarkVision’s acoustic imaging technology collects terabytes of high-fidelity data on every run. Our Data Analysis team plays a critical role in turning these massive datasets into valuable insights using proprietary visualization software. The team is meticulous, methodical, and thorough - delivering analysis that directly supports high-impact, multi-million-dollar decisions.

What You Will Do


Work on the highest impact and fastest turnaround projects for offshore and international wells
Inspect and interpret ultrasound data using proprietary software to identify features and defects
Review and aggregate information from client documents
Follow detailed processes for completing analyses
Generate and edit reports
Generate images, videos, and 3D renderings
Complete and deliver preliminary reports to clients
Learn and master new types of analysis as DarkVision increases its product offerings


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Ability to work 100% on-site in our North Vancouver office during days and Downtown Vancouver office during nights
Ability to work the shifts described above, night shift in particular
At least 6 months of experience in an engineering or scientific discipline; co-op/internship experience is acceptable
STEM degree or diploma
Experience working under tight deadlines with fast turnarounds


What Will Put You Ahead


Image processing experience
Experience with 3D data
Data visualization experience
Experience in the Oil & Gas industry
Experience performing reviews or quality checks on other people’s work
Experience making critical decisions independently (e.g. when working alone during night shift)
Education in petroleum engineering, mechanical engineering, or chemical engineering preferred


General Salary Range

For this role, we anticipate paying $30 to $34 per hour.
