You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
  • Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
  • Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
  • Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
  • Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
  • Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
  • Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.

We're excited about you because…

  • You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
  • You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
  • You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
  • You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
  • You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
  • You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
  • You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
  • You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Make an impact with our Consulting – Economics team as an Analyst. As a trusted advisor, you’ll evaluate programs and business alternatives, determine economic and financial contributions, develop public policy and empower clients to make informed strategic decisions.

MNP is proudly Canadian. Providing business strategies and solutions, we are a leading national accounting, tax and business advisory firm in Canada. Execute business planning, feasibility studies, strategic planning, operational planning, program review, program re-deigns, financial analysis and other forms of management consulting

Title: Associate Planner | Global Inventory
Description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

As a member of the product team, the Global Planning team is responsible for ensuring the efficient management of inventory for the company. They work closely with the regional teams to understand new product trends, regional needs, size trends, and logistics. The team monitors inventory levels on a weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis, assessing changes in trends and adjusting strategies to optimize inventory management and mitigate risks. The priority is to understand and protect the guest experience, followed by maintaining effective inventory control and supporting profitable sales growth.

Reporting to the Global Inventory & Operations Planning Manager, the Global Associate Planner plays a key role in supporting global inventory planning and visibility across the business. This role is responsible for developing forward-looking inventory projections, assessing inventory health, and translating data into insights that support planning and operational decisions. You will work closely with Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional partners to understand inventory flow, identify risks and opportunities, and support both short- and long-term business priorities.


Inventory Health & Insights: Analyze inventory performance and develop inventory composition and aged inventory projections across global and market levels. Assess the health, balance, and aging of inventory, identifying emerging risks and opportunities and providing actionable insights to support inventory decisions and leadership discussions.
Inventory Flow & Projections: Manage and analyze on-orders, receipts, and inventory flow to maintain visibility to future inventory positions. Partner closely with DC Operations to develop inbound and outbound projections that support capacity planning, operational readiness, and changing business needs.
Business Performance & Reporting: Monitor key inventory and planning KPIs against plan and prior year. Analyze trends and underlying drivers to identify areas of opportunity or risk and provide clear insights into business performance.
Leadership Insights & Presentations: Support the development of monthly and quarterly business reviews, bringing together inventory and performance data into clear, concise presentations. Highlight key trends, business drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for leadership.
Cross-Functional Planning: Build strong partnerships across Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align inventory projections, communicate changes, and ensure teams have the visibility needed to make informed decisions.
Tools & Process Improvement: Own and maintain key planning tools, dashboards, and reporting while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate processes. Support the evolution of scalable reporting and tools that improve data accuracy, visibility, and overall team efficiency.


Qualifications


College certificate or University degree is required
1-3 years merchandise planning or inventory management experience
2-3 years proven experience with data analysis
Expert knowledge of Excel & Power Bi for report building is required.
Financial acumen and understanding of retail math
Effective communication skills (written & verbal)
Extremely organized, thorough and able to prioritize
Detail orientated


must haves


Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.


Additional Notes

Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from  $80,800 - $106,100 CAD   annually ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth


Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans
Paid time off
Savings and retirement plan matching
Generous employee discount
Fitness & yoga classes
Parenthood top-up
Extensive catalog of development course offerings
People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)


Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

workplace arrangement

Hybrid

In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

Title: Project Manager 1 - Environment Data Analytics and Reporting
Description:
Job Location: Burnaby (Edmonds), British Columbia, Canada

Employment type: Temporary (approximately 12 months)

Hours of work: Full-time (37.5 hrs/wk)

Annual Salary: $109,700.00 - $138,700.00

No. of positions: 1

Closing date: October 30, 2026

About the job:

At BC Hydro, we're working towards creating a cleaner and more sustainable future for all British Columbians and need people like you to help us. A career at BC Hydro is meaningful and provides you the opportunity to be part of a talented, inclusive, and diverse team. We offer a healthy work-life balance, competitive wages, a comprehensive benefits package, and training opportunities to support you in your career growth. We're proud to be ranked as one of B.C.'s Top Employers and one of Canada's Best Diversity Employers.

We invite you to join us as we build an even cleaner B.C. We welcome applications from all qualified job seekers. If you're a person with a disability, please let us know by emailing RecruitmentHelp@bchydro.com, as adjustments can be made to help support you in your application process.

What you'll do

The Environment Strategy & Framework team creates strategic systems and processes to support informed decision making and continual improvement for the Environment Key Business Unit. As part of the team, the project manager will lead Environment's approach to data analytics and reporting. The position provides strategic leadership, governance, stakeholder engagement, change management, and oversight to strengthen data analytics and reporting capabilities across Environment, including the development and sustainment of associated tools, systems, and processes.

You are naturally curious and have a passion for complex data analysis and data management. You can synthesize and draw relationships between data and information, enabling powerful visual and verbal business insights to senior leaders. You are a master at analyzing and visualizing data in platforms such as Power BI, Excel, Tableau and other emerging analytics tools. You are detail-oriented but can also speak about the big picture. You are proactive and willing to take on unplanned challenges while adapting to changing priorities. You possess an open mind with a desire to learn and grasp new and complex problems quickly, particularly where no precedent exists. You understand how to achieve success as a key contributor to a larger team.

Major Responsibilities and Duties:

Assists/leads the development and reporting of Environment's Key Performance Indicators that support the delivery of the Strategy, Annual Action Plan, and other departmental plans.
Prepares data analytics for reports that provide powerful business insights and support informed decision making. Examples include acting as owner for the Environment Scorecard, as well as acting as a contributor to other topics such as board reporting, risk reviews, and compliance reporting.
Ensures reports are prepared and communicated after appropriate QA/QC checks are performed.
Leads opportunities to provide data analytics that can support real-time decision making.
Applies analytical skills and judgment to recommend solutions to improve and close reporting gaps to meet the needs of stakeholders.
Develops, builds, and maintains data collection tools.
Develops and delivers training to all users of Environment's reporting and other related performance reports.
Works with partners in the Technology Business Unit to ensure back-end system architecture for Environment's data analytics and reporting needs are delivered and sustained.
Works to ensure technology solutions are integrated, creating a single source of truth for Environment and across the organization.
Works with Environment's technology business partner to assess and prioritize IT upgrades and sustainment needs. These efforts support Environment employees with the tools, skills, and support they need to focus on high-value work.
Develops and delivers change management plans associated with reporting and IT systems.

What you bring

A post-secondary degree or diploma in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Science, Mathematics or Economics.
A minimum of 5 years leading projects or teams focused on data analytics and reporting, preferably in the utility sector with demonstrated capabilities in:
Identifying and developing key performance indicators.
Advanced data analytics.
Advanced proficiency with the MS365 suite of applications.
Building and sustaining reports, including dashboards, with advanced experience using Power BI.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to summarize data to visually tell a story.
Must hold a valid BC Driver's License.

The following would be considered assets:

Understanding of advanced statistics.
Project Management Professional designation from the Project Management Institute.
Experience with prioritizing and developing information technology work plans.
Experience accessing enterprise databases (e.g., SAP) to retrieve and extract raw data.

What we offer

A comprehensive benefits package
A minimum of 15 paid vacation days
A lifetime pension
Flexible work model, depending on your role type
Training and development courses

For more information on the benefits we offer, visit bchydro.com/benefits.

What else you should know

This is a Full-Time temporary (FTT) M&P Group 44 opportunity with the team located at our Edmonds office in Burnaby, BC. This opportunity is estimated to be for approximately 12 months.
Please note a condition of employment for this role is to maintain your Class 5 Driver's License in good standing.
As part of the selection process, applicants may be required to complete a written test/assessment and/or a presentation as part of the interview process.

Don't forget to update your Candidate Profile with your current resume and copies of your certifications. If applicable, include your Trades Qualification. This will ensure we have all the necessary information to assess your application without any delays.

How to apply

Click 'Apply' to be taken to BC Hydro's careers site, or visit bchydro.com/careers and search for job 52541129. Please use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge when applying. Create or update your Candidate Profile and attach your current resume and copies of your certifications before submitting.

Title: Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
About Earthdaily

EarthDaily is revolutionizing the way we understand and monitor our planet. READY TO LAUNCH?

Do you want to join one of the most exciting space companies at the forefront of global change detection/change monitoring? This is a full-time, hybrid position based at our Vancouver Convention Centre office. Occasional travel may be required.

PREPARE FOR IMPACT!

As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will partner with the Sales Operations and Finance teams to identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues, establish and enforce data entry standards, and maintain the governance processes that keep records consistent as the business scales.

As a detail-oriented problem solver with a systems mindset, you will leverage CRM tooling, reporting platforms, and all available processes to surface anomalies before they reach downstream reporting. You’ll take a proactive approach to data stewardship, routinely auditing records rather than waiting for errors to surface and translating recurring issues into durable process and system improvements. As a trusted resource to the sales and finance teams, you will ensure that account, opportunity, and pipeline data can be relied upon for forecasting, commission calculation, and executive decision-making.

Data Quality and Cleanup


Review and audit CRM records (contacts, accounts, opportunities, leads) for accuracy, completeness, and duplicates
Identify and correct data entry errors, missing fields, and inconsistent formatting in the CRM
Lead or support data cleanup projects such as deduplication, record merging, and standardizing naming conventions
Manage the import and validation of new leads or account data from third-party sources


Standards, Governance and Training


Establish and maintain data entry guidelines, and train and support sales reps on proper data entry practices
Maintain data definitions and a data dictionary for standard fields used across the sales team
Recommend process improvements to reduce recurring data quality issues
Escalate or collaborate with senior Sales Operations, Finance, and/or Data Governance staff on complex or cross-system data issues


Reporting and Metrics


Build and monitor data quality dashboards and reports, and investigate anomalies and trends
Track and report on data quality metrics (e.g., duplicate rate, field completeness, data decay) and remediation progress to Sales Operations and Finance leadership


Systems, Integrations and Automation


Partner with Sales Ops and IT on integration checks between the CRM and other connected sales tools (e.g., marketing automation, lead enrichment platforms)
Design and build sales automation and AI solutions to increase process efficiency and suggest improvements to the customer experience


YOUR PAST MISSIONS


Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, information systems, data analytics, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
1 to 4 years of experience in sales operations, sales support, data quality, revenue operations, or a related analytical role, with a proven track record of improving the accuracy and reliability of business-critical data
Hands-on experience administering or maintaining a CRM platform, including bulk data operations using data loaders, deduplication tools, or similar utilities
Demonstrated experience cleaning, reconciling, and manipulating large datasets (10,000+ rows) using advanced Excel functions such as INDEX/MATCH, nested IFs, array formulas, data tables, and Power Query
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a CRM or BI environment (Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to data governance or data quality frameworks
Experience supporting forecasting, pipeline reporting, or commission processes in a SaaS or technical sales environment
Applied use of AI for analysis or automation


YOUR TOOLKIT


Deep working knowledge of CRM data structures, including the relationships between accounts, contacts, opportunities, and pipeline stages (HubSpot preferred but not required)
Understanding of sales and marketing processes and metrics (prospecting, lead gen, contracts, time to close, ACV/TCV/LCV, CAC/CPL, ROAS/ROMI, etc.)
Understanding of finance and reporting metrics (revenue recognition, backlog and pipeline calculations, close probabilities, growth scenarios, CAGR, etc.)
Has built, or can build, AI tools to automate sales processes (e.g., Claude, HubSpot Breeze)
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation
Basic to intermediate SQL for querying and validating data across systems
Strong attention to detail with a methodical, systematic approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving data issues
Understands the downstream impact of poor data quality on forecasting, reporting, and commission accuracy
Curious and inquisitive, excellent at asking questions to understand why an error occurred rather than only correcting it
Able to work independently on recurring data quality tasks while recognizing when to escalate; highly organized with excellent time management and the ability to balance competing priorities
Strong work ethic and self-drive, with an honest and ethical approach
Team player with a proactive and positive attitude, and experience collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams


Your Compensation

Base Salary Range: $55,000 to $80,000 CAD annually

The range is based on Vancouver, BC-derived compensation for this role. Individual placement in the range is determined based on many factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The top end of the range is typically reserved for individuals that meet or exceed all required qualifications and show demonstrated experience and expertise in all responsibilities of the role.

We’d love to welcome you to our world of software for space. We have a shared passion for building production critical systems that generate near real-time views of Earth from satellites that power real-world applications like disaster mitigation, environmental monitoring and crop yield improvements.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Vancouver Convention Centre office, working in a fast-paced environment with regular collaboration across a team spread over North American time zones, and occasional travel (approximately 10%).

Competitive compensation, full benefits and flexible time off
Be part of a meaningful mission as part of one of Canada’s most innovative space companies that are developing sustainable solutions for our planet

Title: Fraud Prevention Analyst
Description:
About the Role

Punt is entering an exciting new phase of growth, with new products and verticals launching alongside our existing business. With that growth comes new revenue streams, new fund flows, new systems, and plenty of interesting finance problems to solve.




We are seeking a detail-oriented Fraud Prevention Analyst to join our Risk team, based on-site at our Vancouver head office. This role is critical to protecting our online platform from fraudulent activity, minimizing financial losses, and ensuring a safe experience for our customers. This position requires close collaboration with our Customer Support, Product, and Engineering teams. The ideal candidate combines strong quantitative skills with 2–4 years of hands-on experience with fraud prevention, chargeback mitigation in electronic payments and data analysis.




What You'll Do

Monitor transactions in real time to identify, investigate, and mitigate fraudulent activity
Analyse chargeback and large datasets to detect emerging fraud patterns and trends
Develop, test, and refine fraud detection rules and models with moderate autonomy
Manage and resolve chargebacks, disputes, and payment reconciliation issues end-to-end
Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Product, and Engineering teams to improve fraud controls and customer experience
Prepare regular reports on fraud metrics, loss trends, and key risk indicators for leadership
Stay current on payment fraud trends, regulations, and industry best practices
Identify and help implement process improvements to reduce false positives and fraud losses
Mentor junior analysts or support onboarding as needed




What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
Experience with fraud detection platforms or tools
2–4 years of experience working with electronic payments within North America, including chargeback processes and dispute resolution
Demonstrated experience analyzing and working with large datasets
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with moderate independence
Excellent attention to detail and sound judgment in ambiguous situations
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Must be able to work on-site at our Vancouver office
Legally entitled to work in Canada




Nice to Have

Familiarity with machine learning concepts applied to fraud/risk modelling
Prior experience in e-commerce specifically
Hands on experience with SQL, Python, R, or similar tools

Title: Research Data Technologist
Description:
Job Title

Research Data Technologist

Job Category

Non Union Technicians and Research Assistants

Job Profile

Non Union Salaried - Research Assistant /Technician 3

Job Family Group

Staff - Non Union

Department

Keown Laboratory Division of Nephrology | Department of Medicine | Faculty of Medicine

Compensation Range

$4,845.17 - $5,713.66 CAD Monthly

Job End Date

March 31, 2027

Posting End Date

October 23, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.

Please note this is a one (1) year fixed term position. However, there is a possibility of renewal.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, software developers, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The incumbent will support research activities by organizing, processing, analysing, and reporting biomedical data under the direction of senior research team members. In addition, they will support the preparation, quality control, analysis, and interpretation of biomedical datasets, including clinical, molecular, genomic, and imaging data. The incumbent will use established analytical methods and software tools and contribute to data organization, visualization, reporting, and other research activities supporting translational research projects. The incumbent will participate in projects involving data processing, visualization, clinical data integration, and selected applications of statistical and computational methods. Work will be performed using established procedures and under the guidance of senior members of the research team.

The Department of Medicine provides excellence in research, teaching, and clinical services related to the nature, cause, and prevention of adult diseases. As the largest Department in the Faculty of Medicine, comprising 18 Divisions and more than 1,200 faculty and staff located throughout British Columbia, the Department is committed to fostering research excellence, supporting learners and faculty, and contributing to the health of the Province of British Columbia.

Organizational Status

The successful candidate will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown), with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate, Data Manager and/or senior research team members. The Research Data Technologist will work as a member of an interdisciplinary team including clinicians, research scientists, statisticians, and trainees at UBC and collaborating institutions. The Research Data Technologist will receive direction and training appropriate to assigned projects and will provide regular updates on assigned activities and findings, with the day-to-day oversight given by the Research Associate in the Division of Nephrology, Department of Medicine

Work Performed


Perform routine data preparation, cleaning, quality checks, and organization for biomedical research datasets.
Use established analytical methods, software tools, and procedures to support research data analysis.
Prepare datasets and analysis outputs for use by researchers, statisticians, and other members of the research team.
Support the processing, quality control, integration, and management of molecular, genomic, clinical, and imaging data.
Develop or modify basic scripts, spreadsheets, and analytical tools to support data processing, visualization, and reporting.
Assist with the application of statistical, machine learning, or other computational methods under the direction of senior team members.
Support data visualization, image analysis, and other analytical activities as required by research projects.
Assist with maintaining research data files, analysis environments, and related computational resources.
Work with researchers and other team members to clarify data requirements and support agreed research activities.
Identify and report data quality issues, workflow problems, or unexpected results to senior research team members.
Assist with testing, documentation, quality assurance, and reproducibility of analyses and data workflows.
Assist with the organization, storage, security, and appropriate handling of research data in accordance with institutional and ethical requirements.
Prepare clear documentation, data summaries, tables, figures, and other research materials.
Assist with established analytical and data management procedures for new and ongoing research projects.
Contribute data summaries, figures, and other materials to scientific reports, presentations, publications, and grant applications.
Maintain familiarity with relevant data analysis tools and procedures and participate in training as required.


Consequence of Error/Judgement

All duties performed by the Research Data Technologist must adhere to data privacy and confidentiality policies, standard operating procedures, and UBC policies. Errors in data handling, analysis, or reporting could affect research results, delay study activities, or compromise data integrity. The Research Data Technologist is expected to follow established procedures and seek guidance from senior research team members when non-routine issues or decisions arise.

Supervision Received

The Research Data Technologist will report to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Paul Keown) with day-to-day oversight provided by the Research Associate. The incumbent may also receive direction from senior research team members and/or senior project co-lead(s), dependent on project. They will also receive necessary training from the Bioinformatician, as well as other members of the research team. The candidate is expected to provide regular research activity updates and present research findings to the team members

Supervision Given

The Research Data Technologist will not have formal supervisory responsibilities. The incumbent may provide basic guidance to students or other team members on routine data procedures when requested.

Minimum Qualifications

Completion of a relevant technical program or a university degree in a relevant discipline and a minimum three years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion


Preferred Qualifications

Title: Senior Analyst, Fulfillment Inventory Management
Description:
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of inventory, analytics, supply chain and strategy, with significant visibility across the organization. You will build models and turn complex data into actionable insights, identify risks and opportunities, and help drive meaningful business results.

The ideal person is a self-starter and strong program manager who can bring clarity to complex, cross-functional initiatives, build alignment across teams, and turn strategy into execution. A consulting background combined with strong retail or supply chain experience would be particularly relevant. There is also a strong continuous-improvement mandate - this is someone who will challenge how things are done and find better ways to drive results.

This is a contract through January 2028.




Who – The Company:

Our client is one of Vancouver’s most sought-after companies to work for, with global operations and an impeccable reputation.




What- The Role:

The Fulfillment Inventory Management team plays a critical role in maintaining inventory health, optimizing network capacity, enabling strategic inventory placement across the NAM fulfillment network, and ensuring the timely exit of end‑of‑life inventory. They partner closely with a broad range of cross‑functional teams to deliver on investment commitments while governing the processes that support effective inventory management and end‑of‑life execution.

They design and evolve core operational processes, lead governance routines, strengthen organizational connectivity, and generate data‑driven insights that fuel continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Through consistent and scalable governance frameworks, we drive efficient, standardized inventory practices that improve product availability, maximize DC space utilization, and minimize impacts on DC operations.

This role will lead a team to deliver on key mandates and financial commitments in a highly cross-functional area.

Lead and influence cross‑functional forums (analyst through director level) to enhance collaboration and partnership in support of shared operational, financial, and strategic outcomes.
Build complex operational–financial models that quantify process impacts, identify key drivers and KPIs, evaluate scenarios, surface risks, and recommend actionable improvements.
Partner across the network to improve inventory health, accelerate end‑of‑life inventory turnover, and optimize DC space utilization and overall operational efficiency.
Drive cross‑functional KPI improvements (e.g. inventory health, capacity, labor efficiency) by leading root cause analysis, quantifying possible levers to improve, and enabling teams with the right data, tools, and governance routines to support strategic prioritization and accountable execution.
Analyze large, complex datasets (Excel, Power BI, and related tools) to generate timely, accurate insights to support operational and financial decisions.
Support a multi-million dollar savings portfolio by creating and enabling processes and tactical execution plans, leveraging strong cross-team communication and influencing skills to proactively identify risks and develop initial risk mitigation strategies.
Support existing processes and enable new optimizations by creating integrated tools that provide transparent KPI visibility and faster, more effective issue escalation and resolution.
Continuously optimize current-state fulfillment processes to improve accuracy, speed, and alignment with evolving business priorities and strategic direction.




Who- the Candidate:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Supply chain or similar; Analytics is an asset; MBA or CPA preferred
5-8 years of experience, preferably in consulting, strategy or equivalent experience with product/supply chain internal function within a large corporation
4+ years of experience working within a highly cross-functional team
Proven ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects with varying timelines and scopes; including ability to plan, budget and manage project execution
Self-starter approach to work, with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives and foster this within your team
Excellent attention to detail given the complex nature of the work and the high exposure of the content across various groups and leadership
Creative thinking and excellent problem-solving skills – must be able to solve problems in a new way, seeing past what is established and create a new way of doing things
Demonstrated ability to create clarity and drive alignment towards a common goal and across team members in various functions
Advanced proficiency with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word necessary. Experience using Power BI is an asset
Strong process documentation skills and excellent spoken and written communication skills (verbal and non-verbal)




How much:

Competitive hourly wage in the range of $60-72/hr + 4% vacation pay, if incorporated, please discuss with Swim




Where:

Vancouver, hybrid working conditions, minimum 3 days onsite




When & How To Apply:

Swim Recruiting has been engaged as a trusted recruitment agency partner on this important search. If you already have a Recruiter at SWIM, please reach out very soon. If you do not yet have a contact at Swim Recruiting, please hit 'APPLY NOW' to send us your resume. Thank you!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Overview

Remarcable is purpose-built for trade contractors, helping them manage procurement, tools, and warehouse operations with unmatched visibility and control. As we scale across North America, data is at the core of how we deliver on that promise.

As our Data Scientist, you'll partner closely with Data Engineering to design and build out our data lakehouse, bringing data from across the business into one place to power in-platform and internal reporting, sharpen Remarcable's product intelligence, and surface the trends and next-step recommendations that help contractors and our own teams make better decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who's comfortable wearing multiple hats (analyst, scientist, developer) to shape data architecture and build out reporting, models, and insights that drive action and decision-making.

What You’ll Do


Partner with Data Engineering to design the lakehouse's semantic and analytical layers (on top of AWS S3, Redshift, Athena, Glue)
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholder
Analyze product, operations, and customer usage data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions
Build models and heuristics that power Remarcable Intelligence (e.g. smart search, recommendation engine, forecasting)
Build out AI/ML data infrastructure - feature engineering, training datasets, and model evaluation - supporting SageMaker and Bedrock workflows
Develop and maintain core analytics supporting company metrics (ARR, churn, NRR, product usage, ROI)
Create customer-facing and internal reporting for customers and internal teams
Design and validate product experiments (A/B tests and other measurement methodologies) to drive data-informed decisions that improve user experience and business outcomes


Who You Are


5+ years of experience in a Data Scientist, Analytics, or similar role
Someone who thrives in a startup - adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by impact.
Strong SQL skills: complex queries, window functions, performance tuning
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy)
Experience building dashboards/reporting (e.g., QuickSight, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or custom-built reporting)
Experience with modern data transformation tools (e.g., dbt).
Experience building, validating, and deploying practical ML and heuristic models to solve business problems in a production setting (e.g. recommendation, trend analysis, scoring).
Bonus: experience with AWS data/ML stack (Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock), and/or building recommendation or "next best action" style features


Why join us?

High Impact: Join a builder-led team where your work directly shapes the core product used by thousands.

Culture: Hybrid work environment in our Vancouver office (1 WFH day).

Retirement: RRSP Matching Program (50% match on the first 6% of your contribution).

Care: Health Spending Account (HSA) and Wellness Spending Account (WSA) administered via RBC.

Competitive PTO

Who We Are

Remarcable is a cloud based platform that helps electrical contractors and distributors streamline purchasing processes to save time and money.

Dedicated to the Electrical Contractor Industry, Remarcable provides cloud-based Procurement & Tool Management Software nationwide. Title: Analyste de l’information
Description:
La personne titulaire est chargée de mener des enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes afin d’appuyer les activités de la Mise en application de l’OCRI. Son rôle ne se limite pas à la collecte de données : il consiste également à interpréter et à synthétiser des renseignements complexes provenant de diverses sources, à dégager des tendances, des liens et des constatations clés qui orientent la stratégie relative aux dossiers et ouvrent de nouvelles pistes d’enquête. La personne titulaire transforme des données brutes et des éléments de preuve en renseignement clair donnant matière à intervention disciplinaire. En collaboration avec les équipes de la Mise en application, elle joue un rôle essentiel dans l’avancement des enquêtes par l’exercice de son jugement analytique, le maintien de l’intégrité des données et la gestion de multiples priorités dans un environnement dynamique axé sur les dossiers.

Principales responsabilités

Enquêtes


Mener des enquêtes approfondies sur les sociétés autorisées et les personnes autorisées en réponse aux plaintes du public (dont celles traitées par l’Évaluation des dossiers de l’OCRI), en réalisant des recherches exhaustives à partir du renseignement de sources ouvertes.
Consulter des bases de données internes et externes, des sources ouvertes et les médias sociaux afin de recueillir, de valider et d’analyser le renseignement pertinent.


Analyse et soutien à la Mise en application


Collaborer avec les équipes de la Mise en application en organisant, en interprétant et en présentant des données et des éléments de preuve à l’appui des dossiers en cours, y compris en préparant des pièces matérielles et en présentant les constatations à la direction et aux collègues.
Au moyen des outils logiciels disponibles, recueillir et analyser des renseignements complexes, produire des visualisations de données et rédiger des rapports de renseignement clairs mettant en évidence les principales constatations, les tendances observées, les lacunes relevées et les mesures à prendre recommandées afin de soutenir la prise de décisions à l’égard des enquêtes et les mesures disciplinaires.
Soutenir les procédures disciplinaires en témoignant lors d’audiences, au besoin.


Développement de la fonction de renseignement


Participer aux réunions d’équipe et contribuer aux projets d’amélioration continue en proposant des démarches novatrices concernant les pratiques, les processus et l’efficacité opérationnelle globale du renseignement.
Repérer les lacunes en matière de renseignement, les difficultés à relever dans les enquêtes, les liens entre les sources d’information ainsi que les occasions de renforcer les stratégies d’enquête.
Concevoir et tenir à jour des outils de suivi des données (p. ex. systèmes de gestion de la relation client [GRC], feuilles de calcul Excel et tableaux de bord Power BI), effectuer la saisie et l’agrégation des données, et améliorer continuellement les flux de travaux et les processus d’analyse afin d’accroître l’efficacité et d’améliorer les résultats des enquêtes.
Développer et maintenir une fine connaissance des systèmes de l’OCRI, des sources de données, des outils d’analyse (p. ex. systèmes de GRC, Excel, i2, Power BI et logiciels de renseignement de sources ouvertes) ainsi que des technologies émergentes grâce à du perfectionnement professionnel continu et à l’apprentissage autonome.
Établir des relations de travail efficaces avec les parties prenantes en matière de réglementation et les autorités compétentes d’autres territoires afin de soutenir la mission de l’OCRI et de renforcer les activités d’enquête et de renseignement.


Aptitudes et compétences clés

Éléments essentiels


Diplôme d’études postsecondaires en criminologie, en finance, en affaires ou en comptabilité
Compétences ou expérience en matière d’enquêtes fondées sur le renseignement de sources ouvertes
De 3 à 5 années d’expérience dans le secteur du placement à travailler avec des données
Grande maîtrise de l’ensemble des fonctionnalités de Microsoft 365
Connaissance des outils de visualisation de données comme Microsoft Power BI et i2
Bon jugement dans l’évaluation de la pertinence, de l’utilité et de l’importance de l’information Grand souci du détail et souci de fournir de l’information qui peut être utilisée dans une audience contestée
Aptitudes pour la gestion et la coordination de projets
Expérience des logiciels de base de données et expérience en saisie de données
Esprit d’équipe et excellente aptitude pour la communication orale et écrite


Atouts


Expérience dans les secteurs de la réglementation, de l’application de la loi, de la comptabilité ou de la finance
Connaissance pratique des stratégies de négociation des participants et de leurs clients
Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais

L’OCRI, qui possède des bureaux dans plusieurs villes au Canada (de Vancouver à Montréal), a pour mission de favoriser des marchés financiers sains en faisant respecter une réglementation équitable et efficace afin que les investisseurs soient protégés et se sentent en confiance lorsqu’ils investissent pour leur avenir. Vous souhaitez faire carrière dans un organisme qui vous permet de protéger l’intégrité des marchés canadiens? Joignez-vous à l’OCRI et faites partie de l’équipe qui protège notre avenir financier.

Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et bienveillant où vous pourrez vous épanouir et avoir un impact réel. Pour en savoir plus sur ce que signifie bâtir votre carrière à CIRO, visitez notre page Carrières : https://www.ciro.ca/about-ciro/careers

Notre engagement 

L’OCRI souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et s’engage à offrir des mesures d’adaptation conformément au Code des droits de la personne de l’Ontario et à la Loi de 2005 sur l’accessibilité pour les personnes handicapées de l’Ontario. L’organisme offre des mesures d’adaptation aux personnes handicapées tout au long du processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin de telles mesures, veuillez communiquer avec les Ressources humaines.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et nous tenons à procurer aux postulants qui en font la demande des mesures d’adaptation tout au long du processus de recrutement, conformément aux droits de la personne et à la législation sur l’accessibilité qui s’appliquent.

Notre processus de recrutement


Cette offre d’emploi concerne un poste actuellement vacant dans notre équipe.
Nous utilisons des assistants automatisés (IA) pour la recherche de candidats et les communications. Les candidatures sont examinées par notre équipe d’embauche et les décisions sont prises par des personnes physiques.

Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $38.88 - $55.89 / hour

Job Summary

We are currently seeking a Full-Time, Business Analyst, Contract Management to provide leadership to our Contract Management & Supply Utilization team, at our Central City Tower, located in Surrey BC.

Build On Your Education And Career Experience As You


Coordinate work activities related to the production of major reports and documents, identify reporting needs, analyze current procedures, explore opportunities, reduce redundancies and ensure data gathering and reporting processes support corporate strategies and business objectives related to contract management, service utilization reviews, health intervention/technology assessments and cost-effective analyses in collaboration with business units and stakeholders.
Consult with Directors and Managers and engages with clients and stakeholders to determine and ensure relevant information is captured, effectively gathered, mined and leveraged to support effective decision making in support of program and corporate strategies.
Verify the accuracy, consistency and integrity of data and information.
Consult with Contract Management leadership to validate contents of reports and documents.
Provide detailed analysis, advice, interpretation and resource support within Contract Management for multi-source complex data analysis by compiling and reviewing financial, contract, human resource and operational data, clinical data and significant events occurring within a specified time frame.
Prepare strategic business cases and supporting documents, briefing papers, strategic and tactical reports for an assigned area and/or portfolio for submission to Fraser Health Executive, Board of Directors and other stakeholders.
Develop comprehensive business and technical requirement documentation for existing and new contract management processes.


Are you passionate about joining our team? We will be looking for you to have:


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Health Economics, Computer Science and/or related field
Five (5) to seven (7) years' recent related experience in contract management, business analysis and/or health care management
An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be acceptable


Detailed Overview

Supporting the Vision, Values, Purpose and Commitments of Fraser Health including service delivery that is centered around patients/clients/residents and families:

Provides leadership and support to the Contract Management Office (CMO) team by applying expert knowledge in Contract Management, Sourcing and Procurement, or Product Management, and skills in business and data analytics, UX/UI, system administration, and reporting to provide evidence-based review of service utilization, health interventions and technology assessments; responsible for the planning and development of reporting requirements by reviewing clinical, financial, human resource, commercial service and operational data to develop strategic business cases; prepares supporting documents, process maps, briefing papers, strategic and tactical reports for an assigned area and/or portfolio for submission to Fraser Health Executive, Board of Directors and other stakeholders; works collaboratively with members of the Contract Management team, senior management, staff of various organizational units and other internal and external stakeholders in support of the mission, philosophies and goals of Fraser Health.

Responsibilities


Coordinates work activities related to the production of major reports and documents, identify reporting needs, analyze current procedures, explore opportunities, reduce redundancies and ensure data gathering and reporting processes support corporate strategies and business objectives related to contract management, service utilization reviews, health intervention/technology assessments and cost-effective analyses in collaboration with business units and stakeholders.
Consults with Directors and Managers and engages with clients and stakeholders to determine and ensure relevant information is captured, effectively gathered, mined and leveraged to support effective decision making in support of program and corporate strategies.
Verifies the accuracy, consistency and integrity of data and information; consults with Contract Management leadership to validate contents of reports and documents.
Provides detailed analysis, advice, interpretation and resource support within Contract Management for multi-source complex data analysis by compiling and reviewing financial, contract, human resource and operational data, clinical data and significant events occurring within a specified time frame.
Prepares strategic business cases and supporting documents, briefing papers, strategic and tactical reports for an assigned area and/or portfolio for submission to Fraser Health Executive, Board of Directors and other stakeholders.
Develop comprehensive business and technical requirement documentation for existing and new contract management processes.
Provides system administration support to existing contract management digital platforms such as DocuSign, Bonfire, ComplyWorks and Agiloft CLM; oversees activities pertaining to updates and maintenance of intranet site.
Tracks and monitors the implementation of the project progress according to established plan; monitors and reports on the status and major issues/obstacles encountered; makes recommendations regarding scope changes.
Provides expertise during different phases of system implementation life cycle to ensure reporting requirements meet established guidelines and standards; reviews reporting requirements and performs corrective action, as required.
Develops annual performance plans including goals and objectives for assigned area of responsibility, in collaboration with the Manager, Contract Management Office.
Develops business reports and participates in the design, development and testing of performance reporting solutions using various tools such as MS Excel, SQL or Power BI Designs and develops BI reporting solutions using reporting tools such as SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.

Description:
Department: Marketing

Location: Vancouver

Compensation: CA$90,000 - CA$110,000 / year

Description

Hi there, we’re Article. 👋 We’re an online first furniture company creating remarkably better furniture experiences, one sofa at a time. Since 2013, we’ve been redefining the industry. Vancouver, BC is home to our HQ and first retail store, and our logistics network serves customers coast to coast across the US and Canada. This is where you come in. As our Customer Research & Insight Specialist (Marketing), you will help build, scale, and deliver Article’s Voice of Customer (VoC) engine, turning customer feedback datasets into commercial insights that directly shape business strategy and drive end to end customer retention.

Please Note (Role Profile & Contract Term): This is a 1 Year Full Time Term Contract based out of our Vancouver HQ. This position is a strategic customer research and commercial insights role—it is not a passive reporting or general Business Analyst position. We are looking for a true business partner who combines sharp business acumen with qualitative customer empathy and cross functional influence.

Why We Need You

Understanding our customers at scale is essential to delivering remarkable experiences and driving business performance. The Customer Research & Insight Specialist sits at the intersection of customer feedback and business strategy, synthesizing data across every customer touchpoint: product reviews, experience surveys, claims data, and customer care interactions into strategic intelligence.

In this role, you will do far more than generate dashboards or deliver static reports. You will act as a pragmatic business partner and passionate customer advocate who translates complex customer sentiment into tangible commercial recommendations. By owning our taxonomy frameworks, refining sentiment tools, and collaborating directly with operational leaders across Article, you will ensure the voice of the customer actively informs strategic investments, product decisions, and operational trade offs. You’ll work closely as an embedded strategic partner to leaders across Customer Care, Logistics, eCommerce, Quality, and Category Management to ensure customer sentiment directly drives operational improvements and product strategy.

Within your first few months, you’d take ownership of our customer feedback datasets in our Voice of Customer tool (Chattermill), establish strong working partnerships with key department heads, and refine our code frames to align with operational goals. In a year, you’ll be proud to say you’ve elevated our VoC engine into a core business driver, established clear cross functional alignment, and influenced key business initiatives through data backed strategic recommendations.

Why Article?

As a Particle (people of Article), you will have a high level of autonomy to solve challenging, meaningful problems the best way you can. That means you’re trusted to explore solutions you believe will work best (you’re the expert, after all). You’ll do all this while growing your career within a company that is actively scaling its commercial and direct to consumer presence.

About The Marketing & Insights Team

You will sit within the Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Manager, Research & Insights. Our team operates at the intersection of customer experience, brand strategy, and commercial execution, serving as an embedded strategic partner to leaders across Customer Care, Logistics, eCommerce, Quality, and Category Management.

We thrive on business acumen, curiosity, clear communication, and first principles problem solving. We’re looking for someone who acts as a true consultant to internal teams, combining deep customer empathy with a sharp understanding of business drivers.

This position is based out of our Vancouver, BC HQ (Hybrid in office schedule required; remote work outside Vancouver is not supported for this role).

What You’ll Do

You will drive the strategic management, deep dive analysis, and cross functional implementation of customer feedback data across Article.

Specifically, You Will


Act as a Strategic Business Partner: Partner directly with department heads across Customer Care, Logistics, eCommerce, Quality, and Category Management to translate customer feedback into actionable business strategies and trade off decisions.
Co Develop VoC Strategy & Analysis: Manage and analyze Article's Voice of Customer (VoC) datasets, including product reviews, post delivery experience reviews, claims data, and customer care interaction logs.
Govern Taxonomy & Sentiment Rules: Maintain and refine text tagging code frames and NLP/sentiment rules within Chattermill to ensure open ended customer feedback is accurately categorized and optimized for commercial relevance.
Deliver High Impact Executive Recommendations: Translate customer feedback into executive briefs and functional dashboards that deliver clear strategic guidance rather than just raw data updates.
Drive Data Storytelling & Business Impact: Build compelling narratives that connect customer sentiment directly to operational costs, product quality, and customer lifetime value.
Support Market Research Projects: Assist with broader primary and secondary market research projects as needed to support strategic enterprise initiatives.


Who You Are


Strong Business Acumen: You understand how business operations, unit economics, and customer experience intersect. You focus on driving business outcomes, not just delivering reports.
Strategic Business Partner: Proven ability to build credibility, collaborate with cross functional stakeholders, and influence business decisions across different operational groups.
Customer Research & Insights Profile: Background in customer research, market insights, or Voice of Customer (VoC) programs with a balance of qualitative empathy and quantitative analytical rigour.
Storyteller with Data: Skilled at taking unstructured data, sentiment metrics, and open ended feedback and translating them into compelling business cases and strategic recommendations.
Taxonomy & Sentiment Familiarity: Experience or comfort managing code frames, text tagging taxonomies, or NLP/sentiment tools (e.g., Chattermill, Qualtrics, or similar feedback platforms).
Organized & Independent: Highly organized self starter with a hybrid builder operator mindset who thrives managing multiple strategic projects simultaneously.
Tech & Tool Proficient: Proficient with Google Suite, Excel, and data visualization platforms.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or post secondary certification in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, Market Research, Statistics, or a related field.
Legally able to work in Canada.
Completion of criminal background check.


Wealth

The salary range is $90,000 to $110,000
Starting salary is determined by your transferable skills, knowledge, work experience, and the hiring team’s budget, which is based on business needs, market compensation data, and internal equity
Life:


15 days of vacation*
1 extra day off (Inclusion and Diversity Day)
6 well-being (sick) days
Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office

$1000 health/lifestyle spending account* for your total physical and mental well-being
TELUS Health App

The Article HQ is a converted warehouse, with an open accessible layout and no offices (even for our founders)
Work from your desk, an Article sofa, collaboration spaces, or a private meeting room
Standup desks can be requested too
Our kitchens are stocked with salty, sweet and healthy snacks, & all the premium coffees and teas to keep you buzzing
Onsite fitness equipment with showers and towel service
Pickleball, badminton, and table tennis matches happen, from very competitive to very casual
A dog-friendly office - well-socialized pups are welcome

Free street parking (first come, first serve; no reserved spots for senior leaders)
Indoor secure bike storage with change rooms and showers

45% discount on our entire product range (15% for friends and family)

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.


We're excited about you because…


You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.

Title: Associate Planner | Global Inventory
Description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

As a member of the product team, the Global Planning team is responsible for ensuring the efficient management of inventory for the company. They work closely with the regional teams to understand new product trends, regional needs, size trends, and logistics. The team monitors inventory levels on a weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis, assessing changes in trends and adjusting strategies to optimize inventory management and mitigate risks. The priority is to understand and protect the guest experience, followed by maintaining effective inventory control and supporting profitable sales growth.

Reporting to the Global Inventory & Operations Planning Manager, the Global Associate Planner plays a key role in supporting global inventory planning and visibility across the business. This role is responsible for developing forward-looking inventory projections, assessing inventory health, and translating data into insights that support planning and operational decisions. You will work closely with Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional partners to understand inventory flow, identify risks and opportunities, and support both short- and long-term business priorities.


Inventory Health & Insights: Analyze inventory performance and develop inventory composition and aged inventory projections across global and market levels. Assess the health, balance, and aging of inventory, identifying emerging risks and opportunities and providing actionable insights to support inventory decisions and leadership discussions.
Inventory Flow & Projections: Manage and analyze on-orders, receipts, and inventory flow to maintain visibility to future inventory positions. Partner closely with DC Operations to develop inbound and outbound projections that support capacity planning, operational readiness, and changing business needs.
Business Performance & Reporting: Monitor key inventory and planning KPIs against plan and prior year. Analyze trends and underlying drivers to identify areas of opportunity or risk and provide clear insights into business performance.
Leadership Insights & Presentations: Support the development of monthly and quarterly business reviews, bringing together inventory and performance data into clear, concise presentations. Highlight key trends, business drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for leadership.
Cross-Functional Planning: Build strong partnerships across Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align inventory projections, communicate changes, and ensure teams have the visibility needed to make informed decisions.
Tools & Process Improvement: Own and maintain key planning tools, dashboards, and reporting while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate processes. Support the evolution of scalable reporting and tools that improve data accuracy, visibility, and overall team efficiency.


Qualifications


College certificate or University degree is required
1-3 years merchandise planning or inventory management experience
2-3 years proven experience with data analysis
Expert knowledge of Excel & Power Bi for report building is required.
Financial acumen and understanding of retail math
Effective communication skills (written & verbal)
Extremely organized, thorough and able to prioritize
Detail orientated


must haves


Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.
Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.
Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.
Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.


Additional Notes

Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from  $80,800 - $106,100 CAD   annually ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.

Paid time off

Parenthood top-up

People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)

For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

As Senior Analytics Engineer - GTM, you’ll play a key role in helping our GTM team grow our business. You’ll report to the Director of Business Intelligence joining a centralized global team of analytics engineers and data engineers. Our team owns data pipelines for sales analytics such as headcount planning, quota attainment, and sales effectiveness. You’ll ensure that we have accurate data and a single source of truth for GTM and growth metrics. We’re looking for someone with deep domain expertise working with sales and GTM teams. You’ll combine that domain expertise with data skills in data analysis, building pipelines, and designing data models. We want someone who enjoys collaborating with a diverse group of stakeholders and won’t rest until their business needs are met.

What You'll Do


Drive the GTM data roadmap to build scalable durable data products
Build and maintain key data pipelines and marts that power core company-wide GTM metrics such as our headcount model, quota attainment, and pipeline.
Build insightful and reliable dashboards to track performance of core metrics that will deliver insights to the whole company
Collaborate with our GTM analyst teams to train and enable them on datasets and data tools
Write excellent documentation and tutorials
Work across the full-stack of analytics from ad-hoc analysis and reports to architecting pipelines
Build semantic models and run evals to power AI tools that let sales operators query business data in natural language
Use AI-assisted development tools to move fast while keeping code, models, and documentation clean and maintainable for both humans and machines
Communicate complex data concepts clearly and persuasively through technical specs, dashboards, and presentations to align teams on metrics and definitions


Qualifications


7+ years experience in data engineering, data analytics, or analytics engineering
Deep expertise in data modeling and data warehouse design
Expert level SQL skills and experience with columnar analytics databases such as Snowflake and Bigquery
Expert level knowledge of Salesforce’s data model and other GTM systems
Experience with DBT and GIT
Experience with business intelligence tools - Direct Hex experience is a bonus
Experience working with sales, sales operations, sales compensation, and finance teams
Experience building with AI tooling for data such as semantic models, context management systems, and evals
A meticulous attention to detail
Self-starter with the ability to self-project manage work
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You are comfortable speaking with business executives and engineers alike and can translate between the two groups at the IC and senior stakeholder level

Key job responsibilities

Problem-Solving


Analyze complex data to identify patterns, inform product decisions, and understand root causes of anomalies.
